    20                                  
    21                                  ;------ Retro DOS v2 (v3) boot sector loads RETRODOS.SYS (MSDOS.SYS)
    22                                  ;	at 1000h:0000h and loader (initialization) part of RETRODOS kernel
    23                                  ;	moves IO.SYS (DOSBIOSCODE & DOSBIOSDATA, 'IOSYS5.BIN') to 70h:0000h.
    24                                  ;	Then SYSINIT code to the next segment (46Dh for original MSDOS 5.0)..
    25                                  ;	SYSINIT code relocates itself and DOSBIOSCODE and MSDOS.SYS
    26                                  ;	(MSDOS5.BIN) according to request/setting in 'config.sys' file.
    27

   497                                  ; NOTES:

   499                                  ;   Relocates the loader code to top-of-memory.

   509                                  ; Determine the number of paragraphs (16 byte blocks) of memory.

   514                                  ; available amount of memory in AX

   769                                  ; NOTES: read the start of the clusters that covers at least IbmLoadSize
   770                                  ;	 fully.  for example, if sector/cluster = 2, and IbmLoadSize=3
   771                                  ;	 then we are going to re-read the second cluster to fully cover
   772                                  ;	 msload program in the cluster boundary.

   776                                  ;		  msboot program when you build the new version!!!!!

  1232                                  ; ReadSectors
  1233                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1234                                  ; notES:
  1235                                  ;
  1236                                  ;  read in the CS:SectorCount number of sectors at ES:di
  1237                                  ;
  1238                                  ;
  1239                                  ; INPUT:
  1240                                  ;
  1241                                  ;   DI = OFFSET of start of read
  1242                                  ;   ES = segment of read
  1243                                  ;   CS:SectorCount = number of sectors to read
  1244                                  ;   CS:StartSecL = starting sector (low)
  1245                                  ;   CS:StartSecH = starting sector (high)
  1246                                  ;   following is bpb info that must be setup prior to call
  1247                                  ;   CS:NumHeads
  1248                                  ;   CS:number_of_sectors
  1249                                  ;   CS:BootDrive
  1250                                  ;   CS:SecPerTrack
  1251                                  ;
  1252                                  ; OUTPUT:
  1253                                  ;
  1254                                  ;   AX,BX,CX,DX,SI,DI destroyed
  1255                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1256                                  ; divide start sector by sectors per track
  1257                                  ; the remainder is the actual sector number, 0 based
  1258                                  ;
  1259                                  ; increment actual sector number to get 1 based
  1260                                  ;
  1261                                  ; the quotient is the number of tracks - divide by heads to get the cyl
  1262                                  ;
  1263                                  ; the remainder is actual head, the quotient is cylinder
  1264                                  ;
  1265                                  ; figure the number of sectors in that track, set al to this
  1266                                  ;
  1267                                  ; do the read
  1268                                  ;
  1269                                  ; if error, do reset, then redo the int 13h
  1270                                  ;
  1271                                  ; if successful read, subtract # sectors read from SectorCount, add to logical
  1272                                  ; sector, add #sectors read * BytesPerSec to bx;
  1273                                  ;
  1274                                  ; if SectorCount <> 0 do next read

  1599                                  ; GetNextFatEntry
  1600                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1601                                  ;
  1602                                  ; NOTES:
  1603                                  ;
  1604                                  ;   given the last cluster found, this will return the next cluster of
  1605                                  ;   iosys. if the last cluster is (f)ff8 - (f)fff, then the final cluster
  1606                                  ;   of iosys has been loaded, and control is passed to goto_iosys
  1607                                  ;   msload can handle maximum fat area size of 128 kb.
  1608                                  ;
  1609                                  ; INPUT:
  1610                                  ;
  1611                                  ;    CS:CurrentCluster
  1612                                  ;    CS:FatSize
  1613                                  ;
  1614                                  ; OUTPUT:
  1615                                  ;
  1616                                  ;   CS:CurrentCluster (updated)
  1617                                  ;
  1618                                  ; calls:  GetFatSector
  1619                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1620                                  ; get CurrentCluster
  1621                                  ;
  1622                                  ; if (16 bit fat)
  1623                                  ;    {if (CurrentCluster = fff8 - ffff)
  1624                                  ;	 {jmp goto_iosys}
  1625                                  ;     else
  1626                                  ;	{get OFFSET by multiply cluster by 2}
  1627                                  ;
  1628                                  ; else
  1629                                  ;    {if (CurrentCluster = ff8 - fff)
  1630                                  ;	 {jmp goto_iosys}
  1631                                  ;     else
  1632                                  ;	{get OFFSET by	- multiply cluster by 3
  1633                                  ;
  1634                                  ;	 rotate right to divide by 2
  1635                                  ;
  1636                                  ;	 if (cy set - means odd number)
  1637                                  ;	    {shr 4 times to keep high twelve bits}
  1638                                  ;
  1639                                  ;	 else
  1640                                  ;	    {and with 0fffh to keep low 12 bits}
  1641                                  ;	}
  1642                                  ;    }
  1643                                  ;
  1644                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1645                                  
  1646                                  ; 09/12/2022
  1647                                  ; FAT_12_BIT equ 1
  1648                                  ; NOT_END_OF_FILE equ 0  ; ~END_OF_FILE ; END_OF_FILE equ 0FFh
  1649                                  
  1650                                  GetNextFatEntry:
  1651 00000294 06                      		push	es
  1652                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1653                                  		; ds = cs
  1654                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:FatSegment]
  1655 00000295 A1[3200]                		mov	ax, [FatSegment]
  1656 00000298 8EC0                    		mov	es, ax		; ES-> FAT area segment
  1657                                  		; 09/12/2022
  1658                                  		;;mov	byte [cs:EndOfFile], END_OF_FILE
  1659                                  		;mov	byte [cs:EndOfFile], 0FFh ; Assume last cluster
  1660                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:CurrentCluster] ; Get last cluster
  1661                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1662                                  		; ds = cs
  1663 0000029A C606[2900]FF            		mov	byte [EndOfFile], 0FFh ; Assume last cluster
  1664 0000029F A1[0E00]                		mov	ax, [CurrentCluster] ; Get last cluster
  1665                                  		; 06/10/2023
  1666 000002A2 29D2                    		sub	dx, dx
  1667                                  		; dx = 0
  1668 000002A4 803E[2700]01            		cmp	byte [Fatsize], 1
  1669                                  		;;cmp	byte [cs:FatSize], FAT_12_BIT
  1670                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:Fatsize], 1

  1769                                  ; GetFatSector
  1770                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1771                                  ;function: find and read the corresponding fat sector into ES:0
  1772                                  ;
  1773                                  ;in). SI = offset value (starting from fat entry 0) of fat entry to find.
  1774                                  ;     ES = fat sector segment
  1775                                  ;     CS:BytesPerSec
  1776                                  ;
  1777                                  ;out). corresponding fat sector read in.
  1778                                  ;      BX = offset value of the corresponding fat entry in the fat sector.
  1779                                  ;      CX destroyed.
  1780                                  ;      zero flag set if the fat entry is splitted, i.e. when 12 bit fat entry
  1781                                  ;      starts at the last byte of the fat sector. in this case, the caller
  1782                                  ;      should save this byte, and read the next fat sector to get the rest
  1783                                  ;      of the fat entry value. (this will only happen with the 12 bit fat).
  1784                                  ;
  1785                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1786                                  
  1787                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1788                                  		; 22/12/2022
  1789                                  GetFatSector:
  1790                                  		; 06/10/2023
  1791                                  		;push	ax
  1792                                  		;push	si
  1793 000002FC 57                      		push	di
  1794 000002FD 89F0                    		mov	ax, si
  1795                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1796                                  		; ds = cs
  1797                                  		;mov	cx, [cs:BytesPerSec]
  1798                                  		;div	cx			; AX = Sector number, DX = Offset
  1799 000002FF F736[1000]              		div	word [BytesPerSec]
  1800 00000303 3B06[0A00]              		cmp	ax, [LastFatSector]
  1801                                  		;cmp	ax, [cs:LastFatSector]	; The same fat sector?
  1802 00000307 7421                    		je	short SplitChk		; Don't need to read it again.
  1803 00000309 A3[0A00]                		mov	[LastFatSector], ax
  1804                                  		;mov	[cs:LastFatSector], ax
  1805 0000030C 52                      		push	dx
  1806                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1807 0000030D 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
  1808                                  		;add	ax, [cs:HiddenSectorsL]
  1809                                  		;adc	dx, [cs:HiddenSectorsH]
  1810                                  		;add	ax, [cs:ReservSectors]
  1811                                  		;adc	dx, 0
  1812                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1813                                  		; ds = cs
  1814 0000030F 0306[2E00]              		add	ax, [FatStartSecL]
  1815 00000313 1316[3000]              		adc	dx, [FatStartSecH]
  1816 00000317 A3[0600]                		mov	[StartSecL], ax
  1817 0000031A 8916[0800]              		mov	[StartSecH], dx		; Set up for ReadSectors
  1818                                  		;mov	[cs:StartSecL], ax
  1819                                  		;mov	[cs:StartSecH], dx	; Set up for ReadSectors
  1820                                  
  1821 0000031E C706[0C00]0100          		mov	word [SectorCount], 1	; 1 sector
  1822                                  		;mov	word [cs:SectorCount], 1 ; 1 sector
  1823 00000324 31FF                    		xor	di, di ; 0
  1824                                  		; es:di = FATSEGMENT:0000h
  1825 00000326 E8D2FE                  		call	ReadSectors
  1826 00000329 5A                      		pop	dx
  1827                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1828                                  		;mov	cx, [cs:BytesPerSec]
  1829                                  SplitChk:
  1830                                  		; 24/12/2022
  1831 0000032A 8B0E[1000]              		mov	cx, [BytesPerSec]
  1832 0000032E 49                      		dec	cx			; CX = SECTOR SIZE - 1
  1833 0000032F 39CA                    		cmp	dx, cx			; If last byte of sector, splitted entry.
  1834 00000331 89D3                    		mov	bx, dx			; set bx to dx
  1835 00000333 5F                      		pop	di
  1836                                  		; 06/10/2023
  1837                                  		;pop	si
  1838                                  		;pop	ax
  1839                                  		; 07/10/2023
  1840                                  ;EndWrite:		; 10/12/2022
  1841 00000334 C3                      		retn

  1882                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  1885                                  
  1886                                  BData_start:
  1887 00000000 E96317                  hdrv_pat:	jmp	init		; MSBIO1.ASM, MSSBDATA.INC
  1888                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1889                                  
  1890 00000003 0000                    DosDataSg:	dw 0
  1891                                  
  1892                                  ; DOS's int 2f handler will exit via a jump through here.
  1893                                  ; This is how the BIOS hooks int2f
  1894                                  			
  1895 00000005 EA                      bios_i2f:	db 0EAh			; far jump to int_2f (segment may not be at 70h)
  1896 00000006 [8808]                  off_706:	dw int_2f
  1897 00000008 7000                    word_708:	dw 70h			; KERNEL_SEGMENT
  1898                                  
  1899 0000000A 0000                    romstartaddr:	dw 0			; The start address for the romfind routines
  1900                                  					; This is to maintain binary compatibility
  1901                                  					; with DISK based DOS 5.0

  2055                                  
  2056                                  ; (MSDOS 3.3) NOTE:
  2057                                  ; Some floppy drives do not have changeline support. The result is a
  2058                                  ; large amount of inefficiency in the code. A media-check always returns
  2059                                  ; "I don`t know". This cause DOS to reread the FAT on every access and
  2060                                  ; always discard any cached data.
  2061                                  ;    We get around this inefficiency by implementing a "Logical Door Latch".
  2062                                  ; The following three items are used to do this. The logical door latch is
  2063                                  ; based on the premise that it is not physically possible to change floppy
  2064                                  ; disks in a drive in under two seconds (most people take about 10). The
  2065                                  ; logical door latch is implemented by saving the time of the last successful
  2066                                  ; disk operation (in the value TIM_DRV). When a new request is made the
  2067                                  ; current time is compared to the saved time. If less than two seconds have
  2068                                  ; passed then the value "No Change" is returned. If more than two seconds
  2069                                  ; have passed the value "Don't Know" is returned.
  2070                                  ;    There is one complecation to this algorithm. Some programs change the
  2071                                  ; value of the timer. In this unfortunate case we have an invalid timer.
  2072                                  ; This possibility is detected by counting the number of disk operations
  2073                                  ; which occur without any time passing. If this count exceeds the value of
  2074                                  ; "AccessMax" we assume the counter is invalid and always return "Don't
  2075                                  ; Know". The variable "AccessCount" is used to keep track of the number
  2076                                  ; of disk operation which occur without the time changing.
  2077                                  
  2078 0000011D 00                      accesscount:	db 0			
  2079 0000011E FF                      tim_drv:	db 0FFh			
  2080 0000011F 00                      medbyt:		db 0
  2081                                  wrtverify:	; 15/10/2022			
  2082 00000120 02                      rflag:		db 2			; 2 for	read, 3	for write
  2083 00000121 00                      verify:		db 0			; 1 if verify after write
  2084 00000122 0000                    seccnt:		dw 0			
  2085 00000124 00                      		db 0			; -- pad where hardnum was
  2086 00000125 01                      dsktnum:	db 1			; number of diskette drives			
  2087                                  
  2088                                  ; (MSDOS 3.3) NOTE:
  2089                                  ; Some of the older versions of the IBM rom-bios always assumed a seek would
  2090                                  ; have to be made to read the diskette. Consequently a large head settle
  2091                                  ; time was always used in the I/O operations. To get around this problem
  2092                                  ; we need to continually adjust the head settle time. The following
  2093                                  ; algorithm is used:
  2094                                  ;
  2095                                  ;   Get the current head settle value.
  2096                                  ;   If it is 1, then
  2097                                  ;	set slow = 15
  2098                                  ;   else
  2099                                  ;	set slow = value
  2100                                  ;   ...
  2101                                  ;   if we are seeking and writing then
  2102                                  ;	use slow
  2103                                  ;   else
  2104                                  ;	use fast
  2105                                  ;   ...
  2106                                  ;   restore current head settle value
  2107                                  
  2108 00000126 00                      motorstartup:	db 0			; value from table
  2109 00000127 00                      settlecurrent:	db 0			; value	from table
  2110 00000128 00                      settleslow:	db 0			; slow settle value
  2111 00000129 00                      nextspeed:	db 0			; value	of speed to be used
  2112 0000012A 00                      save_head_sttl:	db 0			; used by read_sector routine
  2113 0000012B 00                      save_eot:	db 0			; saved	eot from the default DPT
  2114 0000012C 09                      eot:		db 9			
  2115 0000012D 00000000                dpt:		dd 0			; pointer to Disk Parameter Table

  2117 00000132 00                      curhd:		db 0			; current head
  2118 00000133 0000                    curtrk:		dw 0			; current track
  2119 00000135 0000                    spsav:		dw 0			; save the stack pointer

  2674                                  ;************************************************************************
  2675                                  ;*									*
  2676                                  ;*	Ensure A20 is enabled before jumping into code in HMA.		*
  2677                                  ;*	This code assumes that if Segment of Device request packet is	*
  2678                                  ;*	DOS DATA segment then the Device request came from DOS & that	*
  2679                                  ;*	A20 is already on.						*

  2681                                  ;************************************************************************

  2683                                  cdev_entry:	; proc near		
  2684 0000073A 2E803E[0D00]00          		cmp	byte [cs:inHMA], 0
  2685 00000740 740D                    		jz	short ce_enter_codeseg
  2686                                  				; optimized for DOS in HMA
  2687 00000742 50                      		push	ax
  2688 00000743 2EA1[0300]              		mov	ax, [cs:DosDataSg]
  2689 00000747 2E3906[1400]            		cmp	[cs:ptrsav+2], ax
  2690 0000074C 58                      		pop	ax
  2691 0000074D 7505                    		jnz	short not_from_dos
  2692                                  				; jump is coded this way to fall thru
  2693                                  				; in 99.99% of the cases
  2694                                  ce_enter_codeseg:
  2695 0000074F 2EFF2E[D506]            		jmp	far [cs:cdev]
  2696                                  		;jmp	dword ptr cs:cdev

  2698                                  
  2699                                  not_from_dos:

  2704                                  ;*									*
  2705                                  ;*	outchr - this is our int 29h handler. it writes the		*
  2706                                  ;*	   character in al on the display using int 10h ttywrite	*
  2707                                  ;*									*
  2708                                  ;************************************************************************
  2709                                  
  2710                                  outchr:
  2711 00000759 50                      		push	ax		; int 29h handler
  2712 0000075A 56                      		push	si
  2713 0000075B 57                      		push	di
  2714 0000075C 55                      		push	bp
  2715 0000075D 53                      		push	bx
  2716 0000075E B40E                    		mov	ah, 0Eh
  2717 00000760 BB0700                  		mov	bx, 7
  2718 00000763 CD10                    		int	10h		; - VIDEO - WRITE CHARACTER AND	ADVANCE	CURSOR (TTY WRITE)
  2719                                  					; AL = character, BH = display page (alpha modes)
  2720                                  					; BL = foreground color	(graphics modes)
  2721 00000765 5B                      		pop	bx
  2722 00000766 5D                      		pop	bp
  2723 00000767 5F                      		pop	di
  2724 00000768 5E                      		pop	si

  2730                                  ;*									*
  2731                                  ;*	block13 - our int13 hooker					*
  2732                                  ;*									*
  2733                                  ;************************************************************************
  2734                                  
  2735                                  block13:

  2737 00000771 7408                    		jz	short skipa20
  2738 00000773 E85400                  		call	IsA20Off	; A20 Off?
  2739 00000776 7503                    		jnz	short skipa20
  2740 00000778 E84300                  		call	EnableA20	; assure a20 enabled
  2741                                  
  2742                                  skipa20:
  2743 0000077B 2E8C1E[1C00]            		mov	[cs:i13_ds], ds	; save caller's ds for call-through
  2744 00000780 9C                      		pushf			; fake interrupt
  2745 00000781 2EFF1E[E106]            		call	far [cs:i13x]
  2746                                  		;call	dword ptr cs:i13x
  2747                                  					; call through Bios_Code entry table
  2748 00000786 2E8E1E[1C00]            		mov	ds, [cs:i13_ds]
  2749 0000078B CA0200                  		retf	2
  2750                                  
  2751                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  2752                                  
  2753                                  ; the int13 hook calls back here to call-through to the ROM
  2754                                  ; this is necessary because some people have extended their
  2755                                  ; ROM BIOSs to use ds as a parameter/result register and
  2756                                  ; our int13 hook relies heavily on ds to access Bios_Data
  2757                                  
  2758                                  call_orig13:	; proc far

  2760 00000792 9C                      		pushf			; simulate an int13
  2761 00000793 2EFF1E[B400]            		call	far [cs:Orig13]
  2762                                  		;call	cs:Orig13
  2763 00000798 2E8C1E[1C00]            		mov	[cs:i13_ds], ds
  2764 0000079D 0E                      		push	cs
  2765 0000079E 1F                      		pop	ds		; restore ds ->	Bios_Data before return
  2766                                  
  2767 0000079F 9C                      		pushf
  2768                                  		; 10/12/2022
  2769                                  		; ds = cs
  2770 000007A0 803E[0D00]00            		cmp	byte [inHMA], 0	; 16/10/2022
  2771                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:inHMA], 0
  2772 000007A5 7408                    		jz	short corig13_popf_retf
  2773 000007A7 E82000                  		call	IsA20Off
  2774 000007AA 7503                    		jnz	short corig13_popf_retf
  2775 000007AC E80F00                  		call	EnableA20
  2776                                  corig13_popf_retf:			
  2777 000007AF 9D                      		popf
  2778 000007B0 CB                      		retf

  2859                                  ;*									*

  2862                                  int19:
  2863 000007F0 0E                      		push	cs
  2864 000007F1 1F                      		pop	ds
  2865 000007F2 8E06[1A00]              		mov	es, [zeroseg]	; 16/10/2022
  2866 000007F6 B90500                  		mov	cx, 5		; NUMROMVECTORS
  2867                                  		;mov	si, offset RomVectors
  2868 000007F9 BE[0001]                		mov	si, RomVectors	; 19/10/2022
  2869                                  next_int:

  2871 000007FD 98                      		cbw			; assume < 128
  2872 000007FE D1E0                    		shl	ax, 1
  2873 00000800 D1E0                    		shl	ax, 1		; int *	4
  2874 00000802 89C7                    		mov	di, ax
  2875 00000804 AD                      		lodsw
  2876 00000805 AB                      		stosw
  2877 00000806 AD                      		lodsw
  2878 00000807 AB                      		stosw			; install the saved vector
  2879 00000808 E2F2                    		loop	next_int
  2880 0000080A 803E[3706]00            		cmp	byte [int19sem], 0 ; 19/10/2022
  2881 0000080F 7422                    		jz	short doint19
  2882 00000811 BE[3806]                		mov	si, i19_lst	; stacks code has changed these hardware interrupt vectors
  2883                                  					; stkinit in sysinit1 will initialize int19oldxx values
  2884 00000814 B90E00                  		mov	cx, 14		; num_i19
  2885                                  
  2886                                  i19_restore_loop:
  2887 00000817 AC                      		lodsb			; get interrupt	number
  2888 00000818 98                      		cbw			; assume < 128
  2889 00000819 89C7                    		mov	di, ax
  2890 0000081B AD                      		lodsw			; get original vector offset
  2891 0000081C 89C3                    		mov	bx, ax		; save it
  2892 0000081E AD                      		lodsw
  2893 0000081F 83FBFF                  		cmp	bx, 0FFFFh	; check	for 0ffffh (unlikely segment)
  2894 00000822 740D                    		jz	short i19_restor_1 ; opt no need to check selector too
  2895 00000824 83F8FF                  		cmp	ax, 0FFFFh	; opt 0ffffh is	unlikely offset
  2896 00000827 7408                    		jz	short i19_restor_1
  2897 00000829 01FF                    		add	di, di
  2898 0000082B 01FF                    		add	di, di
  2899 0000082D 93                      		xchg	ax, bx
  2900 0000082E AB                      		stosw
  2901 0000082F 93                      		xchg	ax, bx
  2902 00000830 AB                      		stosw			; put the vector back
  2903                                  
  2904                                  i19_restor_1:				
  2905 00000831 E2E4                    		loop	i19_restore_loop

  3041                                  ; WIN386 instance data structure
  3042                                  ;
  3043                                  ; Here is a Win386 startup info structure which we set up and to which
  3044                                  ; we return a pointer when Win386 initializes.
  3045                                  
  3046 00000891 0300                    Win386_SI:	db 3, 0			; SI_Version
  3047                                  					; Startup Info for Win386
  3048 00000893 00000000                SI_Next:	dd 0			; pointer to next info structure
  3049 00000897 00000000                		dd 0			; a field we don't need
  3050 0000089B 00000000                		dd 0			; another field	we don't need
  3051 0000089F [A308]                  SI_Instance:	dw Instance_Table
  3052 000008A1 7000                    		dw 70h	; Bios_Data	; far pointer to instance table
  3053                                  
  3054                                  ; This table gives Win386 the instance data in the BIOS and ROM-BIOS data
  3055                                  ; areas. Note that the address and size of the hardware stacks must
  3056                                  ; be calculated and inserted at boot time.
  3057                                  
  3058 000008A3 00005000                Instance_Table:	dw 0, 50h		; print	screen status...
  3059 000008A7 0200                    		dw 2			; ... 2	bytes
  3060 000008A9 0E005000                		dw 0Eh,	50h		; ROM Basic data...
  3061 000008AD 1400                    		dw 14h			; ... 14H bytes
  3062 000008AF [0C00]                  		dw altah		; a con	device buffer...
  3063 000008B1 7000                    		dw 70h			; Bios_Data segment
  3064 000008B3 0100                    		dw 1			; ... 1 byte
  3065                                  
  3066                                  NextStack:
  3067                                  
  3068                                  ; NOTE:  If stacks are disabled by STACKS=0,0, the following
  3069                                  ;	instance items WILL NOT be filled in by SYSINIT.
  3070                                  ;	That's just fine as long as these are the last items
  3071                                  ;	in the instance list since the first item is initialized
  3072                                  ;	to 0000 at load time.
  3073                                  
  3074 000008B5 00000000                		dw 0, 0			; pointer to next stack	to be used...
  3075 000008B9 0200                    		dw 2			; ... 2 bytes
  3076 000008BB 00000000                IT_StackLoc:	dd 0			; location of hardware stacks
  3077 000008BF 0000                    IT_StackSize:	dw 0			; size of hardware stacks
  3078 000008C1 00000000                		dd 0			; terminate the	instance table
  3079                                  
  3080                                  					;SR;
  3081 000008C5 00                      IsWin386:	db 0			; Flag to indicate whether
  3082                                  					; Win386 is running or not
  3083                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3084                                  
  3085                                  ;This routine was originally in BIOS_CODE but this causes a lot of problems
  3086                                  ;when we call it including checking of A20. The code being only about

  3097 000008D1 B88416                  		mov	ax, 1684h	; Get API entry	point

  3099                                  					; BX = virtual device (VxD) ID,	ES:DI =	0000h:0000h

  3108                                  		;push	ax

  3401                                  ; Possibly disposable data, goes at end of data group
  3402                                  
  3403                                  ;***	ibm_disk_io - main routine, fixes at rom bug
  3404                                  ;
  3405                                  ;	entry:	(ah) = function, 02 or 0a for read.
  3406                                  ;		(dl) = drive number (80h or 81h).
  3407                                  ;		(dh) = head number.
  3408                                  ;		(ch) = cylinder number.
  3409                                  ;		(cl) = sector number (high 2 bits has cylinder number).
  3410                                  ;		(al) = number of sectors.
  3411                                  ;		(es:bx) = address of read buffer.
  3412                                  ;		for more on register contents see rom bios listing.
  3413                                  ;		stack set up for return by an iret.
  3414                                  ;
  3415                                  ;	exit:	(ah) = status of current operation.
  3416                                  ;		(cy) = 1 if failed, 0 if successful.
  3417                                  ;		for other register contents see rom bios listing.
  3418                                  ;
  3419                                  ;	uses:	
  3420                                  ;
  3421                                  ;
  3422                                  ;	warning: uses old13 vector for non-read calls.
  3423                                  ;		does direct calls to the at rom.
  3424                                  ;		does segment arithmatic.
  3425                                  ;
  3426                                  ;	effects: performs disk i/o operation.
  3427                                  
  3428                                  ; 16/10/2022
  3429                                  ; 28/05/2019
  3430                                  cmd_block equ 42h ; ROMBIOS DATA segment (40h) offset 42h ; 13/12/2022
  3431                                  
  3432                                  ;* offsets into cmd_block for registers
  3433                                  
  3434                                  pre_comp equ 0	;write pre-compensation
  3435                                  sec_cnt	 equ 1	;sector count
  3436                                  sec_num	 equ 2	;sector number
  3437                                  cyl_low	 equ 3	;cylinder number, low part
  3438                                  cyl_high equ 4	;cylinder number, high part
  3439                                  drv_head equ 5	;drive/head (bit 7 = ecc mode, bit 5 = 512 byte sectors, 
  3440                                  		;            bit 4 = drive number, bits 3-0 have head number)
  3441                                  cmd_reg  equ 6	;command register
  3442                                  
  3443                                  ; 01/10/2022
  3444                                  disk_status1	equ 74h
  3445                                  hf_num		equ 75h
  3446                                  control_byte	equ 76h
  3447                                  
  3448                                  ibm_disk_io:
  3449 000012D2 80FA80                  		cmp	dl, 80h		; main routine,	fixes at rom bug
  3450 000012D5 720A                    		jb	short atd1	; pass through floppy disk calls. 
  3451 000012D7 80FC02                  		cmp	ah, 2
  3452 000012DA 740A                    		jz	short atd2	; intercept call 02 (read sectors).
  3453 000012DC 80FC0A                  		cmp	ah, 0Ah
  3454 000012DF 7405                    		jz	short atd2	; and call 0Ah (read long).
  3455                                  atd1:
  3456 000012E1 2EFF2E[0601]            		jmp	far [cs:Old13]
  3457                                  		;jmp	cs:Old13	; use rom int 13h handler
  3458                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3459                                  
  3460 000012E6 53                      atd2:		push	bx
  3461 000012E7 51                      		push	cx
  3462 000012E8 52                      		push	dx
  3463 000012E9 57                      		push	di
  3464 000012EA 1E                      		push	ds
  3465 000012EB 06                      		push	es
  3466 000012EC 50                      		push	ax
  3467 000012ED B84000                  		mov	ax, 40h		; bioseg (rombios data segment)
  3468                                  					; establish bios segment addressing
  3469 000012F0 8ED8                    		mov	ds, ax
  3470                                  		; 16/10/2022
  3471 000012F2 C606740000              		mov	byte [disk_status1], 0
  3472                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:74h, 0 ; [disk_status1]
  3473                                  					; initially no error code.
  3474 000012F7 80E27F                  		and	dl, 7Fh		; mask to hard disk number
  3475 000012FA 3A167500                		cmp	dl, [hf_num]
  3476                                  		;cmp	dl, ds:75h	; [hf_num] ; 40h:75h
  3477 000012FE 7207                    		jb	short atd3	; disk number in range
  3478                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:74h, 1 ; bad_disk
  3479 00001300 C606740001              		mov	byte [disk_status1], 1
  3480 00001305 EB20                    		jmp	short atd4	; disk number out of range error,
  3481                                  					; return
  3482                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3483                                  
  3484                                  atd3:					
  3485 00001307 53                      		push	bx
  3486 00001308 8CC0                    		mov	ax, es
  3487 0000130A C1EB04                  		shr	bx, 4		; make es:bx to seg:000x form.
  3488 0000130D 01D8                    		add	ax, bx
  3489 0000130F 8EC0                    		mov	es, ax
  3490 00001311 5B                      		pop	bx
  3491 00001312 83E30F                  		and	bx, 0Fh
  3492 00001315 0E                      		push	cs
  3493 00001316 E8DF00                  		call	check_dma
  3494 00001319 720C                    		jb	short atd4	; abort if dma across segment boundary
  3495 0000131B 58                      		pop	ax
  3496 0000131C 50                      		push	ax
  3497 0000131D E81A00                  		call	setcmd		; set up command block for disk op
  3498 00001320 BAF603                  		mov	dx, 3F6h	; hf_reg_port 
  3499 00001323 EE                      		out	dx, al		; write out command modifier
  3500 00001324 E86B00                  		call	docmd		; carry out command
  3501                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3502                                  
  3503                                  atd4:	
  3504                                  
  3505                                  ;  new code - let logical or clear carry and then set carry if ah!=0
  3506                                  ;	      and save a couple bytes while were at it.
  3507                                  				
  3508 00001327 58                      		pop	ax
  3509                                  		;mov	ah, ds:74h	; [disk_status1]
  3510 00001328 8A267400                		mov	ah, [disk_status1]
  3511 0000132C 08E4                    		or	ah, ah
  3512 0000132E 7401                    		jz	short atd5
  3513 00001330 F9                      		stc
  3514                                  atd5:
  3515 00001331 07                      		pop	es
  3516 00001332 1F                      		pop	ds
  3517 00001333 5F                      		pop	di
  3518 00001334 5A                      		pop	dx
  3519 00001335 59                      		pop	cx
  3520 00001336 5B                      		pop	bx
  3521 00001337 CA0200                  		retf	2		; far return, dropping flags
  3522                                  
  3523                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E ========================================
  3524                                  
  3525                                  ;***	setcmd - set up cmd_block for the disk operation
  3526                                  ;
  3527                                  ;	entry:	(ds) = bios data segment.
  3528                                  ;		(es:bx) in seg:000x form.
  3529                                  ;		other registers as in int 13h call
  3530                                  ;	
  3531                                  ;	exit:	cmd_block set up for disk read call.
  3532                                  ;		control_byte set up for disk operation.
  3533                                  ;		(al) = control byte modifier
  3534                                  ;
  3535                                  ;	sets the fields of cmd_block using the register contents
  3536                                  ;	and the contents of the disk parameter block for the given drive.
  3537                                  ;
  3538                                  ;	warning: (ax) destroyed.
  3539                                  ;		does direct calls to the at rom.
  3540                                  
  3541                                  setcmd:		; proc near		
  3542                                  		;mov	ds:43h,	al	; [cmd_block+sec_cnt]
  3543                                  		; 16/10/2022
  3544 0000133A A24300                  		mov	[cmd_block+sec_cnt], al
  3545                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:48h, 20h ; [cmd_block+cmd_reg]
  3546 0000133D C606480020              		mov	byte [cmd_block+cmd_reg], 20h ; assume function 02h (read)
  3547 00001342 80FC02                  		cmp	ah, 2
  3548 00001345 7405                    		jz	short setc1	; cmd_reg = 20h	if function 02h	(read)
  3549 00001347 C606480022              		mov	byte [cmd_block+cmd_reg], 22h
  3550                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:48h, 22h ; [cmd_block+cmd_reg]
  3551                                  					; cmd_reg = 22h	if function 0Ah	(read long)
  3552                                  setc1:
  3553 0000134C 88C8                    		mov	al, cl
  3554 0000134E 243F                    		and	al, 3Fh		; mask sector number
  3555                                  		;mov	ds:44h,	al	; [cmd_block+sec_num]
  3556                                  		;mov	ds:45h,	ch	; [cmd_block+cyl_low]
  3557 00001350 A24400                  		mov	[cmd_block+sec_num], al ; mov [44h],al
  3558 00001353 882E4500                		mov	[cmd_block+cyl_low], ch ; mov [45h],ch
  3559 00001357 88C8                    		mov	al, cl
  3560 00001359 C0E806                  		shr	al, 6		; get two high bits of cylinder	number
  3561                                  		;mov	ds:46h,	al	; [cmd_block+cyl_high]
  3562 0000135C A24600                  		mov	[cmd_block+cyl_high], al ; mov [46h],al
  3563 0000135F 89D0                    		mov	ax, dx
  3564 00001361 C0E004                  		shl	al, 4		; drive	number
  3565 00001364 80E40F                  		and	ah, 0Fh
  3566 00001367 08E0                    		or	al, ah		; head number
  3567 00001369 0CA0                    		or	al, 0A0h	; set ecc and 512 bytes	per sector
  3568                                  		;mov	ds:47h,	al	; [cmd_block+drv_head]
  3569 0000136B A24700                  		mov	[cmd_block+drv_head], al  ; mov [47h],al 
  3570 0000136E 06                      		push	es
  3571 0000136F 53                      		push	bx
  3572 00001370 0E                      		push	cs
  3573 00001371 E85C00                  		call	get_vec
  3574 00001374 268B4705                		mov	ax, [es:bx+5]	; [es:bx+fdp_precomp]
  3575                                  			 		; write pre-comp from disk parameters
  3576 00001378 C1E802                  		shr	ax, 2
  3577                                  		;mov	ds:42h,	al	; [cmd_block+pre_comp]
  3578 0000137B A24200                  		mov	[cmd_block+pre_comp], al ; mov [42h],al
  3579                                  					; only use low part
  3580 0000137E 268A4708                		mov	al, [es:bx+8]	; [es:bx+fdp_control]
  3581                                  					; control byte modifier
  3582 00001382 5B                      		pop	bx
  3583 00001383 07                      		pop	es
  3584                                  		;mov	ah, ds:76h	; [control_byte]
  3585 00001384 8A267600                		mov	ah, [control_byte] ; mov ah,[76h]
  3586 00001388 80E4C0                  		and	ah, 0C0h	; keep disable retry bits	
  3587 0000138B 08C4                    		or	ah, al
  3588                                  		;mov	ds:76h,	ah
  3589 0000138D 88267600                		mov	[control_byte], ah ; mov [76h],al
  3590 00001391 C3                      		retn
  3591                                  
  3592                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E ========================================
  3593                                  
  3594                                  ;***	docmd - carry out read operation to at hard disk
  3595                                  ;
  3596                                  ;	entry:	(es:bx) = address for read in data.
  3597                                  ;		cmd_block set up for disk read.
  3598                                  ;
  3599                                  ;	exit:	buffer at (es:bx) contains data read.
  3600                                  ;		disk_status1 set to error code (0 if success).
  3601                                  ;
  3602                                  ;	
  3603                                  ;
  3604                                  ;	warning: (ax), (bl), (cx), (dx), (di) destroyed.
  3605                                  ;		no check is made for dma boundary overrun.
  3606                                  ;
  3607                                  ;	effects: programs disk controller.
  3608                                  ;		performs disk input.
  3609                                  
  3610                                  docmd:		; proc near		
  3611 00001392 89DF                    		mov	di, bx
  3612 00001394 0E                      		push	cs
  3613 00001395 E84000                  		call	command
  3614 00001398 7535                    		jnz	short doc3
  3615                                  doc1:
  3616 0000139A 0E                      		push	cs
  3617 0000139B E84200                  		call	waitt		; wait for controller to complete read
  3618 0000139E 752F                    		jnz	short doc3
  3619 000013A0 B90001                  		mov	cx, 256		; 256 words per sector
  3620 000013A3 BAF001                  		mov	dx, 1F0h	; hf_port
  3621 000013A6 FC                      		cld			; string op goes up
  3622 000013A7 FA                      		cli			; disable interrupts
  3623                                  					; (bug was forgetting this)
  3624                                  
  3625                                  ;	M062 -- some of these old machines have intermittent failures
  3626                                  ;		when the read is done at full speed. Instead of using
  3627                                  ;		a string rep instruction, we'll use a loop. There is
  3628                                  ;		a slight performance hit, but it only affects these
  3629                                  ;		very old machines with an exact date code match, and
  3630                                  ;		it makes said machines more reliable
  3631                                  ;
  3632                                  ;M062	repz	insw		;read in sector
  3633                                  
  3634                                  rsct_loop:
  3635 000013A8 6D                      		insw
  3636 000013A9 E2FD                    		loop	rsct_loop
  3637 000013AB FB                      		sti
  3638                                  		; 16/10/2022
  3639 000013AC F606480002              		test	byte [cmd_block+cmd_reg], 02h

  3858

  3860                                  ;

  3884 00001457 BBB505                  		mov	bx, 1461	; (366+365*3)
  3885                                  					; # of days in a Leap year block

  3887 0000145C 2E8916[E904]            		mov	[cs:daycnt], dx	; save daycnt left
  3888 00001461 B304                    		mov	bl, 4
  3889 00001463 F6E3                    		mul	bl		; AX = # of years. Less	than 100
  3890 00001465 2E0006[EE04]            		add	[cs:base_year], al ; So, ah = 0. Adjust year
  3891 0000146A 2EFF06[E904]            		inc	word [cs:daycnt]	; set daycnt to	1 base
  3892 0000146F 2E813E[E904]6E01        		cmp	word [cs:daycnt], 366	; daycnt=remainder of leap year	bk
  3893 00001476 7626                    		jbe	short leapyear	; within 366+355+355+355 days.
  3894 00001478 2EFE06[EE04]            		inc	byte [cs:base_year]	; if daycnt <= 366, then leap year
  3895 0000147D 2E812E[E904]6E01        		sub	word [cs:daycnt], 366	; else daycnt--, base_year++ ;
  3896 00001484 B90300                  		mov	cx, 3		; And next three years are normal
  3897                                  regularyear:				
  3898 00001487 2E813E[E904]6D01        		cmp	word [cs:daycnt], 365	; for(i=1; i>3 or daycnt <=365;	i++)

  3900 00001490 2EFE06[EE04]            		inc	byte [cs:base_year]	;   { daycnt -=	365
  3901 00001495 2E812E[E904]6D01        		sub	word [cs:daycnt], 365	;   }
  3902 0000149C E2E9                    		loop	regularyear	; }
  3903                                  					;
  3904                                  					; should never fall through loop
  3905                                  leapyear:				
  3906 0000149E 2EC606[F004]1D          		mov	byte [cs:month_tab+1], 29 ; leap year.
  3907                                  					; change month table.
  3908                                  yeardone:

  3910 000014A6 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx

  3912                                  		;mov	si, offset month_tab
  3913 000014AC BE[EF04]                		mov	si, month_tab	; 19/10/2022
  3914 000014AF B90C00                  		mov	cx, 12
  3915                                  months:					
  3916 000014B2 FEC3                    		inc	bl
  3917

  3919                                  		;mov	dl, [cs:si]

  3974                                  ; the k09 requires the routines for reading the clock because of the suspend/

  3977                                  ; the following routine is executed at resume time when the system
  3978                                  ; powered on after suspension. it reads the real time clock and
  3979                                  ; resets the system time and date, and then irets.

  3983                                  int6c:					
  3984 000014FE 0E                      		push	cs

  3987 00001504 8F06[B406]              		pop	word [int6c_ret_addr+2]

  3990 0000150C FA                      		cli

  3997                                  					; CX:DX	= clock	count
  3998                                  					; Return: time of day set

  4004                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E ========================================
  4005                                  
  4006                                  ;   read_real_date reads real-time clock for date and returns the number
  4007                                  ;   of days elapsed since 1-1-80 in si
  4008                                  
  4009                                  read_real_date:	; proc near		
  4010 0000151F 50                      		push	ax
  4011 00001520 51                      		push	cx
  4012 00001521 52                      		push	dx
  4013 00001522 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah		; throw	away clock roll	over
  4014 00001524 CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- GET TIME OF DAY
  4015                                  					; Return: CX:DX	= clock	count
  4016                                  					; AL = 00h if clock was	read or	written	(via AH=0,1) since the previous
  4017                                  					; midnight
  4018                                  					; Otherwise, AL	> 0
  4019 00001526 5A                      		pop	dx
  4020 00001527 59                      		pop	cx
  4021 00001528 58                      		pop	ax
  4022 00001529 50                      		push	ax
  4023 0000152A 53                      		push	bx

  4025 0000152C 52                      		push	dx

  4027                                  					; REAL TIME CLOCK ERROR	FLAG (+1 DAY)

  4030                                  					; Return: DL = day in BCD
  4031                                  					; DH = month in	BCD
  4032                                  					; CL = year in BCD
  4033                                  					; CH = century (19h or 20h)
  4034 00001538 7303                    		jnb	short read_ok

  4119                                  ; read_real_time reads the time from the rtc. on exit, it has the number of
  4120                                  ; ticks (at 18.2 ticks per sec.) in cx:dx.

  4122                                  read_real_time:	; proc near

  4125                                  					; Return: CH = hours in	BCD

  4171                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================

  4173                                  ;   bcd_to_bin converts two bcd nibbles in al (value <= 99.) to
  4174                                  ;   a binary representation in al

  4181 00001644 D2EC                    		shr	ah, cl
  4182 00001646 D50A                    		aad
  4183 00001648 C3                      		retn

  4258                                  ;   bcd_verify checks values in bin_date_time to be valid
  4259                                  ;   bcd numerals.  carry set if any nibble out of range

  4261                                  bcd_verify:	; proc near		
  4262 00001699 B90400                  		mov	cx, 4		; 4 bytes to check
  4263 0000169C BB[B606]                		mov	bx, bin_date_time
  4264                                  bv_loop:				
  4265 0000169F 8A07                    		mov	al, [bx]	; get a	bcd number (0..99)
  4266 000016A1 88C4                    		mov	ah, al
  4267 000016A3 250FF0                  		and	ax, 0F00Fh	; 10's place in high ah, 1's in al
  4268                                  					; is 1's place in range?
  4269 000016A6 3C0A                    		cmp	al, 10
  4270 000016A8 77ED                    		ja	short bv_error	; jmp out of range
  4271 000016AA D0EC                    		shr	ah, 1
  4272 000016AC D0EC                    		shr	ah, 1
  4273 000016AE D0EC                    		shr	ah, 1
  4274 000016B0 D0EC                    		shr	ah, 1
  4275 000016B2 80E40F                  		and	ah, 0Fh		; get rid of any erroneous bits
  4276 000016B5 80FC0A                  		cmp	ah, 10		; is 10's place in range
  4277 000016B8 77DD                    		ja	short bv_error	; jmp out of range
  4278 000016BA 43                      		inc	bx		; next byte
  4279 000016BB 49                      		dec	cx
  4280 000016BC 75E1                    		jnz	short bv_loop
  4281 000016BE F8                      		clc			; set success flag

  4296                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
  4297                                  ;									:
  4298                                  ;	System initialization						:
  4299                                  ;									:
  4300                                  ;	The entry conditions are established by the bootstrap		:
  4301                                  ;	loader and are considered unknown. The following jobs		:
  4302                                  ;	will be performed by this module:				:
  4303                                  ;									:
  4304                                  ;	1.	All device initialization is performed			:
  4305                                  ;	2.	A local stack is set up and DS:SI are set		:
  4306                                  ;		to point to an initialization table. Then		:
  4307                                  ;		an inter-segment call is made to the first		:
  4308                                  ;		byte of the dos 					:
  4309                                  ;	3.	Once the dos returns from this call the ds		:
  4310                                  ;		register has been set up to point to the start		:
  4311                                  ;		of free memory. The initialization will then		:
  4312                                  ;		load the command program into this area 		:
  4313                                  ;		beginning at 100 hex and transfer control to		:
  4314                                  ;		this program.						:
  4315                                  ;									:
  4316                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
  4317

  4432                                  		dw	720 ; 2*9*40	; number of sectors (at 512 bytes each)
  4433                                  		db	0FDh		; media descriptor

  4437                                  		dw	0		; hidden sector count (low word)
  4438                                  		dw	0		; hidden sector (high)

  4567                                  ;	entry point to call utility functions in Bios_Code. At this time,
  4568                                  ;	  we aren't doing any A20 switching. During MSINIT time Bios_Code
  4569                                  ;	  will not yet be moved to its final resting place, so we know
  4570                                  ;	  it'll be low.
  4571                                  ;
  4572                                  ;	to use this function, do a "push cs" and load bp with the offset of
  4573                                  ;	  the function you want to call in Bios_Code. This routine will
  4574                                  ;	  push the address of a retf in Bios_Code onto the stack which
  4575                                  ;	  will get executed when the utility function finishes. It will
  4576                                  ;	  then transfer control to Bios_Code:bp using a couple of pushes
  4577                                  ;	  and a retf

  4579                                  ; 16/10/2022
  4580                                  ;BC_RETF equ bc_retf - DOSBIOSEG_2C7h
  4581                                  ; 09/12/2022

  4583                                  
  4584                                  addr_of_bcretf:	;dw 0C8h		; dw bc_retf
  4585                                  					; 2C7h:0C8h = 70h:2638h
  4586 00001757 [C800]                  		dw BC_RETF

  4592                                  					; set up near return to far return

  4594 00001763 55                      		push	bp		; save offset of utility function
  4595 00001764 CB                      		retf			; far jump to (DOS)BIOS code

  4614                                  		;

  4647                                  ; 	Because, Retro DOS v2 boot sector loads complete/entire MSDOS.SYS
  4648                                  ;	(RETRODOS.SYS) Kernel file (IO.SYS & MSDOS.SYS together).
  4649                                  ;	As result of boot sector ve init differences, Retro DOS init code (here)
  4650                                  ;	moves kernel to segment 070h at first, then sets diskette parameters
  4651                                  ;	at segment 50h (while MSDOS 5.0 boot sector sets this).

  4655

  4657                                  ;	save this in cs:bios_h and cs:bios_l. this is for the start of
  4658                                  ;	data sector of the bios.

  4755 000017BA CD11                    		int	11h		; EQUIPMENT DETERMINATION
  4756                                  					; Return: AX = equipment flag bits
  4757                                  
  4758                                  ; we have to support a system that does not have any diskette
  4759                                  ; drives but only hardfiles. this system will ipl from the hardfile.
  4760                                  ; if the equipment flag bit 0 is 1, then the system has diskette drive(s).
  4761                                  ; otherwise, the system has only hardfiles.
  4762                                  ;
  4763                                  ; important thing is that still, for compatibility reason, the drive letter
  4764                                  ; for the hardfiles start from "c".  so, we still need to allocate dummy bds
  4765                                  ; drive a and drive b. at sysinit time, we are going to set cds table entry
  4766                                  ; of dpb pointer for these drives to 0, so any user attempt to access this
  4767                                  ; drives will get "invalid drive letter ..." message. we are going to
  4768                                  ; establish "fakefloppydrv" flag. ***sysinit module should call int 11h to
  4769                                  ; determine whether there are any diskette drivers in the system or not.!!!***
  4770                                  
  4771                                  ; check the register returned by the equipment determination interrupt
  4772                                  ; we have to handle the case of no diskettes in the system by faking
  4773                                  ; two dummy drives.
  4774                                  ;
  4775                                  ; if the register indicates that we do have floppy drives we don't need
  4776                                  ; to do anything special.
  4777                                  ;
  4778                                  ; if the register indicates that we don't have any floppy drives then
  4779                                  ; what we need to do is set the fakefloppydrv variable, change the
  4780                                  ; register to say that we do have floppy drives and then go to execute
  4781                                  ; the code which starts at notsingle. this is because we can skip the
  4782                                  ; code given below which tries to find if there are one or two drives
  4783                                  ; since we already know about this.
  4784

  4787                                  		;test	ax, 1		; floppy drives	present	?
  4788 000017BE 7524                    		jnz	short normalfloppydrv ;	yes.

  4793                                  ; WARNING !!!
  4794                                  ;
  4795                                  ; This sequence of code is present in SYSINIT1.ASM also. Any modification
  4796                                  ; here will require an equivalent modification in SYSINIT1.ASM also

  4812                                  					; DL = number of consecutive drives

  4814 000017C9 7204                    		jc	short _gdskp_error

  5758                                  ;		drive number starting from 2 and then rescan diskette drives

  6139                                  	; ------

  6191                                  ;******************************************************************************
  6192                                  ; module name: remap
  6193                                  ;
  6194                                  ; descriptive name: all the code for himem that could be separated from msbio
  6195                                  ;
  6196                                  ; function:  remap the bds chain to adjusted logical drive numbers (drive
  6197                                  ;	     letters) if more than two diskette drives on the system.
  6198                                  ;
  6199                                  ;     scheme:  if more than 2 diskette drives, first map the bds structure
  6200                                  ;	       as usual and then rescan the bds chain to adjust the drive
  6201                                  ;	       letters. to do this, scan for disk drives and assign logical
  6202                                  ;	       drive number starting from 2 and then rescan diskette drives
  6203                                  ;	       and assign next to the last logical drive number of last disk
  6204                                  ;	       drive to the 3rd and 4th diskette drives.
  6205                                  
  6206                                  ; input:       none
  6207                                  ; exit:	drive letters have been remapped in bds chain
  6208                                  ; exit error:  none
  6209                                  ; called from: msinit
  6210                                  ;
  6211                                  ; notes:  this function  will be called only if more than 2 diskettes are
  6212                                  ;	  found in the system
  6213                                  ;	  this function assumes that there are no more than 26 drives assigned
  6214                                  ;	    this is guaranteed by the code that creates bdss for partitions
  6215                                  ;	  this function assumes that the first entries in the chain are
  6216                                  ;	   floppy drives, and all the rest are hard drives
  6217                                  ;	  will alter the boot drive if necessary to reflect remapping
  6218                                  ;
  6219                                  ;******************************************************************************
  6220                                  
  6221                                  ; 17/10/2022
  6222                                  ; 02/10/2022
  6223                                  
  6224                                  remap:		; proc near
  6225                                  
  6226                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6227                                  		; ds = cs
  6228                                  		;mov	di, [cs:start_bds] ; get first bds
  6229 00001C74 8B3E[1901]              		mov	di, [start_bds]
  6230                                  
  6231                                  ; search for 1st fixed disk physical drive num
  6232                                  
  6233                                  drive_loop:
  6234 00001C78 807D0480                		cmp	byte [di+4], 80h ; [di+BDS.drivenum]
  6235                                  					; first	hard disk??
  6236 00001C7C 7409                    		jz	short fdrv_found ; yes,	continue
  6237 00001C7E 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  6238                                  					; get next bds,	assume segment
  6239 00001C80 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, -1 ; 0FFFFh	; last bds?
  6240 00001C83 75F3                    		jnz	short drive_loop ; loop	if not
  6241 00001C85 EB49                    		jmp	short rmap_exit	; yes, no hard drive on	system
  6242                                  
  6243                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6244                                  ;first disk drive bds, now change the logical drive num to 2 and the subsequent
  6245                                  ;logical drive nums to 3, 4, 5 etc.
  6246                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6247                                  
  6248                                  fdrv_found:
  6249 00001C87 B002                    		mov	al, 2		; start	with logical drv num=2
  6250                                  fdrv_loop:
  6251 00001C89 884505                  		mov	[di+5],	al	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  6252 00001C8C 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  6253                                  					; ds:di--> next	bds
  6254                                  		;inc	al		; set num for next drive
  6255                                  		; 18/12/2022
  6256 00001C8E 40                      		inc	ax
  6257 00001C8F 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh	; last hard drive ?
  6258 00001C92 75F5                    		jnz	short fdrv_loop	; no - assign more disk drives
  6259                                  
  6260                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6261                                  ; now, rescan and find bds of 3rd floppy drive and assign next drive letter
  6262                                  ; in al to 3rd. if the current drive letter is past z, then do not allocate
  6263                                  ; any more.
  6264                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6265                                  
  6266                                  		;mov	di, [cs:start_bds] ; [start_bds]
  6267                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6268 00001C94 8B3E[1901]              		mov	di, [start_bds]	; get first bds
  6269 00001C98 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  6270                                  					; ds:di-->bds2
  6271                                  		;mov	ah, [cs:dsktnum] ; get number of floppies to remap
  6272 00001C9A 8A26[2501]              		mov	ah, [dsktnum]
  6273 00001C9E 80EC02                  		sub	ah, 2		; adjust for a:	& b:
  6274                                  remap_loop1:
  6275 00001CA1 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  6276                                  					; set new num to next floppy
  6277 00001CA3 884505                  		mov	[di+5],	al	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  6278 00001CA6 FEC0                    		inc	al		; new number for next floppy
  6279 00001CA8 FECC                    		dec	ah		; count down extra floppies
  6280 00001CAA 75F5                    		jnz	short remap_loop1
  6281                                  
  6282                                  ; now we've got to adjust the boot drive if we reassigned it
  6283                                  
  6284                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6285                                  		;mov	al, [cs:drvfat]
  6286 00001CAC A0[C016]                		mov	al, [drvfat]
  6287 00001CAF 3C02                    		cmp	al, 2		; is it	a: or b: ?
  6288 00001CB1 721D                    		jb	short rmap_exit
  6289                                  		;sub	al, [cs:dsktnum]
  6290 00001CB3 2A06[2501]              		sub	al, [dsktnum]	; is it one of the other floppies?
  6291 00001CB7 7204                    		jb	short remap_boot_flop ;	brif so
  6292                                  
  6293                                  ; we've got to remap the boot hard drive
  6294                                  ; subtract the number of EXTRA floppies from it
  6295                                  
  6296 00001CB9 0402                    		add	al, 2		; bootdrv -= (dsktnum-2)
  6297 00001CBB EB04                    		jmp	short remap_change_boot_drv
  6298                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6299                                  
  6300                                  ; we've got to remap the boot floppy.
  6301                                  ; add the number of hard drive partitions to it
  6302                                  
  6303                                  remap_boot_flop:
  6304                                  		;add	al, [cs:drvmax]	; bootdrv += (drvmax-dsktnum)
  6305                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6306 00001CBD 0206[7500]              		add	al, [drvmax]
  6307                                  remap_change_boot_drv:			
  6308                                  		;mov	[cs:drvfat], al ; alter msdos.sys load drive
  6309 00001CC1 A2[C016]                		mov	[drvfat], al
  6310 00001CC4 FEC0                    		inc	al
  6311 00001CC6 1E                      		push	ds
  6312 00001CC7 BF4504                  		mov	di, SYSINITSEG	; 46Dh
  6313                                  		;mov	di, 544h	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM
  6314                                  		;;mov	di, 46Dh	; SYSINIT segment
  6315 00001CCA 8EDF                    		mov	ds, di
  6316 00001CCC A2[9602]                		mov	[DEFAULTDRIVE], al
  6317                                  		;mov	ds:296h, al	; [SYSINIT+DEFAULT_DRIVE]
  6318                                  					; pass it to sysinit as	well
  6319 00001CCF 1F                      		pop	ds ; ds = cs
  6320                                  rmap_exit:
  6321 00001CD0 C3                      		retn

  6328                                  ; 02/06/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0 (MSDOS 3.3)

  6330                                  ;**************************************************
  6331                                  ; getboot - get the boot sector for a hard disk
  6332                                  ;
  6333                                  ; Reads the boot sector from a specified drive into
  6334                                  ; a buffer at the top of memory.
  6335                                  ;
  6336                                  ; dl = int13 drive number to read boot sector for
  6337                                  ;**************************************************
  6338                                  
  6339                                  ; 17/10/2022
  6340                                  bootbias equ 200h
  6341                                  
  6342                                  getboot:	; proc near
  6343                                  
  6344                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6345                                  		; ds = cs
  6346                                  
  6347                                  		; 08/04/2018
  6348                                  		; Retro DOS v2.0 (IBMBIO.COM, IBMDOS 2.1)
  6349                                  		; 28/03/2018 - MSDOS 6.0 - MSINIT.ASM, 1991
  6350                                  		; 02/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0
  6351                                  		;	      (disassembled IO.SYS code of MSDOS 5.0)
  6352                                  
  6353                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:init_bootseg] ; 17/10/2022
  6354                                  		; 15/12/2023
  6355 00001CD1 A1[CB16]                		mov	ax, [init_bootseg]
  6356 00001CD4 8EC0                    		mov	es, ax
  6357                                  
  6358                                  		; 17/10/2022
  6359 00001CD6 BB0002                  		mov	bx, bootbias ; 200h
  6360                                  		;mov	bx, 200h	; bootbias

  6362 00001CD9 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h

  6366                                  					; AL = number of sectors to read, CH = track, CL = sector
  6367                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill
  6368                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status,	AL = number of sectors read
  6369 00001CE3 7209                    		jb	short erret
  6370                                  		; 17/10/2022
  6371 00001CE5 26813EFE0355AA          		cmp	word [es:bootbias+1FEh], 0AA55h
  6372                                  		;cmp	word ptr es:3FEh, 0AA55h ; [es:bootbias+1FEh]
  6373                                  					; Dave Litton magic word?

  6376 00001CEE F9                      		stc

  6384                                  chk_partition_type:
  6385                                  		; 16/12/2023
  6386 00001CF0 268A07                  		mov	al, [es:bx]	; partition type
  6387                                  
  6388                                  		; see if partitiontype == 1, 4, 6
  6389 00001CF3 3C01                    		cmp	al, 1		; FAT12
  6390 00001CF5 7406                    		je	short chk_ptype_retn
  6391 00001CF7 3C04                    		cmp	al, 4		; FAT16 CHS (<= 32MB)
  6392 00001CF9 7402                    		je	short chk_ptype_retn
  6393 00001CFB 3C06                    		cmp	al, 6		; FAT16 BIG CHS (> 32MB)
  6394                                  chk_ptype_retn:
