  6401                                  ; 28/12/2018 - Retro DOS v4.0 
  6402                                  
  6403                                  ;***************************************************************************
  6404                                  ;   sethard - generate bpb for a variable sized hard file. ibm has a
  6405                                  ;   partitioned hard file; we must read physical sector 0 to determine where
  6406                                  ;   our own logical sectors start. we also read in our boot sector to
  6407                                  ;   determine version number
  6408                                  ;
  6409                                  ;   inputs:	dl is rom drive number (80...)
  6410                                  ;		bh is partition number (0....) 
  6411                                  ;		ds:di points to bds
  6412                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear -> bpb is filled in
  6413                                  ;		carry set   -> bpb is left uninitialized due to error
  6414                                  ;	trashes (at least) si, cx
  6415                                  ;	MUST PRESERVE ES:!!!!
  6416                                  ;***************************************************************************
  6417                                  
  6418                                  sethard:	; proc near
  6419                                  		; 16/12/2023
  6420                                  		; 14/08/2023
  6421                                  		; ds = cs = BIOSDATA
  6422 00001CFE 57                      		push	di
  6423 00001CFF 53                      		push	bx
  6424                                  		;push	ds  ; ds = cs = BIOSDATA ; 14/08/2023
  6425 00001D00 06                      		push	es
  6426 00001D01 885D05                  		mov	[di+5],	bl	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  6427 00001D04 885504                  		mov	[di+4],	dl	; [di+BDS.drivenum]
  6428 00001D07 804D2301                		or	byte [di+23h], 1 ; [di+BDS.flags]
  6429                                  					; fnon_removable
  6430 00001D0B C6452205                		mov	byte [di+22h], 5 ; [di+BDS.formfactor]
  6431                                  					; ffHardFile
  6432 00001D0F C606[C816]00            		mov	byte [fbigfat], 0 ; assume 12 bit FAT
  6433 00001D14 88FE                    		mov	dh, bh		; partition number
  6434 00001D16 52                      		push	dx
  6435 00001D17 B408                    		mov	ah, 8
  6436 00001D19 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - DISK -	GET CURRENT DRIVE PARAMETERS (XT,AT,XT286,CONV,PS)
  6437                                  					; DL = drive number
  6438                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status code, BL	= drive	type
  6439                                  					; DL = number of consecutive drives
  6440                                  					; DH = maximum value for head number, ES:DI -> drive parameter
  6441 00001D1B FEC6                    		inc	dh
  6442 00001D1D 887515                  		mov	[di+15h], dh	; [di+BDS.heads] ; get number of heads
  6443 00001D20 5A                      		pop	dx
  6444 00001D21 7249                    		jb	short setret	; error	if no hard disk
  6445 00001D23 80E13F                  		and	cl, 3Fh
  6446 00001D26 884D13                  		mov	[di+13h], cl	; [di+BDS.secpertrack]
  6447 00001D29 52                      		push	dx		; save partition number
  6448 00001D2A E8A4FF                  		call	getboot
  6449 00001D2D 5A                      		pop	dx		; restore partition number
  6450 00001D2E 723C                    		jb	short setret
  6451 00001D30 BBC203                  		mov	bx, 3C2h	; 1C2h+bootbias
  6452                                  
  6453                                  ; The first 'active' partition is 00, the second is 01....
  6454                                  ;   then the remainder of the 'primary' but non-active partitions
  6455                                  
  6456                                  act_part:
  6457 00001D33 26F647FC80              		test	byte [es:bx-4], 80h ; is the partition active?
  6458 00001D38 740B                    		jz	short no_act	; no
  6459                                  ; 16/12/2023
  6460                                  %if 0
  6461                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 1 ; reject if partitiontype != 1, 4 or 6
  6462                                  		jz	short got_good_act
  6463                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 4
  6464                                  		jz	short got_good_act
  6465                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 6
  6466                                  		jnz	short no_act
  6467                                  %endif
  6468                                  		; 16/12/2023 - Retro DOS v4.1 (Modified MSDOS 5.0)
  6469                                  		; check if it is a primary dos partition
  6470                                  
  6471 00001D3A E8B3FF                  		call	chk_partition_type
  6472 00001D3D 7506                    		jne	short no_act
  6473                                  
  6474                                  got_good_act:
  6475 00001D3F 08F6                    		or	dh, dh		; is this our target partition #?
  6476 00001D41 742D                    		jz	short set2	; WE GOT THE ONE WANTED!!
  6477 00001D43 FECE                    		dec	dh		; count	down
  6478                                  no_act:
  6479 00001D45 83C310                  		add	bx, 16
  6480 00001D48 81FB0204                		cmp	bx, 402h	; 202h+bootbias
  6481                                  					; last entry done?
  6482 00001D4C 75E5                    		jnz	short act_part	; no, process next entry
  6483 00001D4E BBC203                  		mov	bx, 3C2h	; 1C2h+bootbias
  6484                                  					; restore original value of bx
  6485                                  
  6486                                  ; Now scan the non-active partitions
  6487                                  
  6488                                  get_primary:				
  6489 00001D51 26F647FC80              		test	byte [es:bx-4], 80h
  6490 00001D56 750B                    		jnz	short not_prim	; we've already scanned
  6491                                  					; the ACTIVE ones
  6492                                  ; 16/12/2023
  6493                                  %if 0
  6494                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 1 ; see if partitiontype == 1, 4 or 6
  6495                                  		jz	short got_prim
  6496                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 4
  6497                                  		jz	short got_prim
  6498                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 6
  6499                                  		jnz	short not_prim
  6500                                  %endif
  6501                                  		; 16/12/2023 - Retro DOS v4.1 (Modified MSDOS 5.0)
  6502                                  		; check if it is a primary dos partition
  6503                                  
  6504 00001D58 E895FF                  		call	chk_partition_type
  6505 00001D5B 7506                    		jne	short not_prim
  6506                                  
  6507                                  got_prim:
  6508 00001D5D 08F6                    		or	dh, dh		; is this our target partition?
  6509 00001D5F 740F                    		jz	short set2
  6510 00001D61 FECE                    		dec	dh
  6511                                  not_prim:
  6512 00001D63 83C310                  		add	bx, 16
  6513 00001D66 81FB0204                		cmp	bx, 402h	; 202h+bootbias
  6514 00001D6A 75E5                    		jnz	short get_primary ; loop till we've gone through table
  6515                                  setret:					
  6516 00001D6C F9                      		stc			; error	return
  6517 00001D6D E98502                  		jmp	ret_hard_err
  6518                                  
  6519                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6520                                  
  6521                                  ;  until we get the real logical boot record and get the bpb,
  6522                                  ;  BDS_BPB.BPB_BIGTOTALSECTORS will be used instead of BDS_BPB.BPB_TOTALSECTORS
  6523                                  ;  for the convenience of the computation.
  6524                                  ;
  6525                                  ;  at the end of this procedure, if a bpb information is gotten from
  6526                                  ;  the valid boot record, then we are going to use those bpb information
  6527                                  ;  without change.
  6528                                  ;
  6529                                  ;  otherwise, if (hidden sectors + total sectors) <= a word, then we will move
  6530                                  ;  BDS_BPB.BPB_BIGTOTALSECTORS (low) to BDS_BPB.BPB_TOTALSECTORS and zero out
  6531                                  ;  BDS_BPB.BPB_BIGTOTALSECTORS entry to make it a conventional bpb format.
  6532                                  
  6533                                  set2:
  6534                                  		; 14/08/2023
  6535                                  		; ds = cs = BIOSDATA segment (0070h)
  6536 00001D70 8816[CD16]              		mov	[rom_drv_num], dl

  7267 00001FA5 29D0                    		sub	ax, dx

  7270 00001FAB 83E801                  		sub	ax, 1

  7275                                  					; bx = 256 * BDS.secperclus + 2
  7276                                  
  7277                                  ; I don't understand why to add bx here!!!
  7278                                  
  7279                                  		; 29/12/2018 - Erdogan Tan (Retro DOS v4.0)
  7280                                  		; 27/09/2022
  7281                                  		; (Microsoft FAT32 File	System Specification,
  7282                                  		; December 2000, Page 21)
  7283                                  		; TmpVal1 = DskSize - (BPB_ResvdSecCnt+RootrDirSectors)
  7284                                  		; TmpVal2 = (256*BPB_SecPerClus)+BPB_NumFATs
  7285                                  		; FATsz	= (TmpVal1+(TmpVal2-1))/TmpVal2
  7286                                  		; (If FATType == FAT16,	BPB_FATSz16 = LOWORD(FATSz))
  7287                                  		
  7288                                  					; dx:ax = TmpVal1, bx = TmpVal2
  7289 00001FB6 01D8                    		add	ax, bx		; 
  7290 00001FB8 83D200                  		adc	dx, 0		; dx:ax = TmpVal1+TmpVal2
  7291 00001FBB 83E801                  		sub	ax, 1		
  7292 00001FBE 83DA00                  		sbb	dx, 0		; dx:ax = TmpVal1+TmpVal2-1
  7293                                  
  7294                                  ; assuming dx in the table will never be bigger than bx.
  7295                                  
  7296 00001FC1 F7F3                    		div	bx		; BDS.fatsecs =
  7297                                  					; ceil((total-dir-res)/(256*BDS.secperclus+2))
  7298 00001FC3 894511                  		mov	[di+11h], ax	; [di+BDS.fatsecs]
  7299                                  					; number of fat	sectors

  7700                                  ; domini **********************************************************************
  7701                                  ;
  7702                                  ;mini disk initialization routine. called right after dohard
  7703                                  ;modified for >2 hardfile support
  7704                                  ;
  7705                                  ; **cs=ds=es=datagrp
  7706                                  ;
  7707                                  ; **domini will search for every extended partition in the system, and
  7708                                  ;   initialize it.
  7709                                  ;
  7710                                  ; **bdsm stands for bds table for mini disk and located right after the label
  7711                                  ;   end96tpi. end_of_bdsm will have the offset value of the ending
  7712                                  ;   address of bdsm table.
  7713                                  ;
  7714                                  ; **bdsm is the same as usual bds structure except that tim_lo, tim_hi entries
  7715                                  ;   are overlapped and used to identify mini disk and the number of hidden_trks.
  7716                                  ;   right now, they are called as ismini, hidden_trks respectively.
  7717                                  ;
  7718                                  ; **domini will use the same routine in sethard routine after label set2 to
  7719                                  ;   save coding.
  7720                                  ;
  7721                                  ; **drvmax determined in dohard routine will be used for the next
  7722                                  ;   available logical mini disk drive number.
  7723                                  ;
  7724                                  ; input: drvmax, dskdrvs
  7725                                  ;
  7726                                  ; output: minidisk installed. bdsm table established and installed to bds.
  7727                                  ;	  end_of_bdsm - ending offset address of bdsm.
  7728                                  ;
  7729                                  ; called modules:

  8010                                  cmos_clock_read:	
  8011 0000222C 50                      		push	ax
  8012 0000222D 51                      		push	cx
  8013 0000222E 52                      		push	dx
  8014 0000222F 55                      		push	bp
  8015 00002230 31ED                    		xor	bp, bp
  8016                                  loop_clock:
  8017 00002232 31C9                    		xor	cx, cx
  8018 00002234 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
  8019 00002236 B402                    		mov	ah, 2
  8020 00002238 CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- READ REAL TIME CLOCK (AT,XT286,CONV,PS)
  8021                                  					; Return: CH = hours in	BCD
  8022                                  					; CL = minutes in BCD
  8023                                  					; DH = seconds in BCD
  8024 0000223A 83F900                  		cmp	cx, 0
  8025 0000223D 7512                    		jnz	short clock_present
  8026 0000223F 83FA00                  		cmp	dx, 0
  8027 00002242 750D                    		jnz	short clock_present
  8028 00002244 83FD01                  		cmp	bp, 1		; read again after a slight delay, in case clock
  8029 00002247 741B                    		jz	short no_readdate ; was	at zero	setting.
  8030 00002249 45                      		inc	bp		; only perform delay once.
  8031 0000224A B90040                  		mov	cx, 4000h	; 16384
  8032                                  delay:
  8033 0000224D E2FE                    		loop	delay
  8034 0000224F EBE1                    		jmp	short loop_clock
  8035                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8036                                  
  8037                                  clock_present:
  8038                                  		;mov	byte [cs:havecmosclock], 1 ; set the flag for cmos clock
  8039                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8040                                  		; ds = cs
  8041 00002251 C606[EC04]01            		mov	byte [havecmosclock], 1 ; set the flag for cmos clock
  8042                                  
  8043 00002256 E81000                  		call	cmosck		; reset	cmos clock rate	that may be
  8044                                  					; possibly destroyed by	cp dos and
  8045                                  					; post routine did not restore that.
  8046 00002259 56                      		push	si
  8047 0000225A E8C2F2                  		call	read_real_date	; read real-time clock for date
  8048 0000225D FA                      		cli
  8049                                  		;mov	ds:daycnt, si	; set system date
  8050 0000225E 8936[E904]              		mov	[daycnt], si
  8051 00002262 FB                      		sti

  8059 00002268 C3                      		retn

  8061                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8062                                  
  8063                                  ; the following code is written by jack gulley in engineering group.
  8064                                  ; cp dos (CP/DOS, OS/2) is changing cmos clock rate for its own purposes
  8065                                  ; and if the use cold boot the system to use pc dos while running cp dos,
  8066                                  ; the cmos clock rate are still slow which slow down disk operations
  8067                                  ; of pc dos which uses cmos clock. pc dos is put this code in msinit
  8068                                  ; to fix this problem at the request of cp dos.
  8069                                  ;
  8070                                  ; the program is modified to be run on msinit. equates are defined
  8071                                  ; in cmosequ.inc. this program will be called by cmos_clock_read procedure.
  8072                                  ;
  8073                                  ;  the following code cmosck is used to insure that the cmos has not
  8074                                  ;	had its rate controls left in an invalid state on older at's.
  8075                                  ;
  8076                                  ;	it checks for an at model byte "fc" with a submodel type of
  8077                                  ;	00, 01, 02, 03 or 06 and resets the periodic interrupt rate
  8078                                  ;	bits in case post has not done it. this initialization routine
  8079                                  ;	is only needed once when dos loads. it should be run as soon
  8080                                  ;	as possible to prevent slow diskette access.
  8081                                  ;
  8082                                  ;	this code exposes one to dos clearing cmos setup done by a
  8083                                  ;	resident program that hides and re-boots the system.
  8084                                  
  8085                                  cmosck:					; check and reset rtc rate bits
  8086                                  
  8087                                  ;model byte and submodel byte were already determined in msinit.
  8088                                  
  8089                                  	; 16/06/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
  8090                                  	; 19/03/2018 (Model: 0FCh, Sub Model: 01h, REF: AMIBIOS Prog. Guide)
  8091                                  
  8092                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8093                                  		; ds = cs
  8094                                  		;push	ax ; not necessary ; 19/12/2023
  8095                                  		;
  8096 00002269 803E[3506]FC            		cmp	byte [model_byte], 0FCh
  8097                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:model_byte], 0FCh
  8098 0000226E 75F8                    		jnz	short cmosck9	; Exit if not an AT model
  8099 00002270 803E[3606]06            		cmp	byte [secondary_model_byte], 6 ; 21/04/2024
  8100                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:secondary_model_byte], 6
  8101                                  					; Is it 06 for the industral AT ?
  8102 00002275 7407                    		jz	short cmosck4	; Go reset CMOS periodic rate if 06
  8103 00002277 803E[3606]04            		cmp	byte [secondary_model_byte], 4
  8104                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:secondary_model_byte], 4
  8105                                  					; Is it 00, 01, 02, or 03 ?
  8106 0000227C 73EA                    		jnb	short cmosck9	; EXIT if problem fixed by POST
  8107                                  					; Also,Secondary_model_byte = 0
  8108                                  					;   when AH=0C0h, int 15h failed.
  8109                                  					;	RESET THE CMOS PERIODIC RATE
  8110                                  					;  Model=FC submodel=00,01,02,03 or 06
  8111                                  cmosck4:
  8112 0000227E B08A                    		mov	al, 8Ah		; cmos_reg_a|nmi
  8113                                  					; NMI disabled on return
  8114 00002280 B426                    		mov	ah, 26h		; 00100110b
  8115                                  					; Set divider & rate selection
  8116 00002282 E80B00                  		call	cmos_write
  8117 00002285 B08B                    		mov	al, 8Bh		; cmos_reg_b|nmi
  8118                                  					; NMI disabled on return
  8119 00002287 E82000                  		call	cmos_read
  8120 0000228A 2407                    		and	al, 7		; 00000111b
  8121                                  					; clear SET,PIE,AIE,UIE,SQWE
  8122 0000228C 88C4                    		mov	ah, al
  8123 0000228E B00B                    		mov	al, 0Bh		; cmos_reg_b
  8124                                  					; NMI enabled on return
  8125                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8126                                  		;call	cmos_write
  8127                                  ;cmosck9:
  8128                                  		;pop	ax ; 19/12/2023
  8129                                  		;retn
  8130                                  
  8131                                  		; 19/12/2023
  8132                                  		;jmp	short cmos_write
  8133                                  
  8134                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8135                                  
  8136                                  ;--- cmos_write ----------------------------------------------------------------
  8137                                  ;		write byte to cmos system clock configuration table	       :
  8138                                  ;									       :
  8139                                  ; input: (al)=	cmos table address to be written to			       :
  8140                                  ;		bit    7 = 0 for nmi enabled and 1 for nmi disabled on exit    :
  8141                                  ;		bits 6-0 = address of table location to write		       :
  8142                                  ;	 (ah)=	new value to be placed in the addressed table location	       :
  8143                                  ;									       :
  8144                                  ; output:	value in (ah) placed in location (al) with nmi left disabled   :
  8145                                  ;		if bit 7 of (al) is on. during the cmos update both nmi and    :
  8146                                  ;		normal interrupts are disabled to protect cmos data integrity. :
  8147                                  ;		the cmos address register is pointed to a default value and    :
  8148                                  ;		the interrupt flag restored to the entry state on return.      :
  8149                                  ;		only the cmos location and the nmi state is changed.	       :

  8153 00002290 9C                      		pushf			;

  8159                                  					; RTC Seconds

  8167                                  					; RTC Seconds

  8170 000022A7 58                      		pop	ax		; restore work registers

  8178                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8179                                  
  8180                                  ;--- CMOS_READ -----------------------------------------------------------------
  8181                                  ;		read byte from cmos system clock configuration table	       :
  8182                                  ;									       :
  8183                                  ; input: (al)=	cmos table address to be read				       :
  8184                                  ;		bit    7 = 0 for nmi enabled and 1 for nmi disabled on exit    :
  8185                                  ;		bits 6-0 = address of table location to read		       :
  8186                                  ;									       :
  8187                                  ; output: (al)	value at location (al) moved into (al). if bit 7 of (al) was   :
  8188                                  ;		on then nmi left disabled. during the cmos read both nmi and  :
  8189                                  ;		normal interrupts are disabled to protect cmos data integrity. :
  8190                                  ;		the cmos address register is pointed to a default value and    :
  8191                                  ;		the interrupt flag restored to the entry state on return.      :
  8192                                  ;		only the (al) register and the nmi state is changed.	       :
  8193                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8194                                  
  8195                                  cmos_read:				; read location (al) into (al)
  8196 000022AA 9C                      		pushf
  8197 000022AB FA                      		cli

  8200                                  		; 19/12/2023

  8202 000022AF 0C80                    		or	al, 80h
  8203 000022B1 E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  8204                                  					; RTC Seconds
  8205 000022B3 90                      		nop			; (undocumented delay needed)
  8206 000022B4 E471                    		in	al, 71h		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  8207

  8209                                  		;pop	ax ; * ; input

  8214                                  		; bl = output, al = input
  8215                                  
  8216 000022B7 2480                    		and	al, 80h
  8217 000022B9 0C0F                    		or	al, 0Fh

  8222                                  		;mov	ax, bx ; * ; output

  8430                                  ;function: find and read the corresponding fat sector into ds:0
  8431                                  ;
  8432                                  ;in). dx:si - offset value (starting from fat entry 0) of fat entry to find. M054
  8433                                  ;     ds - fatloc segment
  8434                                  ;     cs:drvfat - logical drive number, fat id

  8438                                  ;out). corresponding fat sector read in.
  8439                                  ;      bx = offset value from fatlog segment.
  8440                                  ;      other registera saved.
  8441                                  ;      zero flag set if the fat entry is splitted, i.e., when 12 bit fat entry
  8442                                  ;      starts at the last byte of the fat sector. in this case, the caller
  8443                                  ;      should save this byte, and read the next fat sector to get the rest
  8444                                  ;      of the fat entry value. (this will only happen with the 12 bit fat.)

  8692 00000072 268B5714                		mov	dx, [es:bx+20]	; [es:bx+start]	; dx = start sector
  8693                                  		; 17/10/2022
  8694 00000076 81FE[9104]              		cmp	si, DSKTBL
  8695                                  		;cmp	si, 4A2h	; dsktbl
  8696                                  					; at 2C7h:4A2h = 70h:2A12h
  8697 0000007A 7517                    		jnz	short no_sector32_mapping
  8698                                  
  8699                                  ; Special case for 32-bit start sector number:
  8700                                  ;   if (si==dsktbl) /* if this is a disk device call */
  8701                                  ;      set high 16 bits of secnum to 0
  8702                                  ;      if (secnum == 0xffff) fetch 32 bit sector number
  8703                                  ;
  8704                                  ; pass high word of sector number in start_sec_h, low word in dx
  8705                                  ;
  8706                                  ; note: start_l and start_h are the offsets within the io_request packet
  8707                                  ;	  which contain the low and hi words of the 32 bit start sector if
  8708                                  ;	  it has been used.
  8709                                  ;
  8710                                  ; note: remember not to destroy the registers which have been set up before
  8711                                  
  8712                                  		;mov	ds:start_sec_h,	0 ; initialize to 0
  8713 0000007C C706[2405]0000          		mov	word [start_sec_h], 0
  8714 00000082 83FAFF                  		cmp	dx, 0FFFFh
  8715 00000085 750C                    		jnz	short no_sector32_mapping

  8717                                  					; 32 bits dsk req

  8721                                  					; dx = packet.start_l
  8722                                  no_sector32_mapping:			
  8723 00000093 97                      		xchg	ax, di

  8764                                  command_error:				
  8765 000000C9 E80900                  		call	bc_cmderr
  8766 000000CC EBE2                    		jmp	short already_got_ah_status
  8767                                  ; 15/10/2022
  8768                                  ; 01/05/2019
  8769                                  
  8770                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8771                                  ; The following piece of hack is for supporting CP/M compatibility
  8772                                  ; Basically at offset 5 we have a far call into 0:c0. But this does not call
  8773                                  ; 0:c0 directly instead it call f01d:fef0, because it needs to support 'lhld 6'
  8774                                  ; The following hack has to reside at ffff:d0 (= f01d:fef0) if BIOS is loaded
  8775                                  ; high.
  8776                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8777                                  
  8778                                  		;db 7 dup(0)
  8779                                  
  8780                                  		; 15/10/2022
  8781                                  
  8782 000000CE 0000                    		dw 0		; pad to bring offset to 0D0h
  8783                                  
  8784 000000D0 00<rep 5h>              off_d0: 	times 5 db 0	; 5 bytes from 0:c0 will be copied onto here
  8785                                  				;  which is the CP/M call 5 entry point

  8787

  8794                                  					; unknown command error
  8795                                  
  8796                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8797                                  
  8798                                  ;	now zero the count field by subtracting its current value,
  8799                                  ;	  which is still in cx, from itself.
  8800                                  
  8801                                  ;	subtract the number of i/o's NOT YET COMPLETED from total
  8802                                  ;	  in order to return the number actually complete

  8809                                  					; # of successful i/o's

  8832                                  ;************************************************************************
  8833                                  ;*									*
  8834                                  ;*	device driver dispatch tables					*
  8835                                  ;*									*
  8836                                  ;*	each table starts with a byte which lists the number of		*
  8837                                  ;*	legal functions, followed by that number of words. Each		*
  8838                                  ;*	word represents an offset of a routine in Bios_Code which	*
  8839                                  ;*	handles the function. The functions are terminated with		*
  8840                                  ;*	a near return. If carry is reset, a 'done' code is returned	*
  8841                                  ;*	to the caller. If carry is set, the ah/al registers are		*
  8842                                  ;*	returned as abnormal completion status. Notice that ds		*
  8843                                  ;*	is assumed to point to the Bios_Data segment throughout.	*
  8844                                  ;*									*
  8845                                  ;************************************************************************
  8846                                  
  8847                                  		; 13/12/2022

  8854                                  					; 00 init

  8949                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8950                                  
  8951                                  ;************************************************************************
  8952                                  ;*									*
  8953                                  ;*	chrin - input single char from keyboard into al			*
  8954                                  ;*									*
  8955                                  ;*	  we are going to issue extended keyboard function, if		*
  8956                                  ;*	  supported. the returning value of the extended keystroke	*
  8957                                  ;*	  of the extended keyboard function uses 0E0h in al		*
  8958                                  ;*	  instead of 00h as in the conventional keyboard function.	*
  8959                                  ;*	  this creates a conflict when the user entered real		*
  8960                                  ;*	  greek alpha charater (= 0E0h) to  distinguish the extended	*
  8961                                  ;*	  keystroke and the greek alpha. this case will be handled	*
  8962                                  ;*	  in the following manner:					*
  8963                                  ;*									*
  8964                                  ;*	      ah = 16h							*
  8965                                  ;*	      int 16h							*
  8966                                  ;*	      if al == 0, then extended code (in ah)			*
  8967                                  ;*	      else if al == 0E0h, then					*
  8968                                  ;*	      if ah <> 0, then extended code (in ah)			*
  8969                                  ;*		else greek_alpha character.				*
  8970                                  ;*									*
  8971                                  ;*	also, for compatibility reason, if an extended code is		*
  8972                                  ;*	  detected, then we are going to change the value in al		*
  8973                                  ;*	  from 0E0h to 00h.						*
  8974                                  ;*									*
  8975                                  ;************************************************************************
  8976                                  
  8977                                  		; 19/10/2022
  8978                                  chrin:

  8980 00000169 30C0                    		xor	al, al

  9025                                  ;************************************************************************
  9026                                  ;*									*
  9027                                  ;*	con_rdnd - keyboard non destructive read, no wait		*
  9028                                  ;*									*
  9029                                  ;*	pc-convertible-type machine: if bit 10 is set by the dos	*
  9030                                  ;*	in the status word of the request packet, and there is no	*
  9031                                  ;*	character in the input buffer, the driver issues a system	*
  9032                                  ;*	wait request to the rom. on return from the rom, it returns	*
  9033                                  ;*	a 'char-not-found' to the dos.					*

  9055                                  					; AL = condition type, BH = condition compare or mask value
  9056                                  					; BL = timeout value times 55 milliseconds, 00h	means no timeout
  9057                                  					; DX = I/O port	address	if AL bit 4 set

  9252                                  ;************************************************************************
  9253                                  ;*									*
  9254                                  ;*	prnstat - utility function to call ROM BIOS to check		*
  9255                                  ;*		 printer status. Return meaningful error code		*
  9256                                  ;*									*
  9257                                  ;************************************************************************
  9258                                  
  9259                                  prnstat:				
  9260 0000025B B402                    		mov	ah, 2		; set command for get status
  9261                                  					; PRINTER - GET	STATUS
  9262                                  					; DX = printer port (0-3)
  9263                                  					; Return: AH = status
  9264                                  
  9265                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  9266                                  
  9267                                  ;************************************************************************
  9268                                  ;*									*
  9269                                  ;*	prnop - call ROM BIOS printer function in ah			*
  9270                                  ;*		return zero true if no error				*
  9271                                  ;*		return zero false if error, al = error code		*
  9272                                  ;*									*
  9273                                  ;************************************************************************
  9274                                  
  9275                                  prnop:	
  9276 0000025D 8B16[2100]              		mov	dx, [auxnum]	; get printer number
  9277 00000261 CD17                    		int	17h
  9278                                  
  9279                                  	; This check was added to see if this is a case of no
  9280                                  	; printer being installed. This tests checks to be sure
  9281                                  	; the error is noprinter (30h)
  9282                                  
  9283 00000263 50                      		push	ax
  9284 00000264 80E430                  		and	ah, 30h
  9285 00000267 80FC30                  		cmp	ah, 30h		; noprinter
  9286 0000026A 58                      		pop	ax
  9287 0000026B 7506                    		jnz	short NextTest
  9288 0000026D 80E4DF                  		and	ah, 0DFh	; ~nopaperstatus
  9289 00000270 80CC08                  		or	ah, 8		; ioerrstatus
  9290                                  
  9291                                  ; examine the status bits to see if an error occurred. unfortunately, several
  9292                                  ; of the bits are set so we have to pick and choose. we must be extremely
  9293                                  ; careful about breaking basic.
  9294                                  
  9295                                  NextTest:				
  9296 00000273 F6C428                  		test	ah, 28h		; (ioerrstatus+nopaperstatus)
  9297                                  					; i/o error?
  9298 00000276 740A                    		jz	short checknotready ; no, try not ready
  9299                                  
  9300                                  ; at this point, we know we have an error. the converse is not true
  9301                                  
  9302 00000278 B009                    		mov	al, 9		; error_I24_out_of_paper
  9303                                  					; first, assume	out of paper
  9304 0000027A F6C420                  		test	ah, 20h		; out of paper set?
  9305 0000027D 7502                    		jnz	short ret1	; yes, error is	set
  9306 0000027F FEC0                    		inc	al		; return al=10 (i/o error)
  9307                                  ret1:					
  9308 00000281 C3                      		retn
  9309                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9310                                  
  9311                                  checknotready:				
  9312 00000282 B002                    		mov	al, 2		; assume not-ready
  9313 00000284 F6C401                  		test	ah, 1
  9314 00000287 C3                      		retn

  9704                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------
  9705                                  ;								:
  9706                                  ;		    clock device driver 			:
  9707                                  ;								:
  9708                                  ;								:
  9709                                  ;   this file contains the clock device driver. 		:
  9710                                  ;								:
  9711                                  ;   the routines in this files are:				:
  9712                                  ;								:
  9713                                  ;	routine 		function			:
  9714                                  ;	------- 		--------			:
  9715                                  ;	tim_writ		set the current time		:
  9716                                  ;	tim_read		read the current time		:
  9717                                  ;	time_to_ticks		convert time to corresponding	:
  9718                                  ;				  number of clock ticks 	:
  9719                                  ;								:
  9720                                  ; the clock ticks at the rate of:				:
  9721                                  ;								:
  9722                                  ;	1193180/65536 ticks/second (about 18.2 ticks per second):
  9723                                  ; see each routine for information on the use.			:
  9724                                  ;								:
  9725                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------
  9726                                  
  9727                                  ; convert time to ticks
  9728                                  ; input : time in cx and dx
  9729                                  ; ticks returned in cx:dx
  9730                                  
  9731                                  ;19/07/2019
  9732                                  ;09/03/2019
  9733                                  
  9734                                  time_to_ticks:				; 0070h:2906h =	02C7h:0396h
  9735                                  
  9736                                  ; first convert from hour,min,sec,hund. to
  9737                                  ; total number of 100th of seconds
  9738                                  
  9739 0000038B B03C                    		mov	al, 60
  9740 0000038D F6E5                    		mul	ch		; hours	to minutes
  9741 0000038F B500                    		mov	ch, 0
  9742 00000391 01C8                    		add	ax, cx		; total	minutes
  9743 00000393 B97017                  		mov	cx, 6000	; 60*100
  9744 00000396 89D3                    		mov	bx, dx		; get out of the way of	the multiply
  9745 00000398 F7E1                    		mul	cx		; convert to 1/100 sec
  9746 0000039A 89C1                    		mov	cx, ax
  9747 0000039C B064                    		mov	al, 100
  9748 0000039E F6E7                    		mul	bh		; convert seconds to 1/100 sec
  9749 000003A0 01C1                    		add	cx, ax		; combine seconds with hours and min
  9750 000003A2 83D200                  		adc	dx, 0		; ripple carry
  9751 000003A5 B700                    		mov	bh, 0
  9752 000003A7 01D9                    		add	cx, bx		; combine 1/100	sec
  9753 000003A9 83D200                  		adc	dx, 0
  9754                                  
  9755                                  	; dx:cx is time in 1/100 sec
  9756                                  
  9757 000003AC 92                      		xchg	ax, dx
  9758 000003AD 91                      		xchg	ax, cx		; now time is in cx:ax
  9759 000003AE BB0BE9                  		mov	bx, 59659
  9760 000003B1 F7E3                    		mul	bx		; multiply low half
  9761 000003B3 87D1                    		xchg	dx, cx
  9762 000003B5 92                      		xchg	ax, dx		; cx->ax, ax->dx, dx->cx
  9763 000003B6 F7E3                    		mul	bx		; multiply high	half
  9764 000003B8 01C8                    		add	ax, cx		; combine overlapping products
  9765 000003BA 83D200                  		adc	dx, 0
  9766 000003BD 92                      		xchg	ax, dx		; ax:dx=time*59659
  9767 000003BE BB0500                  		mov	bx, 5
  9768 000003C1 F6F3                    		div	bl		; divide high half by 5
  9769 000003C3 88C1                    		mov	cl, al
  9770 000003C5 B500                    		mov	ch, 0
  9771 000003C7 88E0                    		mov	al, ah		; remainder of divide-by-5
  9772 000003C9 98                      		cbw
  9773 000003CA 92                      		xchg	ax, dx		; use it to extend low half
  9774 000003CB F7F3                    		div	bx		; divide low half by 5
  9775 000003CD 89C2                    		mov	dx, ax		; cx:dx	is now number of ticks in time
  9776 000003CF CB                      		retf			; far return
  9777

  9779                                  
  9780                                  ; 17/10/2022
  9781                                  ; 15/10/2022
  9782                                  
  9783                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------
  9784                                  ;
  9785                                  ; tim_writ sets the current time
  9786                                  ;
  9787                                  ; on entry es:[di] has the current time:
  9788                                  ;
  9789                                  ;	number of days since 1-1-80	(word)
  9790                                  ;	minutes (0-59)			(byte)
  9791                                  ;	hours (0-23)			(byte)
  9792                                  ;	hundredths of seconds (0-99)	(byte)
  9793                                  ;	seconds (0-59)			(byte)
  9794                                  ;
  9795                                  ; each number has been checked for the correct range.
  9796                                  ;
  9797                                  ;	NOTE: Any changes in this routine probably require corresponding
  9798                                  ;	changes in the version that is built with the power manager driver.
  9799                                  ;	See ptime.asm.
  9800                                  ;
  9801                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------
  9802                                  
  9803                                  tim_writ:				; 2C7h:3DBh = 70h:294Bh
  9804 000003D0 268B05                  		mov	ax, [es:di]
  9805 000003D3 50                      		push	ax		; daycnt. we need to set this at the very
  9806                                  					; end to avoid tick windows.
  9807 000003D4 803E[EC04]00            		cmp	byte [havecmosclock], 0
  9808                                  		;cmp	ds:havecmosclock, 0
  9809 000003D9 7426                    		jz	short no_cmos_1
  9810 000003DB 268A4503                		mov	al, [es:di+3]	; near indirect	calls
  9811                                  					; get binary hours
  9812                                  					; convert to bcd
  9813 000003DF FF1E[FB04]              		call	far [bintobcd]
  9814                                  		;call	ds:bintobcd	; call far [bintobcd]
  9815 000003E3 88C5                    		mov	ch, al		; ch = bcd hours
  9816 000003E5 268A4502                		mov	al, [es:di+2]	; get binary minutes
  9817 000003E9 FF1E[FB04]              		call	far [bintobcd]
  9818                                  		;call	ds:bintobcd	; convert to bcd
  9819 000003ED 88C1                    		mov	cl, al		; cl = bcd minutes
  9820 000003EF 268A4505                		mov	al, [es:di+5]	; get binary seconds
  9821 000003F3 FF1E[FB04]              		call	far [bintobcd]
  9822                                  		;call	ds:bintobcd
  9823 000003F7 88C6                    		mov	dh, al		; dh = bcd seconds
  9824 000003F9 B200                    		mov	dl, 0		; dl = 0 (st) or 1 (dst)
  9825 000003FB FA                      		cli
  9826 000003FC B403                    		mov	ah, 3
  9827 000003FE CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- SET REAL TIME	CLOCK (AT,XT286,CONV,PS)
  9828                                  					; CH = hours in	BCD, CL	= minutes in BCD
  9829                                  					;  DH =	seconds	in BCD,DL = 01h	if daylight savings, 00h if standard time
  9830                                  					; Return: CMOS clock set
  9831 00000400 FB                      		sti
  9832                                  no_cmos_1:
  9833 00000401 268B4D02                		mov	cx, [es:di+2]
  9834 00000405 268B5504                		mov	dx, [es:di+4]
  9835                                  		; 17/10/2022
  9836 00000409 FF1E[D906]              		call	far [ttticks]
  9837                                  		;call	dword ptr ds:ttticks ; call far	[ttticks]
  9838                                  					; convert time to ticks
  9839                                  					; cx:dx	now has	time in	ticks
  9840 0000040D FA                      		cli			; turn off timer
  9841 0000040E B401                    		mov	ah, 1
  9842 00000410 CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- SET TIME OF DAY
  9843                                  					; CX:DX	= clock	count
  9844                                  					; Return: time of day set
  9845                                  		;pop	ds:daycnt
  9846 00000412 8F06[E904]              		pop	word [daycnt]
  9847 00000416 FB                      		sti
  9848                                  		;cmp	ds:havecmosclock, 0
  9849 00000417 803E[EC04]00            		cmp	byte [havecmosclock], 0
  9850 0000041C 740A                    		jz	short no_cmos_2
  9851 0000041E FF1E[FF04]              		call	far [daycnttoday]
  9852                                  		;call	ds:daycnttoday	; call far [daycnttoday]
  9853                                  					; convert to bcd format
  9854 00000422 FA                      		cli
  9855 00000423 B405                    		mov	ah, 5
  9856 00000425 CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- SET DATE IN REAL TIME	CLOCK (AT,XT286,CONV,PS)
  9857                                  					; DL = day in BCD, DH =	month in BCD, CL = year	in BCD
  9858                                  					; CH = century (19h or 20h)
  9859                                  					; Return: CMOS clock set
  9860 00000427 FB                      		sti
  9861                                  no_cmos_2:
  9862                                  		; 12/12/2022
  9863                                  		; cf=0
  9864                                  		;clc
  9865 00000428 C3                      		retn
  9866                                  
  9867                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9868                                  
  9869                                  ; 15/10/2022
  9870                                  
  9871                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9872                                  ; gettime reads date and time
  9873                                  ; and returns the following information:
  9874                                  ;
  9875                                  ;	es:[di]  =count of days since 1-1-80
  9876                                  ;	es:[di+2]=hours
  9877                                  ;	es:[di+3]=minutes
  9878                                  ;	es:[di+4]=seconds
  9879                                  ;	es:[di+5]=hundredths of seconds
  9880                                  ;
  9881                                  ;	NOTE: Any changes in this routine probably require corresponding
  9882                                  ;	changes in the version that is built with the power manager driver.
  9883                                  ;	See ptime.asm.
  9884                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9885                                  
  9886                                  		; 08/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
  9887                                  		; 20/12/2023 - Retro DOS v5.0 (& Retro DOS v4.1 optimization)
  9888                                  		; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:04EFh)
  9889                                  
  9890                                  tim_read:				; 2C7h:435h = 70h:29A5h
  9891 00000429 E84A00                  		call	GetTickCnt
  9892 0000042C 8B36[E904]              		mov	si, [daycnt]
  9893                                  
  9894                                  ; we now need to convert the time in tick to the time in 100th of
  9895                                  ; seconds. the relation between tick and seconds is:
  9896                                  ;
  9897                                  ;		 65,536 seconds
  9898                                  ;	       ----------------
  9899                                  ;		1,193,180 tick
  9900                                  ;
  9901                                  ; to get to 100th of second we need to multiply by 100. the equation is:
  9902                                  ;
  9903                                  ;	ticks from clock  * 65,536 * 100
  9904                                  ;      --------------------------------- = time in 100th of seconds
  9905                                  ;		1,193,180
  9906                                  ;
  9907                                  ; fortunately this formula simplifies to:
  9908                                  ;
  9909                                  ;	ticks from clock * 5 * 65,536
  9910                                  ;      --------------------------------- = time in 100th of seconds
  9911                                  ;		59,659
  9912                                  ;
  9913                                  ; the calculation is done by first multipling tick by 5. next we divide by
  9914                                  ; 59,659. in this division we multiply by 65,536 by shifting the dividend
  9915                                  ; my 16 bits to the left.
  9916                                  ;
  9917                                  ; start with ticks in cx:dx
  9918                                  ; multiply by 5
  9919                                  
  9920 00000430 89C8                    		mov	ax, cx
  9921 00000432 89D3                    		mov	bx, dx		; start	with ticks in cx:dx
  9922                                  					; multiply by 5
  9923 00000434 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
  9924 00000436 D1D1                    		rcl	cx, 1		; times	2
  9925 00000438 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
  9926 0000043A D1D1                    		rcl	cx, 1		; times	4
  9927 0000043C 01DA                    		add	dx, bx
  9928 0000043E 11C8                    		adc	ax, cx		; times	5
  9929 00000440 92                      		xchg	ax, dx
  9930                                  
  9931                                  ; now have ticks * 5 in	dx:ax
  9932                                  ; we now need to multiply by 65536 and divide by 59659 d.
  9933                                  
  9934 00000441 B90BE9                  		mov	cx, 59659	; get divisor
  9935 00000444 F7F1                    		div	cx		; dx now has remainder
  9936                                  					; ax has high word of final quotient
  9937                                  		;mov	bx, ax		; put high word	in safe	place
  9938                                  		; 20/12/2023
  9939 00000446 93                      		xchg	ax, bx
  9940 00000447 31C0                    		xor	ax, ax		; this is the multiply by 65536
  9941 00000449 F7F1                    		div	cx		; bx:ax	now has	time in	100th of seconds
  9942                                  
  9943                                  ; rounding based on the	remainder may be added here
  9944                                  ; the result in	bx:ax is time in 1/100 second.
  9945                                  
  9946 0000044B 89DA                    		mov	dx, bx
  9947 0000044D B9C800                  		mov	cx, 200		; extract 1/100's
  9948                                  
  9949                                  ; division by 200 is necessary to ensure no overflow--max result
  9950                                  ; is number of seconds in a day/2 = 43200.
  9951                                  
  9952 00000450 F7F1                    		div	cx
  9953 00000452 80FA64                  		cmp	dl, 100		; remainder over 100?
  9954 00000455 7203                    		jb	short noadj
  9955 00000457 80EA64                  		sub	dl, 100		; keep 1/100's less than 100
  9956                                  noadj:					
  9957 0000045A F5                      		cmc			; if we	subtracted 100,	carry is now set
  9958 0000045B 88D3                    		mov	bl, dl		; save 1/100's
  9959                                  
  9960                                  ; to compensate	for dividing by	200 instead of 100, we now multiply
  9961                                  ; by two, shifting a one in if the remainder had exceeded 100.
  9962                                  
  9963 0000045D D1D0                    		rcl	ax, 1
  9964 0000045F B200                    		mov	dl, 0
  9965 00000461 D1D2                    		rcl	dx, 1
  9966                                  		;mov	cx, 60		; divide out seconds
  9967                                  		; 20/12/2023
  9968 00000463 B13C                    		mov	cl, 60
  9969 00000465 F7F1                    		div	cx
  9970 00000467 88D7                    		mov	bh, dl		; save the seconds
  9971 00000469 F6F1                    		div	cl		; break	into hours and minutes
  9972 0000046B 86C4                    		xchg	al, ah
  9973                                  
  9974                                  ; time is now in ax:bx (hours, minutes, seconds, 1/100 sec)
  9975                                  
  9976                                  		; 20/12/2023
  9977                                  		;push	ax
  9978                                  		;mov	ax, si		; daycnt
  9979 0000046D 96                      		xchg	ax, si
  9980 0000046E AB                      		stosw
  9981                                  		;pop	ax
  9982 0000046F 96                      		xchg	ax, si		; al = hours, ah = minutes
  9983 00000470 AB                      		stosw
  9984 00000471 89D8                    		mov	ax, bx
  9985 00000473 AB                      		stosw
  9986 00000474 F8                      		clc
  9987 00000475 C3                      		retn
  9988                                  
  9989                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  9990                                  
  9991                                  ; 15/10/2022
  9992                                  
  9993                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9994                                  ;
  9995                                  ; procedure : GetTickCnt
  9996                                  ;
  9997                                  ;		Returns the tick count in CX:DX. Takes care of DayCnt in case
  9998                                  ;		of rollover [except when power management driver is in use]. 
  9999                                  ;		Uses the following logic for updating Daycnt
 10000                                  ;
 10001                                  ;		if ( rollover ) {
 10002                                  ;			if ( t_switch )
 10003                                  ;				daycnt++ ;
 10004                                  ;			else
 10005                                  ;				daycnt += rollover ;
 10006                                  ;		}
 10007                                  ;
 10008                                  ; USES : AX
 10009                                  ;
 10010                                  ; RETURNS : CX:DX - tick count
 10011                                  ; MODIFIES : daycnt
 10012                                  ;
 10013                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10014                                  
 10015                                  		; 17/10/2022
 10016                                  GetTickCnt:	
 10017 00000476 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah
 10018 00000478 CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- GET TIME OF DAY
 10019                                  					; Return: CX:DX	= clock	count
 10020                                  					; AL = 00h if clock was	read or	written	(via AH=0,1) since the previous
 10021                                  					; midnight
 10022                                  					; Otherwise, AL	> 0
 10023                                  		; 20/12/2023
 10024 0000047A 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah
 10025 0000047C 3826[EB04]              		cmp	byte [t_switch], ah ; 0
 10026                                  		;cmp	byte [t_switch], 0 ; use old method ? (>0 is yes)
 10027 00000480 7505                    		jnz	short inc_case	; old method assumes that Int 1Ah returns rollover flag
 10028                                  		;xor	ah, ah		; new method assumes that Int 1Ah returns roll over count
 10029                                  					; and not flag
 10030 00000482 0106[E904]              		add	[daycnt], ax
 10031 00000486 C3                      		retn
 10032                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10033                                  
 10034                                  inc_case:				
 10035 00000487 08C0                    		or	al, al
 10036 00000489 7404                    		jz	short no_rollover
 10037 0000048B FF06[E904]              		inc	word [daycnt]
 10038                                  no_rollover:				
 10039 0000048F C3                      		retn

 10080                                  ; some floppies do not have changeline. as a result, media-check would
 10081                                  ; normally return i-don't-know, the dos would continually reread the fat and
 10082                                  ; discard cached data. we optimize this by implementing a logical door-latch:
 10083                                  ; it is physically impossible to change a disk in under 2 seconds. we retain
 10084                                  ; the time of the last successful disk operation and compare it with the current
 10085                                  ; time during media-check. if < 2 seconds and at least 1 timer tick has passed,
 10086                                  ; the we say no change. if > 2 seconds then we say i-don't-know. finally, 
 10087                                  ; since we cannot trust the timer to be always available, we record the number 
 10088                                  ; of media checks that have occurred when no apparent time has elapsed. while
 10089                                  ; this number is < a given threshold, we say no change. when it exceeds that
 10090                                  ; threshold, we say i-don't-know and reset the counter to 0. when we store 
 10091                                  ; the time of last successful access, if we see that time has passed too,
 10092                                  ; we reset the counter.
 10093                                  
 10094                                  accessmax	equ	5
 10095                                  
 10096                                  ; due to various bogosities, we need to continually adjust what the head
 10097                                  ; settle time is.  the following algorithm is used:
 10098                                  ;
 10099                                  ;   get the current head settle value.
 10100                                  ;   if it is 0, then
 10101                                  ;	set slow = 15
 10102                                  ;   else
 10103                                  ;	set slow = value
 10104                                  ;   ...
 10105                                  ;*********************************************
 10106                                  ;************ old algorithm ******************
 10107                                  ;*   if we are seeking and writing then
 10108                                  ;*	 use slow
 10109                                  ;*   else
 10110                                  ;*	 use fast
 10111                                  ;*********************************************
 10112                                  ;*********** ibm's requested logic ***********
 10113                                  ;   if we are seeking and writing and not on an at then
 10114                                  ;	use slow
 10115                                  ;   else
 10116                                  ;	use fast
 10117                                  ;   ...
 10118                                  ;   restore current head settle value
 10119                                  ;
 10120                                  ;
 10121                                  ;---------------------------------------
 10122                                  multrk_on	equ	10000000b	;user spcified mutitrack=on, or system turns
 10123                                  					; it on after handling config.sys file as a
 10124                                  					; default value, if multrk_flag = multrk_off1.
 10125                                  multrk_off1	equ	00000000b	;initial value. no "multitrack=" command entered.
 10126                                  multrk_off2	equ	00000001b	;user specified multitrack=off.

 10318                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 10319                                  
 10320                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10321                                  ; perform a check on the time passed since the last access for this physical
 10322                                  ; drive.
 10323                                  ; we are accessing the same drive. if the time of last successful access was
 10324                                  ; less than 2 seconds ago, then we may presume that the disk was not changed.
 10325                                  ; returns in si:
 10326                                  ;	0 - if time of last access was >= 2 seconds
 10327                                  ;	1 - if time was < 2 seconds (i.e no media change assumed)
 10328                                  ; registers affected ax,cx,dx, flags.
 10329                                  ;
 10330                                  ;	assume es:di -> bds, ds->Bios_Data
 10331                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10332                                  
 10333                                  		; 19/10/2022
 10334                                  Check_Time_Of_Access:
 10335 0000054E BE0100                  		mov	si, 1		; presume no change.
 10336 00000551 E822FF                  		call	GetTickCnt	; cx:dx	is the elapsed time
 10337 00000554 268B4547                		mov	ax, [es:di+47h]	; [es:di+BDS.tim_lo]
 10338                                  					; get stored time
 10339 00000558 29C2                    		sub	dx, ax
 10340 0000055A 268B4549                		mov	ax, [es:di+49h]	; [es:di+BDS.tim_hi]
 10341 0000055E 19C1                    		sbb	cx, ax
 10342 00000560 751A                    		jnz	short timecheck_unk ; cx<>0 => >1 hour
 10343 00000562 09D2                    		or	dx, dx		; time must pass

 10526                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10527                                  ;	getbp - return bpb from the drive specified by the bds.
 10528                                  ;	    if the return_fake_bpb flag is set, then it does nothing.
 10529                                  ;	    note that we never come here for fixed disks.
 10530                                  ;	    for all other cases,
 10531                                  ;	      - it reads boot sector to pull out the bpb
 10532                                  ;	      - if no valid bpb is found, it then reads the fat sector,
 10533                                  ;		to get the fat id byte to build the bpb from there.
 10534                                  ;
 10535                                  ;   inputs:	es:di point to correct bds.
 10536                                  ;
 10537                                  ;   outputs:	fills in bpb in current bds if valid bpb or fat id on disk.
 10538                                  ;		carry set, and al=7 if invalid disk.
 10539                                  ;		carry set and error code in al if other error.
 10540                                  ;		if failed to recognize the boot record, then will set the
 10541                                  ;		set_id_flag to 0.
 10542                                  ;		this routine will only work for a floppy diskette.
 10543                                  ;		     for a fixed disk, it will just return.
 10544                                  ;
 10545                                  ;	****** Note: getbp is a clone of getbp which uses the newer
 10546                                  ;	  segment definitions. It should be migrated towards.
