 10745                                  
 10746                                  ; 15/10/2022 - Retro DOS 4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 10747                                  
 10748                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------
 10749                                  ; read in the boot sector. set carry if error in reading sector.
 10750                                  ; bx is set to 1 if the boot sector is invalid, otherwise it is 0.
 10751                                  ;
 10752                                  ;	assumes es:di -> bds, ds-> Bios_Data
 10753                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------
 10754                                  
 10755                                  ; 10/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 10756                                  
 10757                                  readbootsec:	
 10758 000006A3 B600                    		mov	dh, 0		; head 0
 10759 000006A5 B90100                  		mov	cx, 1		; cylinder 0, sector 1
 10760 000006A8 E8BF00                  		call	read_sector
 10761 000006AB 7243                    		jb	short err_ret
 10762 000006AD 31DB                    		xor	bx, bx		; assume valid boot sector
 10763                                  
 10764                                  		; put a sanity check for the boot sector in here to detect
 10765                                  		; boot sectors that do not have valid bpbs. we examine the
 10766                                  		; first two bytes - they must contain a long jump (69h) or a
 10767                                  		; short jump (EBh) followed by a nop (90h), or a short jump
 10768                                  		; (E9h). if this test is passed, we further check by examining
 10769                                  		; the signature at the end of the boot sector for the word
 10770                                  		; AA55h. if the signature is not present, we examine the media
 10771                                  		; descriptor byte to see if it is valid. for dos 3.3, this
 10772                                  		; logic is modified a little bit. we are not going to check
 10773                                  		; signature. instead we are going to sanity check the media
 10774                                  		; byte in bpb regardless of the validity of signature. this is
 10775                                  		; to save the already developed commercial products that have
 10776                                  		; good jump instruction and signature but with the false bpb
 10777                                  		; informations
 10778                                  
 10779                                  ; that will crash the diskette drive operation. (for example, symphony diskette).
 10780                                  
 10781                                  		; 02/09/2023
 10782                                  		; 19/10/2022
 10783                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector], 69h ; is it a direct jump?
 10784                                  		;jz	short check_bpb_mediabyte ; don't need to find a nop
 10785                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector], 0E9h ; dos 2.0 jump?
 10786                                  		;jz	short check_bpb_mediabyte ; no need for	nop
 10787                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector], 0EBh ; how about a short jump?
 10788                                  		;jnz	short invalidbootsec
 10789                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector+2], 90h ; is next one a nop?
 10790                                  		;jnz	short invalidbootsec
 10791                                  
 10792                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1)
 10793 000006AF A0[4E01]                		mov	al, [disksector]
 10794 000006B2 3C69                    		cmp	al, 69h		; is it a direct jump?
 10795 000006B4 740F                    		je	short check_bpb_mediabyte
 10796                                  					; don't need to find a nop
 10797 000006B6 3CE9                    		cmp	al, 0E9h	; dos 2.0 jump?
 10798 000006B8 740B                    		je	short check_bpb_mediabyte
 10799                                  					; no need for nop
 10800 000006BA 3CEB                    		cmp	al, 0EBh	; how about a short jump?
 10801 000006BC 7530                    		jne	short invalidbootsec
 10802 000006BE 803E[5001]90            		cmp	byte [disksector+2], 90h ; is next one a nop?
 10803 000006C3 7529                    		jne	short invalidbootsec
 10804                                  
 10805                                  ; 15/10/5022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 10806                                  ;
 10807                                  ;; 10/03/2019
 10808                                  ;; (MSDOS 3.3, MSDISK.ASM, 1988)
 10809                                  ;;
 10810                                  ;; Don't have to perform the following signature check since
 10811                                  ;; we need to check the media byte even with the good signatured diskette.
 10812                                  ;;
 10813                                  ;;check_signature:
 10814                                  ;;		cmp	word [cs:disksector+1FEh],0AA55h ; see if non-ibm
 10815                                  ;;							 ; disk or 1.x media.
 10816                                  ;;		jz	short checksinglesided ; go see if single sided medium.
 10817                                  ;;					       ; may need some special handling
 10818                                  
 10819                                  ; check for non-ibm disks which do not have the signature AA55h at the
 10820                                  ; end of the boot sector, but still have a valid boot sector. this is done
 10821                                  ; by examining the media descriptor in the boot sector.
 10822                                  
 10823                                  		; 19/10/2022
 10824                                  check_bpb_mediabyte:			
 10825 000006C5 A0[6301]                		mov	al, [disksector+15h]
 10826                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.MEDIADESCRIPTOR]
 10827 000006C8 50                      		push	ax ; 02/09/2023
 10828 000006C9 24F0                    		and	al, 0F0h
 10829 000006CB 3CF0                    		cmp	al, 0F0h	; allow	for strange media
 10830 000006CD 58                      		pop	ax ; 02/09/2023
 10831 000006CE 751E                    		jnz	short invalidbootsec
 10832                                  
 10833                                  ; there were some (apparently a lot of them) diskettes that had been formatted
 10834                                  ; under dos 3.1 and earlier versions which have invalid bpbs in their boot
 10835                                  ; sectors. these are specifically diskettes that were formatted in drives
 10836                                  ; with one head, or whose side 0 was bad. these contain bpbs in the boot
 10837                                  ; sector that have the sec/clus field set to 2 instead of 1, as is standard
 10838                                  ; in dos. in order to support them, we have to introduce a "hack" that will
 10839                                  ; help our build bpb routine to recognise these specific cases, and to
 10840                                  ; set up out copy of the bpb accordingly.
 10841                                  ; we do this by checking to see if the boot sector is off a diskette that
 10842                                  ; is single-sided and is a pre-dos 3.20 diskette. if it is, we set the
 10843                                  ; sec/clus field to 1. if not, we carry on as normal.
 10844                                  
 10845                                  checksinglesided:
 10846                                  		;mov	al, [disksector+15h]
 10847                                  		; 02/09/2023
 10848                                  		; al = [disksector+15h]
 10849 000006D0 3CF0                    		cmp	al, 0F0h
 10850 000006D2 741B                    		jz	short gooddsk
 10851 000006D4 A801                    		test	al, 1
 10852 000006D6 7517                    		jnz	short gooddsk
 10853 000006D8 813E[5601]332E          		cmp	word [disksector+8], 2E33h ; "3."
 10854 000006DE 7507                    		jnz	short mustbeearlier
 10855 000006E0 803E[5801]32            		cmp	byte [disksector+0Ah], 32h ; "2"
 10856 000006E5 7308                    		jnb	short gooddsk
 10857                                  
 10858                                  ; we must have a pre-3.20 diskette. set the sec/clus field to 1
 10859                                  
 10860                                  mustbeearlier:				
 10861 000006E7 C606[5B01]01            		mov	byte [disksector+0Dh], 1
 10862                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.SECTORSPERCLUSTER]
 10863 000006EC EB01                    		jmp	short gooddsk
 10864                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10865                                  
 10866                                  invalidbootsec:				
 10867 000006EE 43                      		inc	bx		; indicate that boot sector invalid
 10868                                  		; 10/12/2022
 10869                                  movbpb_ret:
 10870                                  gooddsk:				
 10871 000006EF F8                      		clc
 10872                                  err_ret:
 10873 000006F0 C3                      		retn
 10874                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10875                                  
 10876                                  		; 10/12/2022
 10877                                  ;err_ret:				
 10878                                  		;retn
 10879                                  
 10880                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 10881                                  
 10882                                  ; 15/10/2022
 10883                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10884                                  ; 'movbpb' moves the bpb read from the boot sector into registers for use by
 10885                                  ; getbp routine at has1
 10886                                  ;
 10887                                  ; if the set_id_flag is 1, and if an extended boot record, then set volume
 10888                                  ; serial number, volume label, file system id in bds according to
 10889                                  ; the boot record.  after that, this routine will set the set_id_flag to 2
 10890                                  ; to signal that volume label is set already from the extended boot record
 10891                                  ; (so, don't set it again by calling "set_volume_id" routine which uses
 10892                                  ; the volume label in the root directory.)
 10893                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10894                                  
 10895                                  ; 10/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 10896                                  
 10897                                  		; 19/10/2022
 10898                                  movbpb:	
 10899 000006F1 8A36[5B01]              		mov	dh, [disksector+0Dh]
 10900                                  					; disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.SECTORSPERCLUSTER]
 10901                                  					; sectors per unit
 10902 000006F5 8A3E[5F01]              		mov	bh, [disksector+11h]
 10903                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.ROOTENTRIES]
 10904                                  					; number of directory entries
 10905 000006F9 8B0E[6101]              		mov	cx, [disksector+13h]
 10906                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.TOTALSECTORS]
 10907                                  					; size of drive
 10908 000006FD 8A26[6301]              		mov	ah, [disksector+15h]
 10909                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.MEDIADESCRIPTOR]
 10910                                  					; media	descriptor
 10911 00000701 A0[6401]                		mov	al, [disksector+16h];
 10912                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.SECTORSPERFAT]
 10913                                  					; number of fat	sectors
 10914 00000704 8A1E[6601]              		mov	bl, [disksector+18h]
 10915                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.SECTORSPERTRACK]
 10916                                  					; sectors per track
 10917 00000708 8A16[6801]              		mov	dl, [disksector+1Ah]
 10918                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.HEADS]
 10919                                  					; number of heads
 10920 0000070C 803E[0305]01            		cmp	byte [set_id_flag], 1 ; called by get_bpb?
 10921 00000711 75DC                    		jnz	short movbpb_ret
 10922 00000713 E81200                  		call	mov_media_ids
 10923 00000716 7205                    		jb	short movbpb_conv ; conventional boot record?
 10924 00000718 C606[0305]02            		mov	byte [set_id_flag], 2 ; signals that volume id is set
 10925                                  movbpb_conv:				
 10926 0000071D 803E[7700]01            		cmp	byte [fhave96], 1
 10927 00000722 75CB                    		jnz	short movbpb_ret
 10928 00000724 E88811                  		call	resetchanged	; reset	flags in bds to	not fchanged.
 10929                                  		; 10/12/2022
 10930                                  		; cf = 0
 10931                                  ;movbpb_ret:
 10932                                  		;clc
 10933 00000727 C3                      		retn
 10934                                  
 10935                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 10936                                  
 10937                                  ;copy the boot_serial number, volume id, and filesystem id from the
 10938                                  ;***extended boot record*** in ds:disksector to the bds table pointed
 10939                                  ;by es:di.
 10940                                  
 10941                                  ;in.) es:di -> bds
 10942                                  ;     ds:disksector = valid extended boot record.
 10943                                  ;out.) vol_serial, bds_volid and bds_system_id in bds are set according to
 10944                                  ;      the boot record information.
 10945                                  ;     carry flag set if not an extended bpb.
 10946                                  ;     all registers saved except the flag.
 10947                                  
 10948                                  		; 19/10/2022
 10949                                  mov_media_ids:		
 10950 00000728 803E[7401]29            		cmp	byte [disksector+26h], 29h
 10951                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.SIG],
 10952                                  					; EXT_BOOT_SIGNATURE
 10953 0000072D 752C                    		jnz	short mmi_not_ext
 10954 0000072F 51                      		push	cx
 10955 00000730 8B0E[7501]              		mov	cx, [disksector+27h]
 10956                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.SERIAL]
 10957 00000734 26894D57                		mov	[es:di+57h], cx	; [es:di+BDS.vol_serial]
 10958 00000738 8B0E[7701]              		mov	cx, [disksector+29h]
 10959                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.SERIAL+2]
 10960 0000073C 26894D59                		mov	[es:di+59h], cx	; [es:di+BDS.vol_serial+2]
 10961 00000740 57                      		push	di
 10962 00000741 56                      		push	si
 10963 00000742 B90B00                  		mov	cx, 11		; size_of_EXT_BOOT_VOL_LABEL
 10964 00000745 BE[7901]                		mov	si, disksector+2Bh
 10965                                  		;mov	si, (offset disksector+2Bh) ;
 10966                                  					; disksector+EXT_BOOT.VOL_LABEL
 10967 00000748 83C74B                  		add	di, 75		; BDS.volid
 10968 0000074B F3A4                    		rep movsb
 10969                                  		;mov	cx, 8		; size_of_EXT_SYSTEM_ID
 10970                                  		; 10/12/2022
 10971 0000074D B108                    		mov	cl, 8 ; cx = 8
 10972 0000074F BE[8401]                		mov	si, disksector+36h
 10973                                  		;mov	si, (offset disksector+36h) ; disksector+EXT_BOOT.SYSTEM_ID
 10974 00000752 83C705                  		add	di, 5		; (BDS.filesys_id-BDS.volid)-size_of_EXT_BOOT_VOL_LABEL
 10975 00000755 F3A4                    		rep movsb
 10976 00000757 5E                      		pop	si
 10977 00000758 5F                      		pop	di
 10978 00000759 59                      		pop	cx
 10979                                  		; 10/12/2022
 10980                                  		; cf = 0
 10981                                  		;clc		; this clc is not required (16/06/2019 - Erdogan Tan)
 10982                                  				; (20/09/2022)
 10983 0000075A C3                      		retn
 10984                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10985                                  
 10986                                  mmi_not_ext:				
 10987 0000075B F9                      		stc
 10988 0000075C C3                      		retn

 10992                                  ; 15/10/2022
 10993                                  ; --------------------------------------------------------------
 10994                                  ; read in the fat sector and get the media byte from it.
 10995                                  ; input : es:di -> bds
 10996                                  ; output:
 10997                                  ;	  carry set if an error occurs, ax contains error code.
 10998                                  ;	  otherwise, ah contains media byte on exit
 10999                                  ; --------------------------------------------------------------
 11000                                  
 11001                                  readfat:	
 11002                                  		;mov	dh, 0
 11003                                  		; 10/12/2022
 11004 0000075D 30F6                    		xor	dh, dh
 11005 0000075F B90200                  		mov	cx, 2		; head 0
 11006                                  					; cylinder 0, sector 2
 11007 00000762 E80500                  		call	read_sector
 11008 00000765 7202                    		jb	short bad_fat_ret
 11009 00000767 8A27                    		mov	ah, [bx]	; media	byte
 11010                                  bad_fat_ret:				
 11011 00000769 C3                      		retn
 11012                                  
 11013                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 11014                                  
 11015                                  ; 15/10/2022
 11016                                  
 11017                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11018                                  ; read a single sector into the temp buffer.
 11019                                  ; perform three retries in case of error.
 11020                                  ;   inputs:	es:[di].bds_drivenum has physical drive to use
 11021                                  ;		cx has sector and cylinder
 11022                                  ;		dh has head
 11023                                  ;		es:di has bds
 11024                                  ;		ds has Bios_Data
 11025                                  ;
 11026                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear
 11027                                  ;		    Bios_Data:bx point to sector
 11028                                  ;		       (note: some callers assume location of buffer)
 11029                                  ;
 11030                                  ;		carry set
 11031                                  ;		    ax has rom error code
 11032                                  ;
 11033                                  ; register bp is preserved.
 11034                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11035                                  
 11036                                  ; 10/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 11037                                  
 11038                                  		; 19/10/2022
 11039                                  read_sector:	
 11040 0000076A 55                      		push	bp
 11041 0000076B BD0300                  		mov	bp, 3		; make 3 attempts
 11042 0000076E 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 11043 00000772 BB[4E01]                		mov	bx, disksector	; get es:bx to point to	buffer
 11044                                  rd_ret:					
 11045 00000775 06                      		push	es
 11046 00000776 1E                      		push	ds
 11047 00000777 07                      		pop	es
 11048 00000778 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h
 11049 0000077B CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - READ SECTORS INTO MEMORY
 11050                                  					; AL = number of sectors to read, CH = track, CL = sector
 11051                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill
 11052                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status,	AL = number of sectors read
 11053 0000077D 07                      		pop	es
 11054 0000077E 734A                    		jnb	short okret2
 11055                                  rd_rty:					
 11056 00000780 E86604                  		call	again		; reset	disk, decrement	bp, preserve ax
 11057 00000783 7442                    		jz	short err_rd_ret
 11058 00000785 26F6452301              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 1
 11059                                  		;test	byte ptr [es:di+23h], 1	; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 11060                                  					; fnon_removable
 11061 0000078A 75E9                    		jnz	short rd_ret
 11062 0000078C 803E[2F06]00            		cmp	byte [media_set_for_format], 0
 11063 00000791 7510                    		jnz	short rd_skip1_dpt
 11064 00000793 50                      		push	ax
 11065 00000794 1E                      		push	ds		; for retry, set the head settle time to 0Fh
 11066 00000795 C536[2D01]              		lds	si, [dpt]
 11067                                  		;mov	al, [si+9]	; [si+DISK_PARMS.DISK_HEAD_STTL]
 11068                                  		;mov	byte [si+9], 15 ; [si+DISK_PARMS.DISK_HEAD_STTL]
 11069                                  		;			; NORMSETTLE
 11070                                  		; 12/12/2022
 11071 00000799 B00F                    		mov	al, 15
 11072 0000079B 864409                  		xchg	al, [si+9]
 11073                                  		; 
 11074 0000079E 1F                      		pop	ds
 11075 0000079F A2[2A01]                		mov	[save_head_sttl], al
 11076 000007A2 58                      		pop	ax
 11077                                  rd_skip1_dpt:				
 11078 000007A3 06                      		push	es
 11079 000007A4 1E                      		push	ds
 11080 000007A5 07                      		pop	es
 11081 000007A6 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h
 11082 000007A9 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - READ SECTORS INTO MEMORY
 11083                                  					; AL = number of sectors to read, CH = track, CL = sector
 11084                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill
 11085                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status,	AL = number of sectors read
 11086 000007AB 07                      		pop	es
 11087 000007AC 9C                      		pushf
 11088 000007AD 803E[2F06]00            		cmp	byte [media_set_for_format], 0
 11089 000007B2 750E                    		jnz	short rd_skip2_dpt
 11090 000007B4 50                      		push	ax
 11091 000007B5 A0[2A01]                		mov	al, [save_head_sttl]
 11092 000007B8 1E                      		push	ds
 11093 000007B9 C536[2D01]              		lds	si, [dpt]
 11094 000007BD 884409                  		mov	[si+9],	al	; [si+DISK_PARMS.DISK_HEAD_STTL]
 11095 000007C0 1F                      		pop	ds
 11096 000007C1 58                      		pop	ax
 11097                                  rd_skip2_dpt:				
 11098 000007C2 9D                      		popf
 11099 000007C3 7305                    		jnb	short okret2
 11100 000007C5 EBB9                    		jmp	short rd_rty
 11101                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11102                                  
 11103                                  err_rd_ret:				
 11104 000007C7 B2FF                    		mov	dl, 0FFh	; make sure we ask rom if media	has changed
 11105                                  					; return error
 11106 000007C9 F9                      		stc
 11107                                  
 11108                                  ; update information pertaining to last drive accessed, time of access, last
 11109                                  ; track accessed in that drive.
 11110                                  
 11111                                  okret2:					
 11112 000007CA 8816[7600]              		mov	[step_drv], dl	; set up for head settle logic in disk
 11113 000007CE 8816[1E01]              		mov	[tim_drv], dl	; save drive last accessed
 11114 000007D2 26886D46                		mov	[es:di+46h], ch	; [es:di+BDS.track]
 11115                                  					; save last track accessed on this drive
 11116                                  					; preserve flags in case error occurred
 11117 000007D6 9C                      		pushf
 11118 000007D7 E8EF03                  		call	set_tim
 11119 000007DA 9D                      		popf			; restore flags
 11120 000007DB 5D                      		pop	bp
 11121 000007DC C3                      		retn

 12908                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 12909                                  
 12910                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 12911                                  ;
 12912                                  ; The sector size in bytes needs to be converted to an index value for the ibm
 12913                                  ; rom. (0=>128,1=>256,2=>512,3=>1024). It is assumed that only these values
 12914                                  ; are permissible.
 12915                                  ;

 13038                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13039                                  ;
 13040                                  ; Set Media Type for Format
 13041                                  ; Performs the int 13 with ah = 18h to see if the medium described in the
 13042                                  ; BPB area in the BDS can be handled by the rom.
 13043                                  ; On Input, ES:DI -> current BDS.
 13044                                  ; The status of the operation is returned in AL
 13045                                  ;
 13046                                  ;	- 0 - if the support is available,and the combination is valid.
 13047                                  ;	- 1 - no rom support
 13048                                  ;	- 2 - illegal combination
 13049                                  ;	- 3 - no media present (rom support exists but cannot determine now)
 13050                                  ;
 13051                                  ; Flags also may be altered. All other registers preserved.
 13052                                  ; If the call to rom returns no error,then the current Dpt is "replaced" by
 13053                                  ; the one returned by the rom. This is Done by changing the pointer in [Dpt]
 13054                                  ; to the one returned. the original pointer to the disk base table is stored
 13055                                  ; in TempDpt, until it is restored.
 13056                                  ;
 13057                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13058                                  
 13059                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13060                                  SetMediaForFormat:

 13312                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13313                                  ;
 13314                                  ; get the owner of the physical drive represented by the logical drive in al.
 13315                                  ; the assumption is that we **always** keep track of the owner of a drive!!
 13316                                  ; if this is not the case, the system may hang, just following the linked list.

 13320                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13321                                  ioctl_getown:

 13324                                  					; Get physical drive number
 13325 000010BF C43E[1901]              		les	di, [start_bds] ; Get start of bds chain
 13326                                  ownloop:

 13332                                  					; fi_own_physical
 13333 000010CE 7514                    		jnz	short exitown

 13336 000010D3 EBEE                    		jmp	short ownloop

 13338                                  
 13339                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13340                                  ;
 13341                                  ; set the ownership of the physical drive represented by the logical drive
 13342                                  ; in al to al.

 13443                                  ;	get media id
 13444                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13445                                  ;
 13446                                  ; FUNCTION: get the volume label,the system id and the serial number from
 13447                                  ;	    the media that has the extended boot record.
 13448                                  ;	    for the conventional media,this routine will return "unknown
 13449                                  ;	    media type" error to dos.
 13450                                  ;
 13451                                  ; INPUT :   ES:di -> bds table for this drive.
 13452                                  ;
 13453                                  ; OUTPUT:   the request packet filled with the information,if not carry.
 13454                                  ;	    if carry set,then al contains the device driver error number
 13455                                  ;	    that will be returned to dos.
 13456                                  ;	    register DS,DX,AX,CX,DI,SI destroyed.
 13457                                  ;

 13459                                  ;	BootIo:NEAR

 13463                                  ;	access the boot sector even if it is a hard disk.
 13464                                  ;	note:the valid extended bpb is recognized by looking at the mediabyte
 13465                                  ;	field of bpb and the extended boot signature.

 13469                                  ;	rFlag = read operation;

 13471                                  ;	if (no error) then

 13474                                  ;		  of the request packet to those of the boot record;
 13475                                  ;		};
 13476                                  ;	     else		  /*not an extended bpb */
 13477                                  ;		{ set register al to "unknown media.." error code;
 13478                                  ;		  set carry bit;
 13479                                  ;		};
 13480                                  ;	else
 13481                                  ;	     ret;	/*already error code is set in the register al
 13482                                  ;
 13483                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13484                                  
 13485                                  ;size_of_EXT_BOOT_SERIAL equ 4
 13486                                  ;;size_of_EXT_BOOT_VOL_LABEL equ 11

 13543                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13544                                  ;  set media id
 13545                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13546                                  
 13547                                  ; function: set the volume label, the system id and the serial number of
 13548                                  ;	    the media that has the extended boot record.
 13549                                  ;	    for the conventional media, this routine will return "unknown
 13550                                  ;	    media.." error to dos.
 13551                                  ;	    this routine will also set the corresponding informations in
 13552                                  ;	    the bds table.
 13553                                  ;
 13554                                  ; input :   ES:di -> bds table for this drive.
 13555                                  ;
 13556                                  ; output:   the extended boot record in the media will be set according to
 13557                                  ;	    the request packet.
 13558                                  ;	    if carry set, then al contains the device driver error number
 13559                                  ;	    that will be returned to dos.
 13560                                  ;
 13561                                  ; subroutines to be called:
 13562                                  ;	BootIo:NEAR
 13563                                  ;
 13564                                  ; logic:
 13565                                  ;
 13566                                  ; {
 13567                                  ;	get drive_number from bds;
 13568                                  ;	rFlag = "read operation";

 13570                                  ;	if (no error) then
 13571                                  ;	     if (extended boot record) then
 13572                                  ;		{ set volume label,volume serial number and system id
 13573                                  ;		  of the boot record to those of the request packet;
 13574                                  ;		  rFlag = "write operation";
 13575                                  ;		  get drive number from bds;
 13576                                  ;		  BootIo;	  /*write it back*/
 13577                                  ;		};
 13578                                  ;	     else		  /*not an extended bpb */
 13579                                  ;		{ set register al to "unknown media.." error code;
 13580                                  ;		  set carry bit;
 13581                                  ;		  ret;	 /*return back to caller */
 13582                                  ;		};
 13583                                  ;	else
 13584                                  ;	     ret;		 /*already error code is set */
 13585                                  ;
 13586                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13587                                  
 13588                                  		; 24/12/2023
 13589                                  		; 19/10/2022

 13651                                  
 13652                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13653                                  ;	BootIo
 13654                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13655                                  ;
 13656                                  ; function: read/write the boot record into boot sector.
 13657                                  ;
 13658                                  ; input :
 13659                                  ;	    al=logical drive number
 13660                                  ;	    rFlag = operation (read/write)
 13661                                  ;
 13662                                  ; output:   for read operation,the boot record of the drive specified in bds
 13663                                  ;	    be read into the DiskSector buffer.
 13664                                  ;	    for write operation,the DiskSector buffer image will be written
 13665                                  ;	    to the drive specified in bds.
 13666                                  ;	    if carry set,then al contains the device driver error number
 13667                                  ;	    that will be returned to dos.
 13668                                  ;	    AX,CX,DX register destroyed.
 13669                                  ;	    if carry set,then al will contain the error code from DiskIO.
 13670                                  ;
 13671                                  ; subroutines to be called:
 13672                                  ;	DiskIO:NEAR
 13673                                  ;
 13674                                  ; logic:
 13675                                  ;
 13676                                  ; {
 13677                                  ;	first_sector = 0;	 /*logical sector 0 is the boot sector */
 13678                                  ;	sectorcount = 1;	 /*read 1 sector only */
 13679                                  ;	buffer = DiskSector;	 /*read it into the DiskSector buffer */
 13680                                  ;	call DiskIO (rFlag,drive_number,first_sector,sectorcount,buffer);
 13681                                  ; }
 13682                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13683                                  
 13684                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13685                                  BootIo:	
 13686 000011A7 06                      		push	es
 13687 000011A8 57                      		push	di
 13688 000011A9 53                      		push	bx
 13689 000011AA 1E                      		push	ds
 13690 000011AB 07                      		pop	es		; Point ES: to Bios_Data
 13691                                  
 13692                                  		; Call DiskIO to read/write the boot sec. The parameters which
 13693                                  		; need to be initialized for this subroutine out here are
 13694                                  		; - Transfer address to Bios_Data:DiskSector
 13695                                  		; - Low sector needs to be initalized to 0. this is a reg. param
 13696                                  		; - Hi sector in [Start_Sec_H] needs to be initialised to 0.
 13697                                  		; - Number of sectors <-- 1
 13698                                  
 13699 000011AC BF[4E01]                		mov	di, disksector	; es:di -> transfer address
 13700 000011AF 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx		; First	sector (h) -> 0
 13701 000011B1 8916[2405]              		mov	[start_sec_h], dx ; Start sector (h) -> 0
 13702 000011B5 B90100                  		mov	cx, 1
 13703 000011B8 E8FBF6                  		call	diskio
 13704 000011BB 5B                      		pop	bx
 13705 000011BC 5F                      		pop	di
 13706 000011BD 07                      		pop	es
 13707 000011BE C3                      		retn
 13708

 13713                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13714                                  ;	ChangeLineChk
 13715                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13716                                  ;
 13717                                  ; when the user calls get/set media id call before dos establishes the media
 13718                                  ; by calling "media_chk",the change line activity of the drive is going to be
 13719                                  ; lost.	this routine will check the change line activity and will save the
 13720                                  ; history in the flags.
 13721                                  ;
 13722                                  ; FUNCTION: check the change line error activity
 13723                                  ;
 13724                                  ; INPUT :  ES:di -> bds table.
 13725                                  ;
 13726                                  ; OUTPUT:   flag in bds table will be updated if change line occurs.
 13727                                  ;
 13728                                  ; SUBROUTINES TO BE CALLED:
 13729                                  ;	Set_Changed_DL
 13730                                  ;
 13731                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13732                                  
 13733                                  ChangeLineChk:
 13734 000011BF 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 13735 000011C3 08D2                    		or	dl, dl		; Fixed	disk?
 13736 000011C5 7821                    		js	short ChangeLnChkRet ; Yes, skip it.
 13737                                  		; 12/12/2022
 13738 000011C7 26F6452304              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 4
 13739                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 4 ; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 13740                                  					; return_fake_bpb
 13741 000011CC 751A                    		jnz	short ChangeLnChkRet
 13742 000011CE 803E[7700]01            		cmp	byte [fhave96], 1	; This rom support change line?
 13743 000011D3 7513                    		jnz	short ChangeLnChkRet
 13744 000011D5 E8DD06                  		call	haschange	; This drive support change line?
 13745 000011D8 740E                    		jz	short ChangeLnChkRet ; Do nothing
 13746                                  
 13747                                  		; Execute the rom disk interrupt to check changeline activity.
 13748                                  
 13749 000011DA B416                    		mov	ah, 16h
 13750 000011DC CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - FLOPPY	DISK - CHANGE OF DISK STATUS (AT,XT2,XT286,CONV,PS)
 13751                                  					; DL = drive to	check
 13752                                  					; Return: AH = disk change status
 13753 000011DE 7308                    		jnb	short ChangeLnChkRet
 13754 000011E0 53                      		push	bx
 13755 000011E1 BB4000                  		mov	bx, 40h		; fchanged
 13756                                  					; Update flag in BDS for this
 13757                                  					; physical drive
 13758 000011E4 E8A706                  		call	set_changed_dl
 13759 000011E7 5B                      		pop	bx

 13761 000011E8 C3                      		retn

 13834                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13835                                  ; Ioctl_Support_Query
 13836                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13837                                  ;
 13838                                  ; New device command which was added in DOS 5.00 to allow a query of a 
 13839                                  ; specific GENERIC IOCtl to see if it is supported. Bit 7 in the
 13840                                  ; device attributes specifies if this function is supported.
 13841                                  ;
 13842                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13843                                  
 13844                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13845                                  ioctl_support_query:
 13846 00001216 06                      		push	es
 13847 00001217 C41E[1200]              		les	bx, [ptrsav]	; ES:BX Points to request header.
 13848 0000121B 268B470D                		mov	ax, [es:bx+13]	; [es:bx+IOCTL_REQ.MAJORFUNCTION]
 13849                                  					; AL ==	Major, AH == Minor
 13850 0000121F 3C08                    		cmp	al, 8		; IOC_DC
 13851                                  					; See if major code is 8
 13852 00001221 7513                    		jnz	short nosupport
 13853 00001223 0E                      		push	cs
 13854 00001224 07                      		pop	es
 13855 00001225 B90B00                  		mov	cx, 11		; IOC_DC_TABLE_LEN
 13856                                  		; 10/12/2022
 13857 00001228 BF[1B0C]                		mov	di, IOC_DC_Table
 13858                                  		;mov	di, 0C60h	; IOC_DC_Table
 13859                                  					; at 2C7h:0C60h	= 70h:31D0h

 13884                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13885                                  ;	GetMediaSenseStatus
 13886                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13887                                  ;
 13888                                  ; FUNCTION: Will return the type of diskette media in the specified DOS
 13889                                  ;	    diskette drive and whether the media is the default type
 13890                                  ;	    for that drive. (default type means the max size for that
 13891                                  ;	    drive)
 13892                                  ;
 13893                                  ; INPUT :   ES:DI -> BDS table
 13894                                  ; OUTPUT:   If carry clear
 13895                                  ;	    DS:BX -> Updated IOCtlPacket
 13896                                  ;
 13897                                  ;			 Special Function at offset 0:
 13898                                  ;				0	- Media detected is not default type
 13899                                  ;				1	- Media detected is default type
 13900                                  ;
 13901                                  ;			 Device Type at offset 1:
 13902                                  ;				2       - 720K 3.5" 80 tracks
 13903                                  ;				7	- 1.44M 3.5" 80 tracks
 13904                                  ;				9	- 2.88M 3.5" 80 tracks
 13905                                  ;
 13906                                  ; Error Codes returned in AX if carry set:
 13907                                  ;
 13908                                  ; 8102 - Drive not ready	- No disk is in the drive.
 13909                                  ; 8107 - Unknown media type	- Drive doesn't support this function or
 13910                                  ;				  the media is really unkown, any error
 13911                                  ;				  other than "media not present"
 13912                                  ; 
 13913                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13914                                  
 13915                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13916                                  SenseMediaType:
 13917 0000123A C51E[1200]              		lds	bx, [ptrsav]	; DS:BX	points to request header.
 13918 0000123E C55F13                  		lds	bx, [bx+19]	; bx+IOCTL_REQ.GENERICIOCTL_PACKET]
 13919                                  		; 10/10/2022
 13920                                  		;mov	word [bx], 0	; Initialize the 2 packet bytes
 13921 00001241 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
 13922 00001243 8917                    		mov	[bx], dx ; 0
 13923                                  		;
 13924 00001245 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 13925                                  					; Get int 13h drive number from	BDS
 13926                                  		; 10/12/2022
 13927                                  		;xor	dh, dh		; DX = physical	drive number
 13928 00001249 B420                    		mov	ah, 20h		; Get Media Type function
 13929                                  					; If no	carry media type in AL
 13930 0000124B CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - QCACHE	- DISMOUNT
 13931 0000124D 7216                    		jb	short MediaSenseEr ; error code	in AH
 13932 0000124F FE07                    		inc	byte [bx]	; Signal media type is default (bit 1)
 13933                                  DetermineMediaType:
 13934 00001251 FEC8                    		dec	al
 13935 00001253 3C02                    		cmp	al, 2		; Chk for 720K ie: (3-1) = 2
 13936 00001255 740A                    		jz	short GotMediaType
 13937 00001257 0404                    		add	al, 4
 13938 00001259 3C07                    		cmp	al, 7		; Chk for 1.44M ie: (4-1+4) = 7
 13939 0000125B 7404                    		jz	short GotMediaType
 13940 0000125D 3C09                    		cmp	al, 9		; Chk for 2.88M	ie: (6-1+4) = 9
 13941 0000125F 7510                    		jnz	short UnknownMediaType ; Just didn't recognize media type
 13942                                  GotMediaType:				
 13943 00001261 884701                  		mov	[bx+1],	al	; Save the return value
 13944                                  		; 10/12/2022
 13945                                  		; cf = 0
 13946                                  		;clc			; Signal success
 13947 00001264 C3                      		retn
 13948                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13949                                  
 13950                                  MediaSenseEr:
 13951 00001265 80FC32                  		cmp	ah, 32h		; See if not default media error
 13952 00001268 74E7                    		jz	short DetermineMediaType ; Not really an error
 13953 0000126A B002                    		mov	al, 2		; Now assume drive not ready
 13954 0000126C 80FC31                  		cmp	ah, 31h		; See if media was present
 13955 0000126F 7402                    		jz	short SenseErrExit ; Return drive not ready
 13956                                  UnknownMediaType:			
 13957 00001271 B007                    		mov	al, 7		; Just don't know the media type
 13958                                  SenseErrExit:
 13959 00001273 B481                    		mov	ah, 81h		; Signal error return
 13960 00001275 F9                      		stc
 13961 00001276 C3                      		retn

 13965                                  		;db    0

 13967                                  
 13968                                  ; 16/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 13969                                  
 13970                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13971                                  ; MSINT13.ASM - MSDOS 6.0 - 1991
 13972                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13973                                  ; 16/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 13974                                  
 13975                                  ;	int 2f function 13h allows the user to change the orig13 int_13 vector
 13976                                  ;	after booting. this allows testing and implementation of custom int_13
 13977                                  ;	handlers, without giving up ms-dos error recovery
 13978                                  ;	entry:	ds:dx	== addr. of new int_13 handler
 13979                                  ;		es:bx	== addr. of new int_13 vector used by warm boot (int19)
 13980                                  ;	exit:	orig13	== address of new int_13 handler
 13981                                  ;		ds:dx	== old orig13 value
 13982                                  ;		es:bx	== old old13  value
 13983                                  ;
 13984                                  ; int 2f handler for external block drivers to communicate with the internal
 13985                                  ; block driver in msdisk. the multiplex number chosen is 8. the handler
 13986                                  ; sets up the pointer to the request packet in [ptrsav] and then jumps to
 13987                                  ; dsk_entry, the entry point for all disk requests.
 13988                                  ;
 13989                                  ; on exit from this driver, we will return to the external driver
 13990                                  ; that issued this int 2f, and can then remove the flags from the stack.
 13991                                  ; this scheme allows us to have a small external device driver, and makes
 13992                                  ; the maintainance of the various drivers (driver and msbio) much easier,
 13993                                  ; since we only need to make changes in one place (most of the time).
 13994                                  ;
 13995                                  ;   ax=800h - check for installed handler - reserved
 13996                                  ;   ax=801h - install the bds into the linked list
 13997                                  ;   ax=802h - dos request
 13998                                  ;   ax=803h - return bds table starting pointer in ds:di
 13999                                  ;	   (ems device driver hooks int 13h to handle 16kb dma overrun
 14000                                  ;	    problem. bds table is going to be used to get head/sector
 14001                                  ;	    informations without calling generic ioctl get device parm call.)
 14002                                  
 14003                                  ;BIOSSEGMENT equ 70h
 14004                                  DOSBIOSSEG equ 0070h ; 17/10/2022
 14005                                  
 14006                                  ;;BIOSCODE:1302h (MSDOS 6.21, IO.SYS)
 14007                                  
 14008                                  i2f_handler:				; here is 02C7h:1302h =	0070h:3872h

 14011 0000127C 80FC08                  		cmp	ah, 8

 14266                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14267                                  ;
 14268                                  ; procedure : HMAPtr
 14269                                  ;
 14270                                  ;		Gets the offset of the free HMA area ( with respect to
 14271                                  ;							seg ffff )
 14272                                  ;		If DOS has not moved high, tries to move DOS high.
 14273                                  ;		In the course of doing this, it will allocate all the HMA
 14274                                  ;		and set the FreeHMAPtr to past the end of the BIOS and 
 14275                                  ;		DOS code. The call to MoveDOSIntoHMA (which is a pointer)
 14276                                  ;		enters the routine in sysinit1 called FTryToMovDOSHi.
 14277                                  ;
 14278                                  ;	RETURNS : offset of free HMA in DI
 14279                                  ;		  BIOS_DATA, seg in DS
 14280                                  ;
 14281                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14282                                  
 14283                                  		; 17/10/2022
 14284                                  HMAPtr:
 14285 00001372 2E8E1E[3000]            		mov	ds, [cs:BIOSDATAWORD]
 14286                                  		;mov	ds, word ptr cs:BIOSDATAWORD ; [cs:Bios_Data_Word]
 14287 00001377 8B3E[EB08]              		mov	di, [FreeHMAPtr]
 14288                                  		;mov	di, ds:FreeHMAPtr
 14289 0000137B 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh
 14290 0000137E 750F                    		jnz	short HMAPtr_retn
 14291 00001380 803E[F108]00            		cmp	byte [SysinitPresent], 0
 14292                                  		;cmp	ds:SysinitPresent, 0
 14293 00001385 7408                    		jz	short HMAPtr_retn
 14294 00001387 FF1E[ED08]              		call	far [MoveDOSIntoHMA]
 14295                                  		;call	ds:MoveDOSIntoHMA ; call far [MoveDOSIntoHMA]
 14296 0000138B 8B3E[EB08]              		mov	di, [FreeHMAPtr]
 14297                                  		;mov	di, ds:FreeHMAPtr
 14298                                  HMAPtr_retn:
 14299 0000138F C3                      		retn
 14300                                  
 14301                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 14302                                  
 14303                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14304                                  
 14305                                  ; move a 512 byte sector from ds:si to es:di, do not trash cx
 14306                                  ; but go ahead and update direction flag, si, & di
 14307                                  
 14308                                  move_sector:
 14309                                  
 14310                                  ; The 80386 microprocessor considers an access to WORD 0FFFFh in
 14311                                  ; any segment to be a fault. Theoretically, this could be handled
 14312                                  ; by the fault handler and the behavior of an 8086 could be emulated
 14313                                  ; by wrapping the high byte to offset 0000h. This would be a lot
 14314                                  ; of work and was, indeed, blown off by the Win386 guys. COMPAQ
 14315                                  ; also handles the fault incorrectly in their ROM BIOS for real
 14316                                  ; mode. Their fault handler was only designed to deal with one
 14317                                  ; special case which occurred in a magazine benchmark, but didn't
 14318                                  ; handle the general case worth beans.
 14319                                  ;
 14320                                  ; Simply changing this code to do a byte loop would work okay but
 14321                                  ; would involve a general case performance hit. Therefore, we'll
 14322                                  ; check for either source or destination offsets being within one
 14323                                  ; sector of the end of their segments and only in that case fall
 14324                                  ; back to a byte move.
 14325                                  
 14326 00001390 FC                      		cld
 14327 00001391 51                      		push	cx
 14328 00001392 B90001                  		mov	cx, 256
 14329 00001395 81FE00FE                		cmp	si, 0FE00h
 14330 00001399 770A                    		ja	short movsec_bytes
 14331 0000139B 81FF00FE                		cmp	di, 0FE00h
 14332 0000139F 7704                    		ja	short movsec_bytes
 14333 000013A1 F3A5                    		rep movsw
 14334 000013A3 59                      		pop	cx
 14335 000013A4 C3                      		retn
 14336                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14337                                  
 14338                                  movsec_bytes:
 14339 000013A5 D1E1                    		shl	cx, 1
 14340 000013A7 F3A4                    		rep movsb
 14341 000013A9 59                      		pop	cx
 14342 000013AA C3                      		retn
 14343                                  
 14344                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================

 14346                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14347                                  
 14348                                  ; check_wrap is a routine that adjusts the starting sector, starting head
 14349                                  ; and starting cylinder for an int 13 request that requests i/o of a lot
 14350                                  ; of sectors. it only does this for fixed disks. it is used in the sections
 14351                                  ; of code that handle ecc errors and dma errors. it is necessary, because
 14352                                  ; ordinarily the rom would take care of wraps around heads and cylinders,
 14353                                  ; but we break down a request when we get an ecc or dma error into several
 14354                                  ; i/o of one or more sectors. in this case, we may already be beyond the
 14355                                  ; number of sectors on a track on the medium, and the request would fail.
 14356                                  ;
 14357                                  ; input conditions:
 14358                                  ;	all registers set up for an int 13 request.
 14359                                  ;
 14360                                  ; output:
 14361                                  ;	dh - contains starting head number for request
 14362                                  ;	cx - contains starting sector and cylinder numbers
 14363                                  ;	(the above may or may not have been changed, and are 0-based)
 14364                                  ;	all other registers preserved.
 14365                                  
 14366                                  check_wrap:
 14367 000013AB 50                      		push	ax
 14368 000013AC 53                      		push	bx
 14369 000013AD 06                      		push	es
 14370 000013AE 57                      		push	di
 14371 000013AF E86C00                  		call	find_bds	; get pointer to bds for drive in dl
 14372 000013B2 725E                    		jb	short no_wrap	; finished if DOS doesn't use it
 14373                                  		; 12/12/2022
 14374 000013B4 26F6452301              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 1
 14375                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 1 ; [es:di+BDS.flags],fnon_removable
 14376 000013B9 7457                    		jz	short no_wrap	; no wrapping for removable media
 14377 000013BB 268B5D13                		mov	bx, [es:di+13h]	; [es:di+BDS.secpertrack]
 14378 000013BF 89C8                    		mov	ax, cx
 14379 000013C1 83E03F                  		and	ax, 3Fh		; extract sector number
 14380 000013C4 39D8                    		cmp	ax, bx		; are we going to wrap?
 14381 000013C6 764A                    		jbe	short no_wrap
 14382 000013C8 F6F3                    		div	bl		; ah=new sector	#, al=#	of head	wraps
 14383                                  
 14384                                  ; we need to be careful here. if the new sector # is 0, then we are on the
 14385                                  ; last sector on that track.
 14386                                  
 14387 000013CA 08E4                    		or	ah, ah
 14388 000013CC 7503                    		jnz	short not_on_bound
 14389                                  		; 18/12/2022
 14390 000013CE 48                      		dec	ax ; *
 14391 000013CF 88DC                    		mov	ah, bl		; set sector=BDS_BPB.BPB_SECTORSPERTRACK
 14392                                  					; if on	boundary
 14393                                  		;dec	al ; *		; also decrement # of head wraps
 14394                                  not_on_bound:
 14395 000013D1 80E1C0                  		and	cl, 0C0h	; zero out sector #
 14396 000013D4 08E1                    		or	cl, ah		; or in	new sector #
 14397 000013D6 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah		; ax = # of head wraps
 14398 000013D8 40                      		inc	ax
 14399 000013D9 00F0                    		add	al, dh		; add in starting head #
 14400 000013DB 80D400                  		adc	ah, 0		; catch	any carry
 14401                                  		; 02/09/2023
 14402 000013DE 268B5D15                		mov	bx, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14403 000013E2 39D8                    		cmp	ax, bx
 14404                                  		;cmp	ax, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14405                                  					; are we going to wrap around a	head?
 14406 000013E4 7632                    		jbe	short no_wrap_head ; do	not lose new head number!!
 14407 000013E6 52                      		push	dx		; preserve drive number and head number
 14408 000013E7 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
 14409                                  		;mov	bx, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14410 000013E9 F7F3                    		div	bx		; dx=new head #, ax=# of cylinder wraps
 14411                                  
 14412                                  ; careful here! if new head # is 0, then we are on the last head.
 14413                                  
 14414 000013EB 09D2                    		or	dx, dx
 14415 000013ED 7507                    		jnz	short no_head_bound
 14416 000013EF 89DA                    		mov	dx, bx		; on boundary. set to BDS_BPB.BPB_HEADS
 14417                                  
 14418                                  ; if we had some cylinder wraps, we need to reduce them by one!!
 14419                                  
 14420 000013F1 09C0                    		or	ax, ax
 14421 000013F3 7401                    		jz	short no_head_bound
 14422 000013F5 48                      		dec	ax		; reduce number	of cylinder wraps
 14423                                  no_head_bound:
 14424 000013F6 88D7                    		mov	bh, dl		; bh has new head number
 14425 000013F8 5A                      		pop	dx		; restore drive number and head number
 14426 000013F9 FECF                    		dec	bh		; get it 0-based
 14427 000013FB 88FE                    		mov	dh, bh		; set up new head number in dh
 14428 000013FD 88CF                    		mov	bh, cl
 14429 000013FF 80E73F                  		and	bh, 3Fh		; preserve sector number
 14430 00001402 B306                    		mov	bl, 6
 14431 00001404 86CB                    		xchg	cl, bl
 14432 00001406 D2EB                    		shr	bl, cl		; get ms cylinder bits to ls end
 14433 00001408 00C5                    		add	ch, al		; add in cylinder wrap
 14434 0000140A 10E3                    		adc	bl, ah		; add in high byte
 14435 0000140C D2E3                    		shl	bl, cl		; move up to ms	end
 14436 0000140E 86D9                    		xchg	bl, cl		; restore cylinder bits	into cl
 14437 00001410 08F9                    		or	cl, bh		; or in	sector number
 14438                                  no_wrap:
 14439 00001412 F8                      		clc
 14440 00001413 5F                      		pop	di
 14441 00001414 07                      		pop	es
 14442 00001415 5B                      		pop	bx
 14443 00001416 58                      		pop	ax
 14444 00001417 C3                      		retn
 14445                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14446                                  
 14447                                  no_wrap_head:
 14448 00001418 88C6                    		mov	dh, al		; do not lose new head number
 14449 0000141A FECE                    		dec	dh		; get it 0-based
 14450 0000141C EBF4                    		jmp	short no_wrap

 14456                                  ; this is a special version of the bds lookup code which is
 14457                                  ; based on physical drives rather than the usual logical drives
 14458                                  ; carry is set if the physical drive in dl is found, es:di -> its bds
 14459                                  ; otherwise carry is clear
 14460                                  ;
 14461                                  ; guaranteed to trash no registers except es:di
 14462                                  
 14463                                  		; 19/10/2022

 14466                                  fbds_1:

 14468 00001426 7409                    		jz	short fdbs_2
 14469 00001428 26C43D                  		les	di, [es:di]	; [es:di+BDS.link]
 14470                                  					; go to next bds
 14471 0000142B 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh
 14472 0000142E 75F2                    		jnz	short fbds_1
 14473 00001430 F9                      		stc
 14474                                  fdbs_2:
 14475 00001431 C3                      		retn

 14510                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14511                                  
 14512                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14513                                  
 14514                                  ; this is the true int 13 handler. we parse the request to see if there is
 14515                                  ; a dma violation. if so, depending on the function, we:
 14516                                  ;   read/write break the request into three pieces and move the middle one
 14517                                  ;	       into our internal buffer.
 14518                                  ;
 14519                                  ;   format     copy the format table into the buffer
 14520                                  ;   verify     point the transfer address into the buffer
 14521                                  ;
 14522                                  ; this is the biggest bogosity of all. the ibm controller does not handle
 14523                                  ; operations that cross physical 64k boundaries. in these cases, we copy
 14524                                  ; the offending sector into the buffer below and do the i/o from there.
 14525                                  
 14526                                  ;struc INT13FRAME
 14527                                  ;.oldbp: resw
 14528                                  ;.oldax: resw 
 14529                                  ;.oldbx: resw
 14530                                  ;.oldcx: resw
 14531                                  ;.olddx: resw
 14532                                  ;.oldds: resw	; now we save caller's ds, too
 14533                                  ;.olddd: resd
 14534                                  ;.oldf:	resw
 14535                                  ;end struc
 14536                                  
 14537                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14538                                  
 14539                                  ;   entry conditions:
 14540                                  ;	ah = function
 14541                                  ;	al = number of sectors
 14542                                  ;	es:bx = dma address
 14543                                  ;	cx = packed track and sector
 14544                                  ;	dx = head and drive
 14545                                  ;   output conditions:
 14546                                  ;	no dma violation.
 14547                                  
 14548                                  ;	use extreme caution when working with this code. In general,
 14549                                  ;	  all registers are hot at all times.
 14550                                  ;
 14551                                  ;	question:  does this code handle cases where dma errors
 14552                                  ;	  occur during ecc retries, and where ecc errors occur during
 14553                                  ;	  dma breakdowns???? Hmmmmm.
 14554                                  
 14555                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14556                                  
 14557                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14558                                  
 14559 0000144C 90004000                dtype_array:	dd 400090h		; 40:90	is drive type array
 14560                                  
 14561                                  ; 17/10/2022

 14563                                  ; 09/12/2022

 14748                                  loop_ecc:
