 14750                                  
 14751                                  ; we do reads one sector at a time. this ensures that we will eventually
 14752                                  ; finish the request since ecc errors on one sector do read in that sector.
 14753                                  ;
 14754                                  ; we need to put in some "intelligence" into the ecc handler to handle reads
 14755                                  ; that attempt to read more sectors than are available on a particular
 14756                                  ; track.
 14757                                  ;
 14758                                  ; we call check_wrap to set up the sector #, head # and cylinder # for
 14759                                  ; this request.
 14760                                  ;
 14761                                  ; at this point, all registers are set up for the call to orig13, except
 14762                                  ; that there may be a starting sector number that is bigger than the number
 14763                                  ; of sectors on a track.
 14764                                  ;
 14765 00001519 E88FFE                  		call	check_wrap	; get correct parameters for int 13
 14766                                  		;;call	far 70:797h ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS BIOSCODE:15C5h
 14767                                  		; 17/10/2022
 14768 0000151C 9A[8E07]7000            		call	DOSBIOSSEG:call_orig13
 14769                                  		;call	call_orig13	; call far KERNEL_SEGMENT:call_orig13
 14770 00001521 730C                    		jnb	short ok11_op
 14771 00001523 80FC09                  		cmp	ah, 9		; DMA error during ECC read?
 14772 00001526 741B                    		jz	short handle_dma_during_ecc
 14773 00001528 80FC11                  		cmp	ah, 11h		; only allow ecc errors
 14774 0000152B 7510                    		jnz	short ok11_exit_err
 14775                                  		; 10/12/2022
 14776                                  		; xor ax ax -> ah = 0
 14777                                  		;mov	ah, 0		; ecc error. reset the system again.
 14778 0000152D 31C0                    		xor	ax, ax		; clear	the error code so that if this
 14779                                  					; was the last sector, no error	code
 14780                                  					; will be returned for the corrected
 14781                                  					; read.	(clear carry too.)
 14782                                  ok11_op:
 14783 0000152F FE0E[2000]              		dec	byte [number_of_sec]
 14784 00001533 7409                    		jz	short ok11_exit	; all done?
 14785 00001535 FEC1                    		inc	cl		; advance sector number
 14786                                  					; add 200h to address
 14787 00001537 FEC7                    		inc	bh
 14788 00001539 FEC7                    		inc	bh
 14789 0000153B EBD9                    		jmp	short loop_ecc
 14790                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14791                                  
 14792                                  ; locate error returns centrally
 14793                                  
 14794                                  ok11_exit_err:
 14795 0000153D F9                      		stc			; set carry bit again.
 14796                                  ok11_exit:
 14797 0000153E 5A                      		pop	dx
 14798 0000153F 59                      		pop	cx
 14799 00001540 5B                      		pop	bx
 14800 00001541 EB88                    		jmp	short i13ret_ck_chglinerr
 14801                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14802                                  
 14803                                  ; do the single sector read again, this time into our temporary
 14804                                  ; buffer, which is guaranteed not to have a DMA error, then
 14805                                  ; move the data to its proper location and proceed
 14806                                  
 14807                                  handle_dma_during_ecc:
 14808 00001543 06                      		push	es
 14809 00001544 53                      		push	bx
 14810 00001545 BB[4E01]                		mov	bx, disksector
 14811 00001548 1E                      		push	ds
 14812 00001549 07                      		pop	es		; point es:bx to buffer
 14813 0000154A B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h	; read one sector
 14814                                  		;;call	far 70:797h ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS BIOSCODE:15F8h
 14815                                  		; 17/10/2022
 14816 0000154D 9A[8E07]7000            		call	DOSBIOSSEG:call_orig13
 14817                                  		;call	call_orig13	; call far KERNEL_SEGMENT:call_orig13
 14818 00001552 5B                      		pop	bx
 14819 00001553 07                      		pop	es
 14820 00001554 7305                    		jnb	short handle_dma_during_ecc_noerr
 14821 00001556 80FC11                  		cmp	ah, 11h
 14822 00001559 75E2                    		jnz	short ok11_exit_err ; if anything but ecc error, bomb out
 14823                                  
 14824                                  ; now we're kosher. Copy the data to where it belongs and resume
 14825                                  ; the ECC looping code.
 14826                                  
 14827                                  handle_dma_during_ecc_noerr:
 14828 0000155B 56                      		push	si
 14829 0000155C 57                      		push	di
 14830 0000155D 89DF                    		mov	di, bx
 14831 0000155F BE[4E01]                		mov	si, disksector
 14832 00001562 E82BFE                  		call	move_sector
 14833 00001565 5F                      		pop	di
 14834 00001566 5E                      		pop	si
 14835 00001567 EBC6                    		jmp	short ok11_op
 14836                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14837                                  
 14838                                  ; we truly have a dma violation. restore register ax and retry the
 14839                                  ; operation as best we can.
 14840                                  
 14841                                  gotdmaerr:
 14842 00001569 A1[1E00]                		mov	ax, [prevoper]	; 19/10/2022
 14843 0000156C FB                      		sti
 14844 0000156D 80FC02                  		cmp	ah, 2		; romread
 14845 00001570 723B                    		jb	short i13_done_dmaerr
 14846                                  					; just pass dma error thru for
 14847                                  					; functions we don't handle
 14848 00001572 80FC04                  		cmp	ah, 4		; romverify
 14849 00001575 743C                    		jz	short intverify
 14850 00001577 80FC05                  		cmp	ah, 5		; romformat
 14851 0000157A 7448                    		jz	short intformat
 14852 0000157C 772F                    		ja	short i13_done_dmaerr
 14853                                  
 14854                                  ; we are doing a read/write call. check for dma problems
 14855                                  
 14856                                  ;	******** set up stack frame here!!! ********
 14857                                  
 14858 0000157E 52                      		push	dx
 14859 0000157F 51                      		push	cx
 14860 00001580 53                      		push	bx
 14861 00001581 50                      		push	ax
 14862 00001582 55                      		push	bp
 14863 00001583 89E5                    		mov	bp, sp
 14864 00001585 8CC2                    		mov	dx, es		; check	for 64k	boundary error
 14865 00001587 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 14866 00001589 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 14867 0000158B D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 14868 0000158D D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1		; segment converted to absolute	address
 14869 0000158F 01DA                    		add	dx, bx		; combine with offset
 14870 00001591 81C2FF01                		add	dx, 511		; simulate a transfer
 14871                                  
 14872                                  ; if carry is set, then we are within 512 bytes of the end of the segment.
 14873                                  ; we skip the first transfer and perform the remaining buffering and transfer
 14874                                  
 14875 00001595 7303                    		jnb	short no_skip_first
 14876 00001597 E98300                  		jmp	bufferx		; restore dh=head & do buffer
 14877                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14878                                  
 14879                                  no_skip_first:
 14880 0000159A D0EE                    		shr	dh, 1		; dh = number of sectors before	address
 14881 0000159C B480                    		mov	ah, 128		; ah = max number of sectors in	segment
 14882 0000159E 28F4                    		sub	ah, dh
 14883                                  
 14884                                  ; ah is now the number of sectors that we can successfully write in this
 14885                                  ; segment. if this number is above or equal to the requested number, then we
 14886                                  ; continue the operation as normal. otherwise, we break it into pieces.
 14887                                  ;
 14888                                  ; wait a sec. this is goofy. the whole reason we got here in the
 14889                                  ; first place is because we got a dma error. so it's impossible
 14890                                  ; for the whole block to fit, unless the dma error was returned
 14891                                  ; in error.
 14892                                  
 14893 000015A0 38C4                    		cmp	ah, al		; can we fit it	in?
 14894 000015A2 7236                    		jb	short doblock	; no, perform blocking.
 14895                                  
 14896                                  ; yes, the request fits. let it happen.
 14897                                  
 14898 000015A4 8A7609                  		mov	dh, [bp+9]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx+1]
 14899                                  					; set up head number
 14900 000015A7 E888FE                  		call	doint
 14901 000015AA E9D900                  		jmp	bad13		; and return from this place
 14902                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14903                                  
 14904                                  i13_done_dmaerr:
 14905 000015AD B409                    		mov	ah, 9		; pass dma error thru to caller
 14906 000015AF F9                      		stc
 14907 000015B0 E914FF                  		jmp	ret_from_i13	; return with error,
 14908                                  					; we know it's not a changeline error
 14909                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14910                                  
 14911                                  ; verify the given sectors. place the buffer pointer into our space.
 14912                                  
 14913                                  intverify:
 14914 000015B3 06                      		push	es		; save caller's dma address
 14915 000015B4 53                      		push	bx
 14916 000015B5 1E                      		push	ds		; es:bx	-> Bios_Data:disksector
 14917 000015B6 07                      		pop	es
 14918                                  dosimple:
 14919 000015B7 BB[4E01]                		mov	bx, disksector
 14920                                  					; do the i/o from Bios_Data:disksector
 14921                                  		;;call	far 70:797h ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS BIOSCODE:1665h
 14922                                  		; 17/10/2022
 14923 000015BA 9A[8E07]7000            		call	DOSBIOSSEG:call_orig13
 14924                                  		;call	call_orig13	; call far KERNEL_SEGMENT:call_orig13
 14925 000015BF 5B                      		pop	bx
 14926 000015C0 07                      		pop	es
 14927 000015C1 E907FF                  		jmp	i13ret_ck_chglinerr
 14928                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14929                                  
 14930                                  ; format operation. copy the parameter table into Bios_Data:disksector
 14931                                  
 14932                                  intformat:
 14933 000015C4 06                      		push	es
 14934 000015C5 53                      		push	bx
 14935 000015C6 56                      		push	si
 14936 000015C7 57                      		push	di
 14937 000015C8 1E                      		push	ds
 14938                                  
 14939                                  ; point ds to the caller's dma buffer, es to Bios_Data
 14940                                  ; in other words, swap (ds, es)
 14941                                  
 14942 000015C9 06                      		push	es
 14943 000015CA 1E                      		push	ds
 14944 000015CB 07                      		pop	es
 14945 000015CC 1F                      		pop	ds
 14946 000015CD 89DE                    		mov	si, bx
 14947 000015CF BF[4E01]                		mov	di, disksector
 14948 000015D2 E8BBFD                  		call	move_sector	; user's data into Bios_Data:disksector
 14949 000015D5 1F                      		pop	ds
 14950 000015D6 5F                      		pop	di
 14951 000015D7 5E                      		pop	si		; do the i/o from
 14952 000015D8 EBDD                    		jmp	short dosimple	; Bios_Data:disksector
 14953                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14954                                  
 14955                                  ; we can't fit the request into the entire block. perform the operation on
 14956                                  ; the first block.
 14957                                  ;
 14958                                  ; doblock is modified to correctly handle multi-sector disk i/o.
 14959                                  ; old doblock had added the number of sectors i/oed (ah in old doblock) after
 14960                                  ; the doint call to cl. observing only the lower 6 bits of cl(=max. 64) can
 14961                                  ; represent a starting sector, if ah was big, then cl would be clobbered.
 14962                                  ; by the way, we still are going to use cl for this purpose since checkwrap
 14963                                  ; routine will use it as an input. to prevent cl from being clobbered, a
 14964                                  ; safe number of sectors should be calculated like "63 - # of sectors/track".
 14965                                  ; doblock will handle the first block of requested sectors within the
 14966                                  ; boundary of this safe value.
 14967                                  
 14968                                  doblock:
 14969                                  
 14970                                  ; try to get the # of sectors/track from bds via rom drive number.
 14971                                  ; for any mini disks installed, here we have to pray that they have the
 14972                                  ; same # of sector/track as the main dos partition disk drive.
 14973                                  				
 14974 000015DA 8B5608                  		mov	dx, [bp+8]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 14975                                  					; get head #, drive #
 14976 000015DD 51                      		push	cx
 14977 000015DE 06                      		push	es
 14978 000015DF 57                      		push	di		; ah - # of sectors before dma boundary
 14979                                  					; al - requested # of sectors for i/o.
 14980 000015E0 E83BFE                  		call	find_bds
 14981 000015E3 268B4D13                		mov	cx, [es:di+13h]	; [es:di+BDS.secpertrack]
 14982                                  		; 12/12/2022
 14983 000015E7 26F6452301              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 1
 14984                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 1 ; [es:di+BDS.flags],fnon_removable
 14985 000015EC 5F                      		pop	di
 14986 000015ED 07                      		pop	es
 14987 000015EE 88E0                    		mov	al, ah		; set al=ah for	floppies
 14988 000015F0 7404                    		jz	short doblockflop ; they are track by track operation
 14989 000015F2 B43F                    		mov	ah, 63		; ah = 63-secpt	(# safe	sectors??)
 14990 000015F4 28CC                    		sub	ah, cl		; al - # of sectors before dma boundary
 14991                                  doblockflop:
 14992 000015F6 59                      		pop	cx
 14993                                  doblockcontinue:
 14994 000015F7 38C4                    		cmp	ah, al		; if safe_# >= #_of_sectors_to_go_before dma,
 14995 000015F9 7305                    		jnb	short doblocklast ; then #_of_sectors_to_go as it is for doint.
 14996 000015FB 50                      		push	ax
 14997 000015FC 88E0                    		mov	al, ah		; otherwise, set al to ah to operate.
 14998 000015FE EB03                    		jmp	short doblockdoint
 14999                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15000                                  
 15001                                  doblocklast:
 15002 00001600 88C4                    		mov	ah, al
 15003 00001602 50                      		push	ax
 15004                                  doblockdoint:				; let ah = al =	# of sectors for this shot
 15005 00001603 E82CFE                  		call	doint
 15006 00001606 727E                    		jb	short bad13	; something happened, bye!
 15007 00001608 58                      		pop	ax
 15008 00001609 286602                  		sub	[bp+2],	ah	; sub [bp+INT13FRAME.oldax], ah
 15009                                  					; decrement by the successful operation
 15010 0000160C 00E1                    		add	cl, ah		; advance sector #. safety gauranteed.
 15011 0000160E 00E7                    		add	bh, ah		; advance dma addres
 15012 00001610 00E7                    		add	bh, ah		; twice	for 512	byte sectors
 15013 00001612 38C4                    		cmp	ah, al		; check	the previous value
 15014 00001614 740A                    		jz	short buffer	; if #_of_sectors_to_go	< safe_#,
 15015                                  					; then we are done already.
 15016 00001616 28E0                    		sub	al, ah		; otherwise,
 15017                                  					; #_sector_to_go = #_of_sector_to_go - safe_#
 15018 00001618 E890FD                  		call	check_wrap	; get new cx, dh for the next operation.
 15019 0000161B EBDA                    		jmp	short doblockcontinue ;	handles	next sectors left.
 15020                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15021                                  
 15022                                  bufferx:
 15023 0000161D 8A7609                  		mov	dh, [bp+9]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx+1]
 15024                                  					; set up head number
 15025                                  buffer:
 15026 00001620 53                      		push	bx
 15027 00001621 8A6603                  		mov	ah, [bp+3]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.oldax+1]
 15028 00001624 80FC03                  		cmp	ah, 3		; romwrite
 15029 00001627 7525                    		jnz	short doread	;
 15030                                  
 15031                                  ; copy the offending sector into local buffer
 15032                                  
 15033 00001629 06                      		push	es
 15034 0000162A 1E                      		push	ds
 15035 0000162B 56                      		push	si
 15036 0000162C 57                      		push	di
 15037 0000162D 1E                      		push	ds		; exchange segment registers
 15038 0000162E 06                      		push	es
 15039 0000162F 1F                      		pop	ds
 15040 00001630 07                      		pop	es
 15041 00001631 BF[4E01]                		mov	di, disksector	; where to move
 15042 00001634 57                      		push	di		; save it
 15043 00001635 89DE                    		mov	si, bx		; source
 15044 00001637 E856FD                  		call	move_sector	; move sector into local buffer
 15045 0000163A 5B                      		pop	bx		; new transfer address
 15046                                  					; (es:bx = Bios_Data:diskbuffer)
 15047 0000163B 5F                      		pop	di		; restore caller's di & si
 15048 0000163C 5E                      		pop	si
 15049 0000163D 1F                      		pop	ds		; restore Bios_Data
 15050                                  
 15051                                  ; see if we are wrapping around a track or head
 15052                                  
 15053 0000163E B001                    		mov	al, 1		; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 15054                                  					; get drive number
 15055 00001640 8A5608                  		mov	dl, [bp+8]
 15056 00001643 E865FD                  		call	check_wrap	; sets up registers if wrap-around
 15057                                  					;
 15058                                  					; ah is	function
 15059                                  					; al is	1 for single sector transfer
 15060                                  					; es:bx	is local transfer addres
 15061                                  					; cx is	track/sector number
 15062                                  					; dx is	head/drive number
 15063                                  					; si,di	unchanged
 15064 00001646 E8E9FD                  		call	doint
 15065 00001649 07                      		pop	es		; restore caller's dma segment
 15066 0000164A 723A                    		jb	short bad13	; go clean up
 15067 0000164C EB22                    		jmp	short dotail
 15068                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15069                                  
 15070                                  ; reading a sector. do int first, then move things around
 15071                                  
 15072                                  doread:
 15073 0000164E 06                      		push	es
 15074 0000164F 53                      		push	bx
 15075 00001650 1E                      		push	ds		; es = Bios_Code
 15076 00001651 07                      		pop	es
 15077 00001652 BB[4E01]                		mov	bx, disksector
 15078 00001655 B001                    		mov	al, 1
 15079 00001657 8A5608                  		mov	dl, [bp+8]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 15080                                  					; get drive number
 15081 0000165A E84EFD                  		call	check_wrap	;
 15082                                  					; ah = function
 15083                                  					; al = 1 for single sector
 15084                                  					; es:bx	points to local	buffer
 15085                                  					; cx, dx are track/sector, head/drive
 15086 0000165D E8D2FD                  		call	doint
 15087 00001660 5B                      		pop	bx
 15088 00001661 07                      		pop	es
 15089 00001662 7222                    		jb	short bad13
 15090 00001664 56                      		push	si
 15091 00001665 57                      		push	di
 15092 00001666 89DF                    		mov	di, bx
 15093 00001668 BE[4E01]                		mov	si, disksector
 15094 0000166B E822FD                  		call	move_sector
 15095 0000166E 5F                      		pop	di
 15096 0000166F 5E                      		pop	si
 15097                                  
 15098                                  ; note the fact that we've done 1 more sector
 15099                                  
 15100                                  dotail:
 15101 00001670 5B                      		pop	bx		; retrieve new dma area
 15102 00001671 80C702                  		add	bh, 2		; advance over sector
 15103 00001674 41                      		inc	cx
 15104 00001675 8A4602                  		mov	al, [bp+2]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.oldax]
 15105 00001678 F8                      		clc
 15106 00001679 FEC8                    		dec	al
 15107 0000167B 7409                    		jz	short bad13	; no more i/o
 15108                                  
 15109                                  ; see if we wrap around a track or head boundary with starting sector
 15110                                  ; we already have the correct head number to pass to check_wrap
 15111                                  
 15112 0000167D 8A5608                  		mov	dl, [bp+8]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 15113 00001680 E828FD                  		call	check_wrap
 15114 00001683 E8ACFD                  		call	doint
 15115                                  
 15116                                  ; we are done. ax has the final code; we throw away what we got before
 15117                                  
 15118                                  ; M046  -- okay gang. Now we've either terminated our DMA loop,
 15119                                  ;	   or we've finished. If carry is set now, our only
 15120                                  ;	   hope for salvation is that it was a read operation
 15121                                  ;	   and the error code is ECC error. In that case, we'll
 15122                                  ;	   just pop the registers and go do the old ECC thing.
 15123                                  ;	   When the DMA error that got us here in the first
 15124                                  ;	   place occurs, it'll handle it.
 15125                                  
 15126                                  bad13:
 15127 00001686 89EC                    		mov	sp, bp
 15128 00001688 5D                      		pop	bp
 15129 00001689 5B                      		pop	bx
 15130 0000168A 5B                      		pop	bx
 15131 0000168B 59                      		pop	cx
 15132 0000168C 5A                      		pop	dx
 15133 0000168D 7203                    		jb	short xgoterr13_xxxx ; go handle ECC errors
 15134 0000168F E935FE                  		jmp	ret_from_i13	; non-error exit
 15135                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15136                                  
 15137                                  xgoterr13_xxxx:
 15138 00001692 E958FE                  		jmp	goterr13_xxxx
 15139                                  
 15140                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15141                                  		; 10/12/2022
 15142                                  		;db 	0
 15143                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15144                                  
 15145                                  ;Bios_Code ends

 15155                                  dsk_init:				; 2C7h:1742h = 70h:3CB2h
 15156 00001695 8A26[7500]              		mov	ah, [drvmax]
 15157 00001699 BF[7E06]                		mov	di, dskdrvs
 15158 0000169C 1E                      		push	ds		; pass result in es:di
 15159 0000169D 07                      		pop	es
 15160 0000169E E912EF                  		jmp	SetPtrSav
 15161                                  
 15162                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 15163                                  
 15164                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15165                                  ; install_bds installs a bds at location es:di into the current linked list of
 15166                                  ; bds maintained by this device driver. it places the bds at the end of the
 15167                                  ; list. Trashes (at least) ax, bx, di, si
 15168                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15169                                  
 15170                                  install_bds:		
 15171 000016A1 1E                      		push	ds		; save Bios_Data segment
 15172 000016A2 BE[1901]                		mov	si, start_bds	; beginning of chain
 15173                                  
 15174                                  		; ds:si now points to link to first bds
 15175                                  		; assume bds list is non-empty
 15176                                  loop_next_bds:				
 15177 000016A5 C534                    		lds	si, [si]	; [si+BDS.link]
 15178                                  					; fetch	next bds
 15179 000016A7 268A4504                		mov	al, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 15180 000016AB 384404                  		cmp	[si+4],	al	; does this one	share a	physical
 15181                                  					; drive	with new one?
 15182 000016AE 7518                    		jnz	short next_bds
 15183 000016B0 B310                    		mov	bl, 10h		; fi_am_mult
 15184 000016B2 26085D23                		or	[es:di+23h], bl	; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 15185                                  					; set both of them to i_am_mult	if so
 15186 000016B6 085C23                  		or	[si+23h], bl	; [si+BDS.flags]
 15187 000016B9 26806523DF              		and	byte [es:di+23h], 0DFh ; [es:di+BDS.flags],~fi_own_physical
 15188                                  					; we don't own it
 15189 000016BE 8A5C23                  		mov	bl, [si+23h]	; [si+BDS.flags]
 15190                                  					; determine if changeline available
 15191 000016C1 80E302                  		and	bl, 2		; fchangeline
 15192 000016C4 26085D23                		or	[es:di+23h], bl	; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 15193                                  next_bds:				
 15194                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1)
 15195 000016C8 B8FFFF                  		mov	ax, 0FFFFh	; -1
 15196 000016CB 3904                    		cmp	[si], ax	; [si+BDS.link],-1
 15197                                  		;cmp	word [si], 0FFFFh ; [si+BDS.link],-1
 15198                                  					; are we at end	of list?
 15199 000016CD 75D6                    		jnz	short loop_next_bds

 15367                                  ; if a different drive is accessed after the current one. in order to avoid

 15411                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15412                                  
 15413                                  ; simple, quick check of latched change. if no indication, then return
 15414                                  ; otherwise do expensive check. if the expensive test fails, pop off the
 15415                                  ; return and set al = 15 (for invalid media change) which will be returned to
 15416                                  ; dos.
 15417                                  ;
 15418                                  ; for dos 3.3, this will work only for the drive that has changeline.
 15419                                  
 15420                                  ;	call with es:di -> bds, ds -> Bios_Data

 15422                                  ;			if an error occurs!
 15423                                  
 15424                                  checklatchio:

 15456                                  ; only if there was a disk error. return that error code in ax.

 15467                                  		; fall into check_vid

 15469                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 15470                                  
 15471                                  ; now with the extended boot record, the logic should be enhanced.
 15472                                  ;

 15474                                  ; number instead of volume id. if it is different, then set si to -1.
 15475                                  ;

 15479                                  ; logic. dos 4.00 will check if the # of fat in the boot record bpb

 15481                                  ; should have already covered by extended boot structure checking.

 15485                                  ; (this will be gauranteed by a successful getbp call right before this

 15533                                  ; extended id check
 15534                                  
 15535                                  ; 16/10/2022
 15536                                  
 15537                                  ; the code to check extended id is basically a check to see if the
 15538                                  ; volume serial number is still the same. the volume serial number
 15539                                  ; previously read is in cs:disksector.EXT_BOOT_SERIAL
 15540                                  ; ds:di points to the bds of the drive under consideration.
 15541                                  ; the bds has fields containing the high and low words 
 15542                                  ; of the volume serial number of the media in the drive.
 15543                                  ; compare these fields to the fields mentioned above. if these fields
 15544                                  ; do not match the media has changed and so we should jump to the code
 15545                                  ; starting at ext_changed else return "i don't know" status
 15546                                  ; in the register used for the changeline status and continue executing
 15547                                  ; the code given below. for temporary storage use the register which
 15548                                  ; has been saved and restored around this block.
 15549                                  ;
 15550                                  ; bds fields in inc\msbds.inc
 15551                                  
 15552                                  		; 19/10/2022
 15553                                  do_ext_check_id:
 15554 000017FD 50                      		push	ax
 15555                                  		;mov	ax, word ptr ds:disksector+27h
 15556                                  					; [DiskSector+EXT_BOOT.SERIAL]

 15561 00001807 750C                    		jnz	short ext_changed

 15579                                  		; ('changed_drv' clears cf)

 15631                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15632                                  
 15633                                  ; moves the pointer to the volid for the drive into the original request packet
 15634                                  ; no attempt is made to preserve registers.

 15652 0000184B C51E[1200]              		lds	bx, [ptrsav]

 15661                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15662                                  
 15663                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15664                                  ;   hidensity - examine a drive/media descriptor to set the media type. if
 15665                                  ;   the media descriptor is not f9 (not 96tpi or 3 1/2), we return and let the
 15666                                  ;   caller do the rest. otherwise, we pop off the return and jump to the tail
 15667                                  ;   of getbp. for 3.5" media, we just return.
 15668                                  ;
 15669                                  ;   inputs:	es:di point to correct bds for this drive
 15670                                  ;		ah has media byte
 15671                                  ;
 15672                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear
 15673                                  ;		    no registers modified
 15674                                  ;		carry set
 15675                                  ;		    al = sectors/fat

 15748                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15749                                  ; set_changed_dl - sets flag bits according to bits set in bx.
 15750                                  ;		   essentially used to indicate changeline, or format.
 15751                                  ;
 15752                                  ;   inputs:	dl contains physical drive number
 15753                                  ;		bx contains bits to set in the flag field in the bdss
 15754                                  ;   outputs:	none
 15755                                  ;   registers modified: flags
 15756                                  ;
 15757                                  ;	called from int13 hooker.  Must preserve ALL registers!!!
 15758                                  ;
 15759                                  ; in the virtual drive system we *must* flag the other drives as being changed
 15760                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15761                                  
 15762                                  set_changed_dl:
 15763 0000188E 06                      		push	es
 15764 0000188F 57                      		push	di
 15765                                  		;les	di, ds:start_bds
 15766                                  		; 19/10/2022
 15767 00001890 C43E[1901]              		les	di, [start_bds]
 15768                                  
 15769                                  ; note: we assume that the list is non-empty
 15770                                  
 15771                                  scan_bds:
 15772 00001894 26385504                		cmp	[es:di+4], dl	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 15773 00001898 7504                    		jnz	short get_next_bds
 15774                                  
 15775                                  ; someone may complain, but this *always* must be done when a disk change is
 15776                                  ; noted. there are *no* other compromising circumstances.
 15777                                  
 15778 0000189A 26095D23                		or	[es:di+23h], bx	; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 15779                                  					; signal change	on other drive
 15780                                  get_next_bds:
 15781 0000189E 26C43D                  		les	di, [es:di]	; [es:di+BDS.link]
 15782                                  					; go to	next bds
 15783 000018A1 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh
 15784 000018A4 75EE                    		jnz	short scan_bds	; loop unless we hit end of chain
 15785 000018A6 5F                      		pop	di
 15786 000018A7 07                      		pop	es
 15787 000018A8 C3                      		retn

 15849                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15850                                  ; set_volume_id      -	main routine, calls other routines.
 15851                                  ; read_volume_id     -	read the volume id and tells if it has been changed.
 15852                                  ; transfer_volume_id -	copy the volume id from tmp to special drive.
 15853                                  ; check_volume_id    -	compare volume id in tmp area with one expected for drive.
 15854                                  ; fat_check          -	see of the fatid has changed in the specified drive.
 15855                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15856                                  
 15857                                  ; set_volume_id
 15858                                  ;   if drive has changeline support, read in and set the volume_id
 15859                                  ; and the last fat_id byte. if no change line support then do nothing.
 15860                                  ;
 15861                                  ;   on entry:
 15862                                  ;	es:di points to the bds for this disk.
 15863                                  ;	ah contains media byte
 15864                                  ;
 15865                                  ;   on exit:
 15866                                  ;	carry clear:
 15867                                  ;	   successful call
 15868                                  ;	carry set
 15869                                  ;	   error and ax has error code
 15870                                  
 15871                                  set_volume_id:
 15872 000018BB 52                      		push	dx		; save registers
 15873 000018BC 50                      		push	ax
 15874 000018BD E8F5FF                  		call	haschange	; does drive have changeline support?
 15875 000018C0 740B                    		jz	short setvret	; no, get out
 15876 000018C2 E81000                  		call	read_volume_id
 15877 000018C5 7209                    		jb	short seterr
 15878 000018C7 E8A800                  		call	transfer_volume_id ; copy the volume id	to special drive
 15879 000018CA E8E2FF                  		call	resetchanged	; restore value	of change line
 15880                                  setvret:
 15881                                  		; 10/12/2022
 15882                                  		; cf = 0
 15883                                  		;clc			; no error, clear carry flag
 15884 000018CD 58                      		pop	ax		; restore registers
 15885 000018CE 5A                      		pop	dx
 15886 000018CF C3                      		retn
 15887                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15888                                  
 15889                                  seterr:
 15890 000018D0 5A                      		pop	dx		; pop stack but don't overwrite ax
 15891 000018D1 5A                      		pop	dx		; restore dx
 15892 000018D2 C3                      		retn
 15893                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15894 000018D3 0000                    root_sec:	dw 0			; root sector #
 15895

 15901                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================

 15903                                  ; 16/10/2022
 15904                                  
 15905                                  ; read_volume_id read the volume id and tells if it has been changed.
 15906                                  ;
 15907                                  ;   on entry:
 15908                                  ;	es:di points to current bds for drive.
 15909                                  ;
 15910                                  ;   on exit:
 15911                                  ;	carry clear
 15912                                  ;	    si = 1  no change
 15913                                  ;	    si = 0  ?
 15914                                  ;	    si = -1 change
 15915                                  ;
 15916                                  ;	carry set:
 15917                                  ;	    error and ax has error code.
 15918                                  
 15919                                  read_volume_id:
 15920 000018D5 52                      		push	dx		; preserve registers
 15921 000018D6 51                      		push	cx
 15922 000018D7 53                      		push	bx
 15923 000018D8 50                      		push	ax
 15924 000018D9 06                      		push	es		; stack the bds last
 15925 000018DA 57                      		push	di
 15926 000018DB 1E                      		push	ds		; point es to Bios_Data
 15927 000018DC 07                      		pop	es
 15928 000018DD BF[0009]                		mov	di, tmp_vid	; "NO NAME	 "
 15929 000018E0 BE[F408]                		mov	si, nul_vid	; "NO NAME	 "
 15930 000018E3 B90C00                  		mov	cx, 12		; initialize tmp_vid to	null vi_id
 15931 000018E6 F3A4                    		rep movsb
 15932 000018E8 5F                      		pop	di
 15933 000018E9 07                      		pop	es
 15934 000018EA 268A450B                		mov	al, [es:di+11]	; [es:di+BDS.fats]
 15935                                  					; # of fats
 15936 000018EE 268B4D11                		mov	cx, [es:di+17]	; [es:di+BDS.fatsecs]
 15937                                  					; sectors / fat
 15938 000018F2 F6E1                    		mul	cl		; size taken by	fats
 15939 000018F4 26034509                		add	ax, [es:di+9]	; [es:di+BDS.resectors]
 15940                                  					; add on reserved sectors
 15941                                  					;
 15942                                  					; ax is	now sector # (0	based)
 15943                                  		; 17/10/2022
 15944 000018F8 2EA3[D318]              		mov	[cs:ROOTSEC], ax
 15945                                  		;mov	word ptr cs:198Fh, ax ; [cs:root_sec]
 15946                                  					; 0070h:3EFFh =	2C7h:198Fh
 15947 000018FC 268B450C                		mov	ax, [es:di+12]	; [es:di+BDS.direntries]
 15948                                  					; # root dir entries
 15949 00001900 B104                    		mov	cl, 4		; 16 entries/sector
 15950 00001902 D3E8                    		shr	ax, cl		; divide by 16
 15951                                  		;mov	cx, ax		; cx is	# of sectors to	scan
 15952                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1, one byte opcode)
 15953 00001904 91                      		xchg	ax, cx		; cx is	# of sectors to	scan
 15954                                  next_sec:				
 15955 00001905 51                      		push	cx		; save outer loop counter
 15956 00001906 2EA1[D318]              		mov	ax, [cs:ROOTSEC]
 15957                                  		;mov	ax, word ptr cs:198Fh ; [cs:root_sec]
 15958                                  					; get sector #
 15959 0000190A 268B4D13                		mov	cx, [es:di+19]	; [es:di+BDS.secpertrack]
 15960                                  					; sectors / track
 15961 0000190E 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
 15962 00001910 F7F1                    		div	cx
 15963                                  
 15964                                  ; set up registers for call to read_sector
 15965                                  
 15966 00001912 42                      		inc	dx		; dx= sectors into track
 15967                                  					; ax= track count from 0
 15968 00001913 88D1                    		mov	cl, dl		; sector to read
 15969 00001915 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
 15970 00001917 26F77515                		div	word [es:di+21] ; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 15971                                  					; # heads on this disc
 15972 0000191B 88D6                    		mov	dh, dl		; head number
 15973 0000191D 88C5                    		mov	ch, al		; track	#
 15974 0000191F E848EE                  		call	read_sector	; get first sector of the root directory,
 15975                                  					; ds:bx	-> directory sector
 15976 00001922 723F                    		jb	short readviderr
 15977 00001924 B91000                  		mov	cx, 16		; # of dir entries in a	block of root
 15978 00001927 B008                    		mov	al, 8		; volume label bit
 15979                                  fvid_loop:
 15980                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1)
 15981 00001929 382F                    		cmp	[bx], ch ; 0
 15982                                  		;cmp	byte [bx], 0 ; end of dir?
 15983 0000192B 7433                    		jz	short no_vid	; yes, no vol id
 15984 0000192D 803FE5                  		cmp	byte [bx], 0E5h ; empty entry?
 15985 00001930 7405                    		jz	short ent_loop	; yes, skip
 15986 00001932 84470B                  		test	[bx+11], al	; is volume label bit set in fcb?
 15987 00001935 750F                    		jnz	short found_vid	; jmp yes
 15988                                  ent_loop:				
 15989 00001937 83C320                  		add	bx, 32		; add length of	directory entry
 15990 0000193A E2ED                    		loop	fvid_loop
 15991 0000193C 59                      		pop	cx		; outer loop
 15992 0000193D 2EFF06[D318]            		inc	word [cs:ROOTSEC]
 15993                                  		;inc	word ptr cs:198Fh ; inc word [root_sec]
 15994                                  					; next sector
 15995 00001942 E2C1                    		loop	next_sec	; continue
 15996                                  notfound:
 15997                                  		; 02/09/2023
 15998                                  		;xor	si, si
 15999 00001944 EB13                    		jmp	short fvid_ret
 16000                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16001                                  
 16002                                  found_vid:
 16003                                  		; 02/09/2023
 16004                                  		; cf = 0  ('test' instruction clears cf)
 16005 00001946 59                      		pop	cx		; clean stack of outer loop counter
 16006 00001947 89DE                    		mov	si, bx		; point	to volume_id
 16007 00001949 06                      		push	es		; preserve current bds
 16008 0000194A 57                      		push	di
 16009 0000194B 1E                      		push	ds
 16010 0000194C 07                      		pop	es		; point es to Bios_Data
 16011 0000194D BF[0009]                		mov	di, tmp_vid	; "NO NAME	 "
 16012 00001950 B90B00                  		mov	cx, 11		; VOLID_SIZ-1
 16013                                  					; length of string minus nul

 16015                                  		;xor	al, al

 16018 00001956 AA                      		stosb			; null terminate
 16019                                  		;;xor	si, si
 16020                                  		; 02/09/2023
 16021                                  		;xchg	ax, si		; si = 0
 16022 00001957 5F                      		pop	di		; restore current bds
 16023 00001958 07                      		pop	es
 16024                                  fvid_ret:
 16025                                  		; 02/09/2023

 16027

 16219                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 16221                                  ; source code by Microsoft, 1991 
 16222                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16223                                  ; Derived from 'SYSINIT.ASM' file of MSDOS 2.0 (IBM PCDOS v2.0) source code

 16226                                  ; main file: 'retrodos4.s'
 16227                                  ; incbin 'SYSINIT3.BIN' ; (SYINITSEG)

 16229                                  ; 21/10/2022
 16230                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16231                                  ; This source code (version) is based on SYSINIT source code of disassembled
 16232                                  ; MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS file (SYSINIT.BIN) 
 16233                                  ; Dissassembler: Hex-Rays Interactive Disassembler (IDA)
 16234                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16235                                  ; Binary file splitter & joiner: FFSJ v3.3
 16236                                  
 16237                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------
 16238                                  ; SYSINIT.TXT (27/01/1983)
 16239                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------
 16240                                  ;    SYSINIT is  a module linked behind the OEM bios.  It takes
 16241                                  ;over  the  system  initialization  after  the  OEM  bios   has
 16242                                  ;performed any  initialization  it  needs  to  do.   Control is
 16243                                  ;transfered with a long jump to the external  variable  SYSINIT
 16244                                  ;
 16245                                  ;
 16246                                  ;   The OEM  has  the  following  variables declared external:
 16247                                  ;
 16248                                  ;   CURRENT_DOS_LOCATION    WORD
 16249                                  ;
 16250                                  ;This word  contains  the  segment  number of the DOS before it
 16251                                  ;is relocated.  The OEM bios must set this value.
 16252                                  ;
 16253                                  ;   FINAL_DOS_LOCATION      WORD
 16254                                  ;
 16255                                  ;This word contains the segment number of the DOS after SYSINIT
 16256                                  ;moves it.  The OEM bios must set this value.
 16257                                  ;
 16258                                  ;   DEVICE_LIST             DWORD
 16259                                  ;
 16260                                  ;This  double  word  pointer  points  to  the  linked  list  of
 16261                                  ;character and block device drivers.  The  OEM  must  set  this
 16262                                  ;value.
 16263                                  ;
 16264                                  ;   MEMORY_SIZE             WORD
 16265                                  ;
 16266                                  ;This word  contains  the  number  of  RAM  paragraphs.  If the
 16267                                  ;bios doesn't set  this  variable  SYSINIT  will  automatically
 16268                                  ;calculate it.   NOTE:  systems with PARITY checked memory must
 16269                                  ;size memory in the BIOS.  SYSINITs method is to  write  memory
 16270                                  ;and read it back until it gets a mismatch.
 16271                                  ;
 16272                                  ;   DEFAULT_DRIVE           BYTE
 16273                                  ;
 16274                                  ;This is  the initial default drive when the system first comes
 16275                                  ;up.  drive a=0, drive b=1,  etc.   If  the  bios  doesn't  set
 16276                                  ;it then drive a is assumed.
 16277                                  ;
 16278                                  ;   BUFFERS                 BYTE
 16279                                  ;
 16280                                  ;This is  the  default  number of buffers for the system.  This
 16281                                  ;value may be overridden by the user in  the  CONFIG.SYS  file.
 16282                                  ;It is DBed to 2 in SYSINIT it should be greater than 1.
 16283                                  ;
 16284                                  ;   FILES                   BYTE
 16285                                  ;
 16286                                  ;This is  the  default  number  of  files for the system.  This
 16287                                  ;value may be overridden by the user in  the  CONFIG.SYS  file.
 16288                                  ;It is  DBed  to  8 in SYSINIT, values less than 5 are ignored.
 16289                                  ;
 16290                                  ;   SYSINIT                 FAR
 16291                                  ;
 16292                                  ;The entry  point  of  the  SYSINIT  module.  OEM BIOS jumps to
 16293                                  ;this label at the end of its INIT code.
 16294                                  ;
 16295                                  ;   The OEM  has  the  following  variables declared public:
 16296                                  ;
 16297                                  ;   RE_INIT                 FAR
 16298                                  ;
 16299                                  ;This is an entry point which allows the BIOS to do some INIT
 16300                                  ;work  after  the  DOS is initialized.  ALL REGISTERS MUST BE
 16301                                  ;PRESERVED.  On entry DS points to the first available memory
 16302                                  ;(after  the DOS).  DS:0 points to a 100H byte program header
 16303                                  ;prefix which represents  the  "program"  currently  running.
 16304                                  ;This  program  should  be  thought  of  as  the OEM BIOS and
 16305                                  ;SYSINIT taken together.  This is not  a  normal  program  in
 16306                                  ;that  no  memory  is  allocated to it, it is running in free
 16307                                  ;memory.
 16308                                  ;NOTES:
 16309                                  ;     At the time this routine is called SYSINIT occupies the
 16310                                  ;highest 10K of memory ("highest" is determined by the  value
 16311                                  ;of the MEMORY_SIZE variable), DO NOT DO WRITES THERE.
 16312                                  ;     Since this is called AFTER DOS is initialized, you can
 16313                                  ;make system calls.  This also implies that the code for this
 16314                                  ;routine    CANNOT   be   thrown   away   by   use   of   the
 16315                                  ;FINAL_DOS_LOCATION since the DOS has already been moved.
 16316                                  ;     If you don't want  anything done just set this to point
 16317                                  ;at a FAR RET instruction.
 16318                                  
 16319                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16320                                  ; TITLE   BIOS SYSTEM INITIALIZATION
 16321                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16322                                  
 16323                                  ;include version.inc
 16324                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16325

 16521                                  ;**	DPB - Drive Parameter Block
 16522                                  
 16523                                  ; 25/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0 (MSDOS 6.0, DPB.INC, 1991)
 16524                                  
 16525                                  ;	BUGBUG - this isn't authorative - it's my probably incomplete and
 16526                                  ;	possibly inaccurate deductions from code study... - jgl
 16527                                  ;
 16528                                  ;	The DPB is DOS's main structure for describing block devices.
 16529                                  ;	It contains info about the "Drive" intermingled with info about
 16530                                  ;	the FAT file system which is presumably on the drive.  I don't know
 16531                                  ;	how those fields are used if it's not the FAT file system - BUGBUG
 16532                                  ;
 16533                                  ;	The DPBs are statically allocated and chained off of DPBHead.
 16534                                  ;	Users scan this chain looking for a match on DPB_DRIVE.
 16535                                  ;	The DPBs are built at init time from info in the SYSDEV structure.
 16536                                  
 16537                                  ; 08/06/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0 (MSDOS 3.3, DPB.INC, 24/07/1987)
 16538

 16626                                  ;**	BIOS PARAMETER BLOCK DEFINITION
 16627                                  ;
 16628                                  ;	The BPB contains information about the disk structure.  It dates
 16629                                  ;	back to the earliest FAT systems and so FAT information is
 16630                                  ;	intermingled with physical driver information.
 16631                                  ;
 16632                                  ;	A boot sector contains a BPB for its device; for other disks
 16633                                  ;	the driver creates a BPB.  DOS keeps copies of some of this
 16634                                  ;	information in the DPB.
 16635                                  ;
 16636                                  ;	The BDS structure contains a BPB within it.
 16637                                  
 16638                                  struc A_BPB

 16917                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16918                                  ; BIOSTRUC.INC (MSDOS 3.3 - 24/07/1987)
 16919                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16920                                  					  ;;Rev 3.30 Modification
 16921                                  ; ROM BIOS CALL PACKET STRUCTURES					  
 16922                                  									  
 16923                                  ;*******************************					  
 16924                                  ;System Service call ( Int 15h )					  
 16925                                  ;*******************************					  
 16926                                  ;Function AH = 0C0h, Return system configuration			  
 16927                                  ;For PC and PCJR on return:						  
 16928                                  ;	(AH)	= 80h							  
 16929                                  ;	(CY)	= 1							  
 16930                                  ;For PCXT, PC PORTABLE and PCAT on return:				  
 16931                                  ;	(AH)	= 86h							  
 16932                                  ;	(CY)	= 1							  
 16933                                  ;For all others:							  
 16934                                  ;	(AH)	= 0							  
 16935                                  ;	(CY)	= 0							  
 16936                                  ;	(ES:BX) = pointer to system descriptor vector in ROS		  
 16937                                  ; System descriptor :							  
 16938                                  ;	DW	xxxx		length of descriptor in bytes,		  
 16939                                  ;				minimum length = 8			  
 16940                                  ;	DB	xx		model byte				  
 16941                                  ;				0FFh	= PC				  
 16942                                  ;				0FEh	= PC/XT, Portable		  
 16943                                  ;				0FDh	= PC/JR 			  
 16944                                  ;				0FCh	= PC/AT				  
 16945                                  ;				0F9h	= Convertable			  
 16946                                  ;				0F8h	= Model 80			  
 16947                                  ;				0E0 thru 0EFh = reserved		  
 16948                                  ;									  
 16949                                  ;	DB	xx		secondary model byte			  
 16950                                  ;				000h	= PC1				  
 16951                                  ;				000h	= PC/XT, Portable		  
 16952                                  ;				000h	= PC/JR 			  
 16953                                  ;				000h	= PC/AT 			  
 16954                                  ;				001h	= PC/AT Model 339		  
 16955                                  ;				003h	= PC/RT				  
 16956                                  ;				000h	= Convertable			  
 16957                                  ;									  
 16958                                  ;	DB	xx		bios revision level			  
 16959                                  ;				00 for first release, subsequent release  
 16960                                  ;				of code with same model byte and	  
 16961                                  ;				secondary model byte require revison level
 16962                                  ;				to increase by one.			  
 16963                                  ;									  
 16964                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 1		  
 16965                                  ;				X0000000 = 1, bios use DMA channel 3	  
 16966                                  ;					 = 0, DMA channel 3 not used	  
 16967                                  ;									  
 16968                                  ;				0X000000 = 1, 2nd Interrupt chip present  
 16969                                  ;					 = 0, 2nd Interrupt chip not present
 16970                                  ;									  
 16971                                  ;				00X00000 = 1, Real Time Clock present	  
 16972                                  ;					 = 0, Real Time Clock not present 
 16973                                  ;									  
 16974                                  ;				000X0000 = 1, Keyboard escape sequence(INT 15h)
 16975                                  ;						called in keyboard interrupt
 16976                                  ;						(Int 09h).		  
 16977                                  ;					 = 0, Keyboard escape sequence not
 16978                                  ;						called. 		  
 16979                                  ;				0000XXXX reserved			  
 16980                                  ;									  
 16981                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 2 - reserved	  
 16982                                  ;									  
 16983                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 2 - reserved	  
 16984                                  ;									  
 16985                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 2 - reserved	  
 16986                                  ;									  
 16987                                  ;	DB	xx		feature information byte 2 - reserved	  
 16988                                  ;									  
 16989                                  
 16990                                  ; 22/03/2019

 17108                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 17109                                  ; CURDIR.INC (MSDOS 6.0 - 1991)
 17110                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 17111                                  ; 22/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 17112                                  
 17113                                  ;**	CDS - Current Directory Structure
 17114                                  ;
 17115                                  ; CDS items are used bu the internal routines to store cluster numbers and
 17116                                  ; network identifiers for each logical name.  The ID field is used dually,
 17117                                  ; both as net ID and for a cluster number for local devices. In the case
 17118                                  ; of local devices, the cluster number will be -1 if there is a potential
 17119                                  ; of the disk being changed or if the path must be recracked.
 17120                                  ;
 17121                                  ;	Some pathnames have special preambles, such as
 17122                                  ;
 17123                                  ;		\\machine\sharename\...
 17124                                  ;	For these pathnames we can't allow ".." processing to back us
 17125                                  ;	up into the special front part of the name.  The CURDIR_END field
 17126                                  ;	holds the address of the seperator character which marks
 17127                                  ;	the split between the special preamble and the regular
 17128                                  ;	path list; ".." processing isn't allowed to back us up past
 17129                                  ;	(i.e., before) CURDIR_END
 17130                                  ;	For the root, it points at the leading /. For net
 17131                                  ;	assignments it points at the end (nul) of the initial assignment:
 17132                                  ;	A:/	\\foo\bar	    \\foo\bar\blech\bozo
 17133                                  ;	  ^		 ^		     ^
 17134                                  
 17135                                  DIRSTRLEN	EQU	64+3		; Max length in bytes of directory strings
 17136                                  TEMPLEN 	EQU	DIRSTRLEN*2
 17137                                  
 17138                                  struc 		curdir_list
 17139                                  ; MSDOS 3.3
 17140 00000000 <res 43h>               .cdir_text	resb	DIRSTRLEN	; text of assignment and curdir
 17141 00000043 ????                    .cdir_flags	resw	1		; various flags
 17142 00000045 ????????                .cdir_devptr	resd	1		; local pointer to DPB or net device
 17143 00000049 ????????                .cdir_ID	resw	2		; cluster of current dir (net ID)
 17144 0000004D ????                    .cdir_usr_word	resw	1
 17145 0000004F ????                    .cdir_end	resw	1		; end of assignment
 17146                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 17147 00000051 ??                      .cdir_type:	resb	1		; IFS drive (2=ifs, 4=netuse)
 17148 00000052 ????????                .cdir_ifd_hdr:	resd	1		; Ptr to File System Header
 17149 00000056 ????                    .cdir_fsda:	resb	2		; File System Dependent Data Area
 17150                                  .size:
 17151                                  endstruc
 17152                                  
 17153                                  curdirlen	EQU	curdir_list.size	; Needed for screwed up
 17154                                  						; ASM87 which doesn't allow
 17155                                  						; Size directive as a macro
 17156                                  						; argument
 17157                                  %define curdir_netID	dword [curdir_list.cdir_ID]
 17158

 17177                                  ;**	System File Table SuperStructure
 17178                                  ;
 17179                                  ;	The system file table entries are allocated in contiguous groups.
 17180                                  ;	There may be more than one such groups; the SF "superstructure"
 17181                                  ;	tracks the groups.
 17182                                  
 17183                                  struc	SF
 17184 00000000 ????????                .SFLink:	resd	1
 17185 00000004 ????                    .SFCount:	resw	1		; number of entries
 17186 00000006 ????                    .SFTable:	resw	1		; beginning of array of the following
 17187                                  .size:
 17188                                  endstruc
 17189                                  
 17190                                  ;**	System file table entry
 17191                                  ;
 17192                                  ;	These are the structures which are at SFTABLE in the SF structure.
 17193                                  
 17194                                  struc	SF_ENTRY
 17195 00000000 ????                    .sf_ref_count:	resw	1		; number of processes sharing entry
 17196                                  					;   if FCB then ref count
 17197 00000002 ????                    .sf_mode: 	resw	1		; mode of access or high bit on if FCB
 17198 00000004 ??                      .sf_attr: 	resb	1		; attribute of file
 17199 00000005 ????                    .sf_flags:	resw	1		;Bits 8-15
 17200                                  					; Bit 15 = 1 if remote file
 17201                                  					;	 = 0 if local file or device
 17202                                  					; Bit 14 = 1 if date/time is not to be
 17203                                  					;   set from clock at CLOSE.  Set by
 17204                                  					;   FILETIMES and FCB_CLOSE.  Reset by
 17205                                  					;   other reseters of the dirty bit
 17206                                  					;   (WRITE)
 17207                                  					; Bit 13 = Pipe bit (reserved)
 17208                                  					;
 17209                                  					; Bits 0-7 (old FCB_devid bits)
 17210                                  					; If remote file or local file, bit
 17211                                  					; 6=0 if dirty Device ID number, bits
 17212                                  					; 0-5 if local file.
 17213                                  					; bit 7=0 for local file, bit 7
 17214                                  					;      =1 for local I/O device
 17215                                  					; If local I/O device, bit 6=0 if EOF (input)
 17216                                  					;		Bit 5=1 if Raw mode
 17217                                  					;		Bit 0=1 if console input device
 17218                                  					;		Bit 1=1 if console output device
 17219                                  					;		Bit 2=1 if null device
 17220                                  					;		Bit 3=1 if clock device
 17221 00000007 ????????                .sf_devptr:	resd	1		; Points to DPB if local file, points
 17222                                  					; to device header if local device,
 17223                                  					; points to net device header if
 17224                                  					; remote
 17225 0000000B ????                    .sf_firclus:	resw	1		; First cluster of file (bit 15 = 0)
 17226                                  ;.sf_lstclus:	resw	1 ; *
 17227 0000000D ????                    .sf_time: 	resw	1		; Time associated with file
 17228 0000000F ????                    .sf_date: 	resw	1		; Date associated with file
 17229 00000011 ????????                .sf_size: 	resd	1		; Size associated with file
 17230 00000015 ????????                .sf_position:	resd	1		; Read/Write pointer or LRU count for FCBs
 17231                                  ;
 17232                                  ; Starting here, the next 7 bytes may be used by the file system to store an
 17233                                  ; ID
 17234                                  ;
 17235 00000019 ????                    .sf_cluspos:	resw	1		; Position of last cluster accessed
 17236 0000001B ????????                .sf_dirsec:	resd	1 ; 09/04/2024	; Sector number of directory sector for this file
 17237 0000001F ??                      .sf_dirpos:	resb	1		; Offset of this entry in the above
 17238                                  ;
 17239                                  ; End of 7 bytes of file-system specific info.
 17240                                  ;
 17241 00000020 <res Bh>                .sf_name:	resb	11		; 11 character name that is in the
 17242                                  					; directory entry.  This is used by
 17243                                  					; close to detect file deleted and

 17253                                  endstruc

 17533                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
