 30307                                  ;include highload.inc	; Routines for devicehigh parsing, control of HIDDEN
 30308                                  ;include highexit.inc	; umb's, etc
 30309                                  
 30310                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 30311                                  ; HIGHLOAD.INC (MSDOS 6.0 - 1991) 	
 30312                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 30313                                  ; 07/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 30314                                  
 30315                                  ;******************************************************************************
 30316                                  ;
 30317                                  ; This file contains routines needed to parse and implement user-given
 30318                                  ; command-line options of the form "/S/L:3,0x500;2;7,127;0x0BE4". InitVar()
 30319                                  ; and Parsevar() are used to parse this data and place it in encoded form into
 30320                                  ; the variables in highvar.inc, for use by the rest of the routines.
 30321                                  ;
 30322                                  ; DeviceHigh accepts this command-line (handled in sysconf.asm, not here):
 30323                                  ;    DEVICEHIGH SIZE=hhhhhh module opts
 30324                                  ; Or, DeviceHigh and LoadHigh accept any of the following:
 30325                                  ;    DH/LH module opts
 30326                                  ;    DH/LH [/S][/L:umb[,size][;umb[,size]]*] module opts
 30327                                  ;    DH/LH [/L:umb[,size][;umb[,size]]*][/S] module opts
 30328                                  ; The initial UMB,SIZE pair designates the module's load address; the remainder
 30329                                  ; of the UMB and SIZE pairs are used to indicate specific UMBs to be left
 30330                                  ; available during the load.
 30331                                  ;
 30332                                  ; When an actual load is ready to be performed, a call to HideUMBs() will
 30333                                  ; temporarily allocate (as owner 8+"HIDDEN  ") all free elements in any
 30334                                  ; upper-memory block which was not specified by the user... in addition, if
 30335                                  ; UMBs were marked to shrink (/S option) to a certain size ("umb,size"), any
 30336                                  ; elements in that umb SAVE the lower-half of the newly-shrunken one are also
 30337                                  ; allocated.  After the load, the function UnHideUMBs() (in highexit.inc) will
 30338                                  ; free any UMBs so allocated.
 30339                                  ;
 30340                                  ; When a device driver loads, there is the additional problem of allocating its
 30341                                  ; initial load site; this should be restricted to the first UMB specified on
 30342                                  ; the command-line. The function FreezeUM temporarily allocates all remaining
 30343                                  ; free upper-memory elements (as owner 8+"FROZEN  "), except those in the load
 30344                                  ; UMB. Then the initial allocation may be made, and a call to UnFreeze will
 30345                                  ; return any so-allocated memory elements to FREE, for the true load. Note
 30346                                  ; that UnFreeze leaves HIDDEN elements allocated; it only frees FROZEN ones.
 30347                                  ;
 30348                                  ;******************************************************************************
 30349                                  
 30350                                  SWTCH	equ	'/'		; Switch character
 30351                                  
 30352                                  DOS_CHECK_STRATEGY  equ	5800h	; Int 21h, Func 58h, Svc 0 = check alloc strat
 30353                                  DOS_SET_STRATEGY    equ	5801h	; Int 21h, Func 58h, Svc 1 = set alloc strategy
 30354                                  DOS_CHECK_UMBLINK   equ	5802h	; Int 21h, Func 58h, Svc 2 = check link state
 30355                                  DOS_GET_UMBLINK	    equ 5802h ; 20/04/2019
 30356                                  DOS_SET_UMBLINK     equ	5803h	; Int 21h, Func 58h, Svc 3 = set link state
 30357                                  DOS_GET_DOS_LISTS   equ	  52h	; Int 21h, Func 52h = return list of lists
 30358                                  DOS_UMB_HEAD        equ	  8Ch	; Offset from ES (after func52h) to get UMBHead
 30359                                  
 30360                                  CR	equ	0Dh		; Carriage Return
 30361                                  LF	equ	0Ah		; Line Feed
 30362                                  TAB	equ	09h		; Tab character (^I)
 30363                                  
 30364                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30365                                  ;*** InitVar - initializes all the variables used in ParseVar and HideUMBs
 30366                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30367                                  ; ENTRY:       None
 30368                                  ; EXIT:        Variables listed in highvar.inc are initialized
 30369                                  ; ERROR EXIT:  None
 30370                                  ; USES:        Flags, variables in highvar.inc
 30371                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30372                                  ; Note that element 0 references UMB 0 (conventional), not UMB 1.  Its contents
 30373                                  ; are largely ignored, but it is initialized nonetheless.
 30374                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30375                                  
 30376                                  InitVar:
 30377                                  	;pushreg <ax, cx, di, es>
 30378                                  	push	ax
 30379                                  	push	cx
 30380                                  	push	di
 30381                                  	push	es
 30382                                  
 30383                                  	;dataseg es			;Point ES into appropriate data segment
 30384                                  	push	cs
 30385                                  	pop	es
 30386                                  
 30387                                  	xor	ax,ax
 30388                                  	mov	[es:fUmbTiny],al	;Shrink UMBs? (made 1 if /S given)
 30389                                  	mov	[es:fInHigh],al		;Set to 1 when DH/LH has been called
 30390                                  	mov	[es:SegLoad],ax		;Load Address (seg), used for DH only
 30391                                  	mov	byte [es:UmbLoad],UNSPECIFIED ; 0FFh
 30392                                  					;Later is the # of the 1st spec'd UMB
 30393                                  	mov	[es:fm_argc], al	;Start with zero args having been read
 30394                                  
 30395                                  	cld
 30396                                  
 30397                                  	mov	cx,MAXUMB ; 16		;For each entry
 30398                                  	mov	di,UmbUsed		;on the UmbUsed array,
 30399                                  	rep	stosb			;	Store 0
 30400                                  
 30401                                  	mov	cx,MAXUMB ; 16		;Okay... for each entry
 30402                                  	mov	di,UmbSize		;on the UmbSize array,
 30403                                  	rep	stosw			;	Store 0
 30404                                  
 30405                                  	;normseg es			; Return ES
 30406                                  
 30407                                  	;popreg	<es, di, cx, ax>
 30408                                  	pop	es
 30409                                  	pop	di
 30410                                  	pop	cx
 30411                                  	pop	ax	 	
 30412                                  
 30413                                  	retn
 30414                                  
 30415                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30416                                  ;*** FixMem - scans the upper memory chain and concatenates adjacent free MCBs
 30417                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30418                                  ; ENTRY   : None
 30419                                  ; EXIT    : None
 30420                                  ; ERROR   : None
 30421                                  ; USES    : Flags, fm_umb, fm_strat
 30422                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30423                                  
 30424                                  FixMem:
 30425                                  	push	ax
 30426                                  	push	bx
 30427                                  	push	cx
 30428                                  	push	dx
 30429                                  	push	es
 30430                                  
 30431                                  	call	fm_link		; Link in UMBs
 30432                                  
 30433                                  	call	UmbHead		; Get first upper-memory MCB address (0x9FFF)
 30434                                  	jc	short fmX	; (if couldn't get it, leave now).
 30435                                  
 30436                                  	mov	es,ax		; It returns in AX, so move it to ES.
 30437                                  
 30438                                  ; - Walk MCB Chain ------------------------------------------------------------
 30439                                  
 30440                                  	xor	dx,dx		; We're keeping the address of the last MCB
 30441                                  	mov 	cx,dx		; in CX... and the last owner
 30442                                  	inc	dx		; in dx as we go through the loop:
 30443                                  
 30444                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 30445                                  ; FM10--DX  = last MCB's owner's PSP address
 30446                                  ;       CX  = last MCB's address (segment)
 30447                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 30448                                  
 30449                                  fm10:	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE] ; if 'Z', don't repeat loop
 30450                                  	mov	bx,[es:ARENA.OWNER]	; if not zero, do nothing
 30451                                  	or	bx,dx			; dx was owner of previous MCB
 30452                                  	jnz	short fm30		; If not both zero, don't cat.
 30453                                  
 30454                                  	; - Coalesce memory blocks at ES:00 and CX:00 -------------------------
 30455                                  
 30456                                  fm20:	mov	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]	; Grab this block's Size,
 30457                                  	mov	es,cx			; Go back to prev MCB's address
 30458                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],al ; & move the SECOND sig here
 30459                                  
 30460                                  	add	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]	; Size += first MCB's size
 30461                                  	;add	bx,1			; And add one for the header
 30462                                  	; 14/08/2023
 30463                                  	inc	bx
 30464                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.SIZE],bx	; Write the size
 30465                                  
 30466                                  	; ---------------------------------------------------------------------
 30467                                  
 30468                                  fm30:	mov	cx,es			; Put this address on the stack
 30469                                  	mov	dx,[es:ARENA.OWNER]	; And remember its owner
 30470                                  
 30471                                  	mov	bx,es			; Move to the next MCB
 30472                                  	add	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 30473                                  	inc	bx
 30474                                  	mov	es,bx
 30475                                  
 30476                                  	;cmp	al,'Z'
 30477                                  	cmp	al,arena_signature_end
 30478                                  	jne	short fm10		; If signature != 'Z', there are more.
 30479                                  fmX:	
 30480                                  	call	fm_unlink		; Unlink UMBs
 30481                                  
 30482                                  	pop	es
 30483                                  	pop	dx
 30484                                  	pop	cx
 30485                                  	pop	bx
 30486                                  	pop	ax
 30487                                  
 30488                                  	retn
 30489                                  
 30490                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 30546                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30547                                  ;*** ParseVar - parses [/S][/L:umb[,size][;umb[,size]]*] and builds the table
 30548                                  ; laid out in highvar.inc
 30549                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30550                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to command tail of LoadHigh/DeviceHigh (whitespace ok)
 30551                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI points to first character in child program name
 30552                                  ; ERROR:    ES:SI points to character which caused error, carry set, AX == code
 30553                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, AX, flags, variables in highvar.inc
 30554                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30555                                  ; Error codes (in AX if carry set on return):
 30556                                  ;
 30557                                  PV_InvArg	equ	1	; Invalid argument passed
 30558                                  PV_BadUMB	equ	2	; Bad UMB number passed (duplicate?)
 30559                                  PV_InvSwt	equ	3	; Unrecognized switch passed
 30560                                  ;
 30561                                  ; This routine exects ES:SI to point to a string much like the following:
 30562                                  ;    "/S/L:1,200;2 module options"
 30563                                  ; Optionally, the string can begin with whitespace; neither /S nor /L is
 30564                                  ; required, though that's what this routine is supposed to parse.
 30565                                  ;
 30566                                  optS		equ	'S'	; /S
 30567                                  optL		equ	'L'	; /L:...
 30568                                  ;
 30569                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30570                                  ; LoadHigh has a list of arguments, returned by cparse, which is used to create
 30571                                  ; a command-line for spawning a child process. For a typical LH command, say,
 30572                                  ;     lh /l:1,1000;2 print/d:lpt2
 30573                                  ; the arguments would look like (one per line):
 30574                                  ;     lh
 30575                                  ;     /l
 30576                                  ;     1
 30577                                  ;     1000
 30578                                  ;     2
 30579                                  ;     print
 30580                                  ;     /d
 30581                                  ;     :lpt2
 30582                                  ; In short, if "print" were, say, "43", there'd be no way to determine which
 30583                                  ; arg was the filename. So, inside this routine, we keep a running counter
 30584                                  ; of the number of arguments LH will need to skip in order to get to the
 30585                                  ; program name. The "lh" is implicit--it'll always have to skip that. So if
 30586                                  ; there's no "/l" or "/s", fm_argc will be 0 ... other than that, 1 is added
 30587                                  ; for:
 30588                                  ;    Each /L
 30589                                  ;    Each /S (there should be only one)
 30590                                  ;    Each UMB number (they follow ":" or ";")
 30591                                  ;    Each UMB size   (they follow ",")
 30592                                  ; So, in the above example, fm_argc would be 4-- and LH would skip right to
 30593                                  ; "print".  Note that InitVar initializes fm_argc to zero.
 30594                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30595                                  
 30596                                  ParseVar:
 30597                                  	;pushreg <di, ds, es>
 30598                                  	push	di
 30599                                  	push	ds
 30600                                  	push	es
 30601                                  
 30602                                  	push	es		; Make DS:SI point to it, as well as ES:SI
 30603                                  	pop	ds		; (regardless if we're in devhigh or loadhigh)
 30604                                  	cld
 30605                                  
 30606                                  ; ------------------------------------------------
 30607                                  ; PV10--ES:SI = any whitespace on the command-line
 30608                                  ; ------------------------------------------------
 30609                                  
 30610                                  pv10:	lodsb			; here, ES:SI=="  /L..."--must eat whitespace
 30611                                  	call	isWhite
 30612                                  	jz	short pv10	;       ES:SI==" /L..."--keep eating.
 30613                                  	;cmp	al,'/'
 30614                                  	cmp	al,SWTCH
 30615                                  	je	short pv20	;       ES:SI=="/L..."--go process a switch
 30616                                  
 30617                                  	dec	si		; Backup--it's now "odule options", and we need
 30618                                  	clc			; that "m" we just read (or whatever it is).
 30619                                  	jmp	short pvX	; Then return with carry clear == we're done.
 30620                                  
 30621                                  pv20:	lodsb			; Just read 'S' or 'L', hopefully
 30622                                  	;toUpper al		; So we make it upper-case, and...
 30623                                  	and	al,0DFh
 30624                                  	;cmp	al,'S'
 30625                                  	cmp	al,optS		; just read 'S'?
 30626                                  	jne	short pv30
 30627                                  
 30628                                  	;call	incArgc		; If it's /S, it's another arg for LH to skip.
 30629                                  	inc	byte [cs:fm_argc] ; 19/04/2019
 30630                                  
 30631                                  	;putdata fUmbTiny,1	; /S, so ES:SI=="  /L..." or " module opts", or
 30632                                  	;
 30633                                  	;push	es
 30634                                  	;push	cs
 30635                                  	;pop	es
 30636                                  	;mov	[es:fUmbTiny],1	
 30637                                  	;pop	es
 30638                                  
 30639                                  	mov	byte [cs:fUmbTiny],1
 30640                                  
 30641                                  	jmp	short pv10	; possibly even "/L...".
 30642                                  
 30643                                  pv30:	;cmp	al,'L'
 30644                                  	cmp	al,optL		; If it's not 'L' either, then 'tis a bad
 30645                                  	jne	short pvE1		; switch!
 30646                                  
 30647                                  	;call	incArgc		; If it's /L, it's another arg for LH to skip.
 30648                                  	inc	byte [cs:fm_argc] ; 19/04/2019
 30649                                  
 30650                                  	call	parseL
 30651                                  	jnc	short pv10	; If no carry, go back and look for more
 30652                                  
 30653                                  	dec	si		; Else, back up and exit.
 30654                                  	jmp	short pvErr	; AX has already been set by parseL
 30655                                  
 30656                                  pvE1:	;mov	ax,3
 30657                                  	mov	ax,PV_InvSwt	; Unrecognized switch passed
 30658                                  pvErr:	dec	si
 30659                                  	dec	si
 30660                                  	stc
 30661                                  pvX:	;popreg	<es, ds, di>
 30662                                  	pop	es
 30663                                  	pop	ds
 30664                                  	pop	di
 30665                                  	retn
 30666                                  
 30667                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30668                                  ;*** parseL - parses ":nnnn[,nnnn][;nnnn[,nnnn]]*" for ParseVar
 30669                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30670                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to colon
 30671                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI points to first character not parsed
 30672                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set; rewind three characters and return (see ParseVar)
 30673                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, flags, AX, CX, DX, variables in highvar.inc
 30674                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30675                                  ; If the string here is terminated with anything other than whitespace or a
 30676                                  ; switchchar (perhaps it's /S or another /L:... ), then we return with carry
 30677                                  ; set, indicating that they've screwed up the syntax.  The 3-character rewind
 30678                                  ; makes sure the app /L: is reported as being the culprit.
 30679                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30680                                  
 30681                                  parseL:
 30682                                  	lodsb
 30683                                  	cmp	al,':'		; Make sure they did /L:
 30684                                  	jne	short plE1	; If they didn't, return with carry set.
 30685                                  
 30686                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 30687                                  ; PL10--ES:SI = a UMB number, after /L: or ;
 30688                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 30689                                  
 30690                                  pl10:	call	GetXNum		; After this, 'tis ",size" or ";umb" or " mod"
 30691                                  	jc	short plE2	; And error if it's a bad number.
 30692                                  	call	convUMB		; Convert any address to a UMB number
 30693                                  
 30694                                  	mov	cl,al		; Remember the UMB number
 30695                                  	call	stowUMB		; Mark this UMB # as used;
 30696                                  	jc	short plE2	; If it was already marked, it'll error
 30697                                  
 30698                                  	;call	incArgc		; Each UMB number is another arg for LH to skip
 30699                                  	inc	byte [cs:fm_argc] ; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 30700                                  
 30701                                  	lodsb
 30702                                  	cmp	al,';'		; Did "umb;" ?
 30703                                  	je	short pl10	; Yep: go back and get another UMB.
 30704                                  
 30705                                  	call	isWhite		; Did "umb " ?
 30706                                  	jz	short plX	; Yep: return (it'll go back to whitespace)
 30707                                  
 30708                                  	call	isEOL		; Did "umb" ?
 30709                                  	jz	short plSwX	; If so, backup and exit like everything's ok
 30710                                  
 30711                                  	;cmp	al,'/'
 30712                                  	cmp	al,SWTCH 	; Did "umb/" ? (as in, "/L:1,100;2/S")
 30713                                  	je	short plSwX	; If so, back up ES:SI one character and return
 30714                                  
 30715                                  	cmp	al,','		; Did "umb," ?
 30716                                  	jne	short plE1	; Just what the heck DID they do? Return error.
 30717                                  
 30718                                  ; --- Read a size -------------------------------------------------------------
 30719                                  
 30720                                  	call	GetXNum		; Stop on "size;" or "size " or anything else
 30721                                  	jc	short plE1	; And error if it's a bad size.
 30722                                  
 30723                                  	call	toPara		; Convert from bytes to paragraphs
 30724                                  
 30725                                  	call	stowSiz		; CL still has the UMB number for this routine
 30726                                  
 30727                                  	;call	incArgc		; Each UMB size is another arg for LH to skip
 30728                                  	inc	byte [cs:fm_argc] ; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 30729                                  
 30730                                  	lodsb
 30731                                  	cmp	al,';'		; They did "umb,size;", so get another UMB.
 30732                                  	je	short pl10	;
 30733                                  
 30734                                  	call	isWhite		; Did it end with whitespace?
 30735                                  	jz	short plX	; If so, we're done here--go back.
 30736                                  
 30737                                  	call	isEOL		; Did they do "umb,size" and end??? (stupid)
 30738                                  	jz	short plSwX	; If so, backup and exit like everything's ok
 30739                                  
 30740                                  	;cmp	al,'/'
 30741                                  	cmp	al,SWTCH	; Did they do "umb,size/" ?
 30742                                  	je	short plSwX	; If so, again, we're done here.
 30743                                  plE1:	
 30744                                  	;mov	ax,1
 30745                                  	mov	ax,PV_InvArg	; If not, we don't know WHAT they did...
 30746                                  	dec	si
 30747                                  	stc
 30748                                  	retn
 30749                                  
 30750                                  plE2:	;mov	ax,2
 30751                                  	mov	ax,PV_BadUMB	; In this case, they've specified a UMB twice
 30752                                  	; 12/12/2022
 30753                                  	; cf=1
 30754                                  	;stc
 30755                                  	retn
 30756                                  plSwX:	
 30757                                  	dec	si		; If we hit a '/' character, back up one char
 30758                                  				; so the whitespace checker will see it too.
 30759                                  plX:	; 12/12/2022
 30760                                  	; cf=0
 30761                                  	;clc			; Then just return with carry clear, so
 30762                                  	retn			; ParseVar will go about its business.
 30763                                  
 30764                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 30766                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 30769                                  ; ERROR:    None

 30771                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30772                                  
 30773                                  ;incArgc:

 30775

 30777

 30779                                  
 30780                                  	;inc	al		; Increment it,
 30781

 30787                                  	;retn

 30789                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30790                                  ;*** isEOL - returns with ZF set if AL contains CR or LF, or 0
 30791                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30792                                  ; ENTRY:    AL contains character to test
 30793                                  ; EXIT:     ZF set iff AL contains CR or LF, or 0
 30794                                  ; ERROR:    None
 30795                                  ; USES:     ZF
 30796                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30797                                  
 30798                                  isEOL:
 30799                                  	cmp	al,0		; Null-terminator
 30800                                  	je	short ieX
 30801                                  	cmp	al,CR ; 0Dh	; Carriage Return
 30802                                  	je	short ieX
 30803                                  	cmp	al,LF ; 0Ah	; LineFeed
 30804                                  ieX:	
 30805                                  	retn
 30806                                  
 30807                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30808                                  ;*** isWhite - returns with ZF set if AL contains whitespace (or "=")
 30809                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30810                                  ; ENTRY:    AL contains character to test
 30811                                  ; EXIT:     ZF set iff AL contains space, tab, or equals
 30812                                  ; ERROR:    None
 30813                                  ; USES:     ZF
 30814                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30815                                  
 30816                                  isWhite:
 30817                                  	cmp	al,' '		; Space
 30818                                  	je	short iwX
 30819                                  	cmp	al,'='		; Equals (treat as whitespace)
 30820                                  	je	short iwX
 30821                                  	cmp	al,tab ; 9	; Tab
 30822                                  iwX:	
 30823                                  	retn
 30824                                  
 30825                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30826                                  ;*** unMarkUMB - marks a given UMB as unused, even if previously marked used
 30827                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30828                                  ; ENTRY:    AL contains UMB number
 30829                                  ; EXIT:     None
 30830                                  ; ERROR:    None
 30831                                  ; USES:     Flags, variables in highvar.inc
 30832                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30833                                  
 30834                                  unMarkUMB:
 30835                                  	push	ax
 30836                                  	push	bx
 30837                                  	push	di
 30838                                  	push	es
 30839                                  
 30840                                  	push	cs
 30841                                  	pop	es
 30842                                  
 30843                                  	xor	ah,ah
 30844                                  	mov	bx,ax
 30845                                  
 30846                                  	; 19/04/2019
 30847                                  	
 30848                                  	;mov	byte [es:bx+UmbUsed],0
 30849                                  	mov	[es:bx+UmbUsed],ah ; 0
 30850                                  
 30851                                  	cmp	[es:UmbLoad],al
 30852                                  	jne	short umu10
 30853                                  
 30854                                  	;mov	[es:UmbLoad],0	; If unmarked the load UMB, load into convent.
 30855                                  	mov	[es:UmbLoad],ah ; 0
 30856                                  umu10:

 30858                                  	pop	di
 30859                                  	pop	bx
 30860                                  	pop	ax

 30863                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30864                                  ;*** stowUMB - marks a given UMB as used, if it hasn't been so marked before
 30865                                  ;            -- accepts a UMB # in AL, and makes sure it hasn't yet been
 30866                                  ; listed in the /L:... chain. If it's the first one specified, it sets UmbLoad
 30867                                  ; to that UMB #... and in any case, it marks the UMB as specified.
 30868                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30869                                  ; ENTRY:    AL contains UMB number, as specified by the user
 30870                                  ; EXIT:     None
 30871                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if UMB # is less than 0 or >= MAXUMB (see highvar.inc)
 30872                                  ; USES:     AX, Flags, variables in highvar.inc
 30873                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30874                                  
 30875                                  stowUMB:
 30876                                  	cmp	al,MAXUMB ; 16
 30877                                  	jb	short su10
 30878                                  	stc
 30879                                  	retn			; Ooops-- UMB>=MAXUMB
 30880                                  su10:	
 30881                                  	push	bx
 30882                                  	push	di
 30883                                  	push	si
 30884                                  	push	ds
 30885                                  	push	es
 30886                                  	push	cs
 30887                                  	pop	es
 30888                                  	push	cs
 30889                                  	pop	ds
 30890                                  	
 30891                                  	;cmp	byte [UmbLoad],0FFh
 30892                                  	cmp	byte [UmbLoad],UNSPECIFIED ; If this, we haven't been here before
 30893                                  	jne	short su20
 30894                                  	mov	[UmbLoad],al	; So remember this UMB as the load UMB slot.
 30895                                  su20:	
 30896                                  	or	al,al		; If they gave UMB 0, there's really nothing
 30897                                  	jz	short su30	; that we should do here.
 30898                                  
 30899                                  	mov	bl,al
 30900                                  	xor	bh,bh
 30901                                  	mov	ax,1		; Now, AX = 1, and BX = UMB Number
 30902                                  
 30903                                  	xchg	[es:bx+UmbUsed],al
 30904                                  
 30905                                  	or	al,al		; If it was already 1, then al==1... and that
 30906                                  	jz	short su30	; means an error.
 30907                                  
 30908                                  	stc			; OOOPS!  This one's been used before.  :(
 30909                                  su30:	
 30910                                  	pop	es
 30911                                  	pop	ds
 30912                                  	pop	si
 30913                                  	pop	di
 30914                                  	pop	bx
 30915                                  	retn
 30916                                  
 30917                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30918                                  ;*** stowSiz - marks a given UMB as having a given minimum size
 30919                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30920                                  ; ENTRY:    CL contains UMB number, AX contains size
 30921                                  ; EXIT:     None
 30922                                  ; ERROR:    None
 30923                                  ; USES:     AX, DX, Flags, variables in highvar.inc
 30924                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30925                                  
 30926                                  ; 13/05/2019
 30927                                  
 30928                                  stowSiz:
 30929                                  	push	bx
 30930                                  	;push	di ; ?
 30931                                  	push	es
 30932                                  
 30933                                  	push	cs
 30934                                  	pop	es	
 30935                                  
 30936                                  	mov	bl,cl			; Now bl==UMB number, AX==size
 30937                                  	mov	bh,0			;     bx==UMB number, AX==size
 30938                                  	shl	bl,1			;     bx==offset into array, AX=size
 30939                                  	mov	[es:bx+UmbSize],ax	; Store the size
 30940                                  	
 30941                                  	pop	es
 30942                                  	;pop	di ; ?
 30943                                  	pop	bx
 30944                                  
 30945                                  	retn
 30946                                  
 30947                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30948                                  ;*** toDigit - converts a character-digit to its binary counterpart
 30949                                  ;            -- verifies that CL contains a valid character-digit; if so, it
 30950                                  ; changes CL to its counterpart binary digit ((CL-'0') or (CL-'A'+10)).
 30951                                  ; A-F are considered valid iff gnradix is 16.
 30952                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30953                                  ; ENTRY:    CL contains a digit ('0' to '9' or, if gnradix==16, 'A' to 'F')
 30954                                  ; EXIT:     CL contains digit in binary (0 to 9 or, if gnradix==16, 0 to 15)
 30955                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set indicates invalid digit; carry clear indicates good digit
 30956                                  ; USES:     CL, Flags
 30957                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30958                                  ; If the string is preceeded with "0x", the value is read as hexadecimal; else,
 30959                                  ; as decimal. After a read, you may check the radix by examining gnradix--it
 30960                                  ; will be 10 or 16.
 30961                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30962                                  
 30963                                  gnradix:
 30964                                  	dw	0		; Must be a word--16x16 multiplication
 30965                                  
 30966                                  toDigit:
 30967                                  	cmp	word [cs:gnradix],16
 30968                                  	jne	short td20	; Don't check hex digits if radix isn't 16
 30969                                  
 30970                                  toDigit_hex:
 30971                                  	cmp	cl,'a'	; 61h
 30972                                  	jb	short td10
 30973                                  	cmp	cl,'f'	; 66h
 30974                                  	ja	short tdE	; Nothing valid above 'z' at all...
 30975                                  	sub	cl,'a'-10 ; 57h	; Make 'a'==10 and return.
 30976                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 30977                                  	retn
 30978                                  td10:	
 30979                                  	cmp	cl,'A'  ; 41h
 30980                                  	jb	short td20	; Below 'A'?  Not a letter...
 30981                                  	cmp	cl,'F'	; 46h
 30982                                  	ja	short tdE	; Above 'F'?  Not a digit.
 30983                                  	sub	cl,'A'-10 ; 37h	; Make 'A'==10 and return.
 30984                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 30985                                  	retn
 30986                                  toDigit_dec:
 30987                                  td20:	
 30988                                  	cmp	cl,'0'		; If less than zero,
 30989                                  	;jb	short tdE	; Done.
 30990                                  	jb	short tdEr ; 08/04/2019
 30991                                  	cmp	cl,'9'		; Or, if greater than nine,
 30992                                  	ja	short tdE	; Done.
 30993                                  	sub	cl,'0'	; 30h	; Okay--make '0'==0 and return.
 30994                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 30995                                  	retn
 30996                                  tdE:	
 30997                                  	stc
 30998                                  tdEr:		; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0	
 30999                                  	retn
 31000                                  
 31001                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31002                                  ;*** GetXNum - reads a 32-bit ASCII number at ES:SI and returns it in DX:AX
 31003                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31004                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to an ascii string to scan
 31005                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI moved to first invalid digit, DX:AX contains value read
 31006                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if # is too big, or has no digits (EOL possibly)
 31007                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, DX, AX, Flags, gnradix
 31008                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31009                                  ; If the string is preceeded with "0x", the value is read as hexadecimal; else,
 31010                                  ; as decimal. After a read, you may check the radix by examining gnradix--it
 31011                                  ; will be 10 or 16.
 31012                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31013                                  
 31014                                  ; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31015                                  
 31016                                  GetXNum:
 31017                                  	;pushreg <bx, cx, ds>
 31018                                  	push	bx
 31019                                  	push	cx
 31020                                  	push	ds
 31021                                  
 31022                                  	cld
 31023                                  	xor	ax,ax
 31024                                  	xor	bx,bx
 31025                                  	xor	cx,cx
 31026                                  	xor	dx,dx			; Start with 0 (makes sense)
 31027                                  
 31028                                  	mov	word [cs:gnradix],10	; And default to a radix of 10 (dec)
 31029                                  
 31030                                  	mov	cl,[es:si]		; Now AX=0, BX=0, CH=0/CL=char, DX=0
 31031                                  	;call	toDigit
 31032                                  	call	toDigit_dec
 31033                                  	jc	short gxnE		; If it's not a digit, leave now.
 31034                                  
 31035                                  	or	cl,cl
 31036                                  	jnz	short gxn20		; Doesn't have '0x'
 31037                                  	mov	cl,[es:si+1]
 31038                                  	cmp	cl,'x'			; Either 'x'...
 31039                                  	je	short gxn10
 31040                                  	cmp	cl,'X'			; ...or 'X' means it's hexadecimal
 31041                                  	jne	short gxn20
 31042                                  
 31043                                  gxn10:	
 31044                                  	mov	word [cs:gnradix], 16
 31045                                  	inc	si			; Since we read "0x", march over it.
 31046                                  	inc	si
 31047                                  
 31048                                  ; ------------------------------------------------------
 31049                                  ; GXN20--ES:SI = a digit in a number; if not, we're done
 31050                                  ;        DX:AX = current total
 31051                                  ;        BX    = 0
 31052                                  ;        CH    = 0
 31053                                  ; ------------------------------------------------------
 31054                                  
 31055                                  gxn20:	
 31056                                  	mov	cl,[es:si]	; Now DX:AX=current total, CH=0/CL=char
 31057                                  	inc	si
 31058                                  
 31059                                  	call	toDigit		; Accepts only valid digits, A-F -> 10-16
 31060                                  	jc	short gxnQ	; <- Ah... wasn't a digit. Stop.
 31061                                  
 31062                                  	call	mul32		; Multiply DX:AX by gnradix
 31063                                  	jc	short gxnX	; (if it's too big, error out)
 31064                                  
 31065                                  	add	ax,cx		; Add the digit
 31066                                  	adc	dx,bx		; (BX is 0!)--Adds 1 iff last add wrapped
 31067                                  	;jc	short gxnX	; If _that_ wrapped, it's too big.
 31068                                  	;jmp	short gxn20
 31069                                  	jnc	short gxn20
 31070                                  gxnE:	
 31071                                  	;stc			; In this case, we need to set the carry
 31072                                  	jmp	short gxnX	; and leave--there were no digits given.
 31073                                  gxnQ:	
 31074                                  	dec	si		; Don't read in the offensive character.
 31075                                  	clc			; And clear carry, so they know it's okay.
 31076                                  gxnX:	
 31077                                  	pop	ds
 31078                                  	pop	cx
 31079                                  	pop	bx
 31080                                  	retn
 31081                                  
 31082                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31083                                  ;*** mul32 - multiplies the number in DX:AX by gnradix
 31084                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31085                                  ; ENTRY:   DX:AX = the number to be multiplied, BX = 0, gnradix = multiplier
 31086                                  ; EXIT:    DX:AX has been multiplied by gnradix if carry clear; BX still 0
 31087                                  ; ERROR:   Carry set if number was too large
 31088                                  ; USES:    Flags, AX, DX
 31089                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31090                                  
 31091                                  mul32:
 31092                                  	push	ax		; DX=old:hi, AX=old:lo, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 31093                                  	mov	ax,dx		; DX=old:hi, AX=old:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 31094                                  	mul	word [cs:gnradix] ; DX=?, AX=new:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 31095                                  	jc	short m32E	; Too big?
 31096                                  
 31097                                  	mov	dx,ax		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 31098                                  	pop	ax		; DX=new:hi, AX=old:lo, TOS=orig, BX=0
 31099                                  
 31100                                  	xchg	dx,bx		; DX=0, AX=old:lo, TOS=orig, BX=new:hi
 31101                                  	mul	word [cs:gnradix] ; DX=carry,  AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=new:hi
 31102                                  	xchg	dx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=carry
 31103                                  	add	dx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=carry
 31104                                  	xor	bx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=0
 31105                                  	retn
 31106                                  m32E:	
 31107                                  	pop	ax
 31108                                  	retn
 31109                                  
 31110                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31111                                  ;*** toPara - divides DX:AX by 16; result in AX only (discards extra DX data)
 31112                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31113                                  ; ENTRY:   DX:AX = the number to be divided
 31114                                  ; EXIT:    Interpereting DX:AX as bytes, AX=paragraph equivalent, 0xFFFF max
 31115                                  ; ERROR:   None
 31116                                  ; USES:    Flags, AX, DX
 31117                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31118                                  ; Note: The 386 has a 32-bit SHR, which would work perfectly for this... but we
 31119                                  ;       can't ensure a 386 host machine. Sorry.
 31120                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31121                                  
 31122                                  toPara:
 31123                                  	push	cx		; DX:AX=HHHH hhhh hhhh hhhh:LLLL llll llll llll
 31124                                  
 31125                                  	mov	cl,4		;
 31126                                  	shr	ax,cl		; DX:AX=HHHH hhhh hhhh hhhh:0000 LLLL llll llll
 31127                                  	xchg	ax,dx		; DX:AX=0000 LLLL llll llll:HHHH hhhh hhhh hhhh
 31128                                  	mov	cl,12
 31129                                  	shl	ax,cl		; DX:AX=0000 LLLL llll llll:hhhh 0000 0000 0000
 31130                                  	or	ax,dx		;    AX=hhhh LLLL llll llll
 31131                                  
 31132                                  	pop	cx
 31133                                  	retn
 31134                                  
 31135                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31136                                  ;*** UmbHead - returns in AX the address of the first UMB block (0x9FFF)
 31137                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31138                                  ; ENTRY:  Nothing
 31139                                  ; EXIT:   AX contains 0x9FFF for most systems
 31140                                  ; ERROR:  Carry set if pointer is 0xFFFF (if not set up yet--DH runs into this)
 31141                                  ; USES:   Flags, AX
 31142                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31143                                  ; Early in the boot-cycle, the pointer used to obtain this value isn't set up;
 31144                                  ; to be precise, before a UMB provider is around. In this event, the pointer
 31145                                  ; is always set to 0xFFFF; it changes once a provider is around. On most
 31146                                  ; machines (all of 'em I've seen), it changes to 0x9FFF at that point.
 31147                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31148                                  
 31149                                  UmbHead:
 31150                                  	; 13/05/2019 (because of callers, pushs & pops are not needed here)
 31151                                  
 31152                                  	;push	si ; ?
 31153                                  	;push	ds ; ? 
 31154                                  	;push	es
 31155                                  	;push	bx ; *	
 31156                                  
 31157                                  	; 09/04/2019
 31158                                  	; !!! No need to save es,bx,ds,si above !!! (es,bx are changed here)
 31159                                  
 31160                                  	mov	ah,GET_IN_VARS		; Call int 21h, function 52h...
 31161                                  	int	21h
 31162                                  
 31163                                  	mov	ax,[es:DOS_UMB_HEAD]	; And read what's in ES:[008C]
 31164                                  	cmp	ax,0FFFFh
 31165                                  	je	short uhE		; If it's 0xFFFF, it's an error...
 31166                                  
 31167                                  	clc				; Else, it isn't (CLC done by prev cmp)
 31168                                  	;jmp	short uhX
 31169                                  	; 12/12/2022
 31170                                  	retn
 31171                                  uhE:	
 31172                                  	stc
 31173                                  uhX:	
 31174                                  	;pop	bx ; *
 31175                                  	;pop	es
 31176                                  	;pop	ds ; ?
 31177                                  	;pop	si ; ?
 31178                                  	retn

 31182                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31183                                  ; ENTRY:  ES:0 should point to a valid MCB
 31184                                  ; EXIT:   ZF set if owned by SC+8 or SC+9 (for japan)
 31185                                  ; USES:   Flags

 31189                                  	;push	ax
 31190

 31193                                  	;je	short ism10

 31195                                  	;;je	short ism10
 31196                                  	;;jmp	short ismX		; Anything else isn't.
 31197                                  	;jne	short ismX
 31198                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],SystemPSPOwner ; 8  ; 09/04/2019
 31199                                  	jne	short ismX 
 31200                                  ism10:	
 31201                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME]	; Check the name...
 31202                                  	;cmp	ax,'SC' ; 4353h
 31203                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME],'SC'

 31210                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31211                                  ;*** AddrToUmb - converts a segment address in AX to its appropriate UMB number
 31212                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31213                                  ; ENTRY:  AX contains a segment address
 31214                                  ; EXIT:   AX will contain the UMB number which contains the address (0==conv)
 31215                                  ; ERROR:  If the address is above UM Range, AX will return as FFFF.
 31216                                  ; USES:   Flags, AX
 31217                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31218                                  ; An address in the following areas is treated as:
 31219                                  ;    0      <-> umbhead (0x9FFF)          = Conventional memory
 31220                                  ;    0x9FFF <-> addr of first UM sys MCB  = UMB #1
 31221                                  ;      ...
 31222                                  ;    addr of last UM sys MCB <-> TOM      = invalid; returns #0xFFFF
 31223                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31224                                  
 31225                                  AddrToUmb:
 31226                                  	push	cx
 31227                                  	push	dx
 31228                                  	push	es
 31229                                  
 31230                                  	mov	dx,ax		; DX = address to search for
 31231                                  
 31232                                  	call	UmbHead		; AX = first segment
 31233                                  	jc	short atuE	; If it couldn't get it, error out.
 31234                                  
 31235                                  	; 14/08/2023
 31236                                  	;mov	es,ax ; *	; ES = first UMB segment
 31237                                  	xor	cx,cx ; 0	; Pretend we're on UMB 0 for now... (cx = UMB#)
 31238                                  
 31239                                  	; 22/07/2023
 31240                                  atu10:
 31241                                  	mov	es,ax ; * ; ** ; 14/08/2023
 31242                                  ; ----------------------------------------
 31243                                  ; ATU10--ES - Current MCB address
 31244                                  ;        DX - Address given for conversion
 31245                                  ;        CX - Current UMB #
 31246                                  ; ----------------------------------------
 31247                                  
 31248                                  ;atu10:	
 31249                                  	;mov	ax,es ; * ; 14/08/2023
 31250                                          cmp	ax,dx		; Present segment >= given segment?
 31251                                  	jae	short atuX	; Yep--done.
 31252                                  
 31253                                  	call	isSysMCB	; Returns with ZF set if this is a system MCB
 31254                                  	jnz	short atu20
 31255                                  
 31256                                  	inc	cx		; If it _was_ a system MCB, we're in a new UMB.
 31257                                  atu20:	
 31258                                  	;mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 31259                                  	;cmp	al,arena_signature_end  ; 'Z'
 31260                                  	; 14/08/2023
 31261                                  	; ax = es
 31262                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 31263                                  	add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31264                                  	cmp	byte [es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],arena_signature_end
 31265                                  	je	short atu30		; 'Z' means this was the last MCB... that's it.
 31266                                  
 31267                                  	;NextMCB es,ax
 31268                                  
 31269                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 31270                                  	;;add	ax,[es:3]
 31271                                  	;add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31272                                  	inc	ax
 31273                                  	; 14/08/2023
 31274                                  	;mov	es,ax ; *
 31275                                  	jmp	short atu10
 31276                                  
 31277                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31278                                  ; if we get to atu30, they specified a number that was past the last MCB.
 31279                                  ; make sure it's not _inside_ that MCB before we return an error condition.
 31280                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31281                                  
 31282                                  atu30:	
 31283                                  	; 14/08/2023
 31284                                  	; ax = es + [es:ARENA.SIZE] 
 31285                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 31286                                  	;add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE] ; **
 31287                                  	cmp	ax,dx		; Present >= given?
 31288                                  	jae	short atuX	; Yep! It _was_ inside.
 31289                                  atuE:	
 31290                                  	xor	cx,cx ; 0	; Else, fall through with UMB # == -1
 31291                                  	dec	cx		; (that makes it return 0xFFFF and sets CF)
 31292                                  atuX:	
 31293                                  	mov	ax,cx		; Return the UMB number in AX
 31294                                  	
 31295                                  	pop	es	
 31296                                  	pop	dx
 31297                                  	pop	cx
 31298                                  	retn
 31299                                  
 31300                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31301                                  ;*** convUMB - checks after GetXNum to convert an address to a UMB number
 31302                                  ;            -- if GetXNum read a hex number, we interperete that as a segment
 31303                                  ; address rather than a UMB number... and use that address to look up a UMB.
 31304                                  ; This routine checks for that condition and calls AddrToUmb if necessary.
 31305                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31306                                  ; ENTRY:  AX contains a UMB number or segment, gnradix has been set by GetXNum
 31307                                  ; EXIT:   AX will contain a UMB number
 31308                                  ; ERROR:  None
 31309                                  ; USES:   Flags, AX
 31310                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31311                                  
 31312                                  convUMB:
 31313                                  	cmp	word [cs:gnradix],16
 31314                                  	jne	short cu10	; If it didn't read in hex, it's not an address
 31315                                  	call	AddrToUmb	; Else, convert the address to a UMB number
 31316                                  ;cmp	ax,0FFFFh
 31317                                  	;jne	short cu10
 31318                                  	;inc	ax		; If too high, ignore it (make it conventional)
 31319                                  	; 14/08/2023
 31320                                  	inc	ax
 31321                                  	jz	short cu10	; If too high, ignore it (make it conventional)
 31322                                  	dec	ax
 31323                                  cu10:	
 31324                                  	retn

 31345                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31346                                  ;*** loadLow - returns AL==0 if UMB0 == 0, else AL==1
 31347                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31348                                  ; ENTRY:  None
 31349                                  ; EXIT:   AL==0 if mem strategy should be set to LOW_FIRST, else AL==1
 31350                                  ;         Carry set if UMB0 not specified (_NOT_ an error)
 31351                                  ; ERROR:  None
 31352                                  ; USES:   Flags, fm_strat, fm_umb
 31353                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31354                                  ; We want to set the memory strategy to LOW_FIRST if the user specified a
 31355                                  ; load UMB, and it is 0.  That 0 can be either from the user having _specified_
 31356                                  ; zero (/L:0;...), or from having specified a too-big min size (/L:1,99999999)
 31357                                  ; such that the load UMB is too small, and shouldn't be used.
 31358                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31359                                  
 31360                                  loadLow:
 31361                                  	;push	ds
 31362                                  	;push	cs		; Point DS into appropriate data segment
 31363                                  	;pop	ds	
 31364                                  
 31365                                  	;mov	al,[UmbLoad]
 31366                                  	mov	al,[cs:UmbLoad]
 31367                                  	cmp	al,UNSPECIFIED ; 0FFh, -1
 31368                                  	jne	short ll10
 31369                                  
 31370                                  	stc
 31371                                  ll15:
 31372                                  	mov	al,1		; Return with AL==1 && STC if no UMBs specified
 31373                                  	;stc
 31374                                  	;jmp	short llX
 31375                                  	retn
 31376                                  ll10:	
 31377                                  	or	al,al		; AL=the load UMB: Is it == 0?
 31378                                  	;jz	short llX	; Yep... CF==0 (from OR) && AL=0, so just exit
 31379                                  
 31380                                  	jnz	short ll15	; 09/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31381                                  	retn
 31382                                  
 31383                                  	;mov	al,1
 31384                                  	;clc
 31385                                  ;llX:
 31386                                  	;pop	ds		; Return DS to where it was
 31387                                  	;retn

 31389                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31390                                  ;*** HideUMBs - links UMBs and hides upper-memory as appropriate
 31391                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31392                                  ; ENTRY:  None
 31393                                  ; EXIT:   None
 31394                                  ; ERROR:  None
 31395                                  ; USES:   Flags, fm_strat, fm_umb
 31396                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31397                                  
 31398                                  HideUMBs:
 31399                                  	push	ax
 31400                                  	push	cx
 31401                                  	push	ds
 31402                                  	push	es
 31403                                  
 31404                                  	call	UmbTest		; See if we REALLY linked in anything...
 31405                                  	jc	short husX	; ...if not, there's nothing for us to do.
 31406                                  
 31407                                  	call	FixMem		; Concatenate adjacent free MCBs in upper mem
 31408                                  	call	setUMBs		; Link UMBs and set memory-allocation strategy
 31409

 31411                                  	mov	byte [cs:fInHigh],1
 31412                                  
 31413                                  	;call	GetLoadUMB	; See if they gave us a list to leave free
 31414                                  	mov	al,[cs:UmbLoad] ; 09/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31415                                  
 31416                                  	cmp	al,UNSPECIFIED	; If they didn't,
 31417                                  	je	short husX	; then we shouldn't do this loop:
 31418                                  
 31419                                  	xor	cx,cx
 31420                                  
 31421                                  ; -----------------------------------------------
 31422                                  ; HUS10-CX - UMB number (after inc, 1==first UMB)
 31423                                  ; -----------------------------------------------
 31424                                  
 31425                                  hus10:	inc	cx		; For each UMB:
 31426                                  	cmp	cx,MAXUMB ; 16
 31427                                  	jae	short hus20
 31428                                  
 31429                                  	mov	al,cl		; (stopping as soon as we're outside of the
 31430                                  	push	es
 31431                                  	call	findUMB		; valid range of UMBs)
 31432                                  	pop	es		; push/pop: trash what findumb finds.  :-)
 31433                                  	jc	short hus20
 31434                                  
 31435                                  	call	_hideUMB_	; hide what we need to hide.
 31436                                  
 31437                                  	jmp	short hus10
 31438                                  hus20:	
 31439                                  	;call	GetLoadUMB	; Now check if they offered /L:0
 31440                                  	mov	al,[cs:UmbLoad] ; 09/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0	
 31441                                  
 31442                                  	or	al,al		; --Is the load UMB 0? (-1==unspecified)
 31443                                  	jnz	short husX	; If not, we're done.
 31444                                  
 31445                                  	call	hl_unlink	; If so, however, fix UMBs and strategy.
 31446                                  husX:	
 31447                                  	pop	es
 31448                                  	pop	ds
 31449                                  	pop	cx
 31450                                  	pop	ax
 31451                                  	retn

 31594                                  
 31595                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31596                                  ;*** hideUMB - marks as HIDDEN all FREE elements in UMB passed as AL
 31597                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31598                                  ; ENTRY:    AL must indicate a valid UMB; 0==conv && is invalid.
 31599                                  ; EXIT:     None; free elements in UMB marked as hidden
 31600                                  ; ERROR:    None
 31601                                  ; USES:     Flags
 31602                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31603                                  
 31604                                  hideUMB:
 31605                                  	push	ax
 31606                                  	push	es
 31607                                  
 31608                                  	call	findUMB		; Returns with carry if err, else ES == MCB
 31609                                  	jc	short huX
 31610                                  
 31611                                  ; ------------------------------------------------
 31612                                  ; HU10--ES - MCB inside UMB; if it's a system MCB,
 31613                                  ;            we're not in the same UMB, so exit.
 31614                                  ; ------------------------------------------------
 31615                                  
 31616                                  hu10:	call	isSysMCB	; Returns with ZF set if owner is SYSTEM
 31617                                  	jz	short huX	; If it is, we've finished the UMB.
 31618                                  	;call	isFreeMCB	; Returns with ZF set if owner is 0
 31619                                  	or	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],0
 31620                                  	jnz	short hu20
 31621                                  
 31622                                  	call	hideMCB
 31623                                  hu20:	
 31624                                  	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 31625                                  	cmp	al,arena_signature_end  ;'Z'
 31626                                  	jz	short huX	; 'Z' means this was the last MCB... that's it.
 31627                                  
 31628                                  	;NextMCB es, ax		; Go on forward.
 31629                                  	mov     ax,es
 31630                                  	;add	ax,[es:3]
 31631                                  	add     ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31632                                  	inc     ax
 31633                                  	mov     es,ax
 31634                                  
 31635                                  	jmp	short hu10
 31636                                  huX:	
 31637                                  	pop	es
 31638                                  	pop	ax
 31639                                  	retn
 31640                                  
 31641                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31642                                  ;*** isTiny - returns with ZF set if user didn't specify /S
 31643                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31644                                  ; ENTRY:    None
 31645                                  ; EXIT:     ZF set if user DIDN'T specify /S
 31646                                  ; ERROR:    None

 31659                                  	;pop	ds

 31661                                  	mov	al,[cs:fUmbTiny]		
 31662

 31664                                  	pop	ax
 31665                                  	retn
