 31674                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31675                                  
 31676                                  ;isFreeMCB:
 31677                                  ;	or	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],0
 31678                                  ;	retn
 31679                                  
 31680                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31681                                  ;*** hideMCB - marks as HIDDEN the MCB at ES:0
 31682                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31683                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:0 should point to an MCB
 31684                                  ; EXIT:     None; MCB marked as HIDDEN
 31685                                  ; ERROR:    None
 31686                                  ; USES:     None
 31687                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31688                                  
 31689                                  hideMCB:
 31690                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],SystemPSPOwner ; 8
 31691                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.NAME+0], 'HI' ; 4948h
 31692                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.NAME+2], 'DD' ; 4444h
 31693                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.NAME+4], 'EN' ; 4E45h
 31694                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.NAME+6], '  ' ; 2020h	
 31695                                  	retn
 31696                                  
 31697                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31698                                  ;*** unHideMCB - marks as FREE the MCB at ES:0
 31699                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31700                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:0 should point to an MCB
 31701                                  ; EXIT:     None; MCB marked as FREE
 31702                                  ; ERROR:    None
 31703                                  ; USES:     None
 31704                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31705                                  
 31706                                  unHideMCB:
 31707                                  	push	ax
 31708                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],FreePSPOwner ; 0
 31709                                  	mov	ax,'  ' ; 2020h
 31710                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+0],ax
 31711                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+2],ax
 31712                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+4],ax
 31713                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+6],ax
 31714                                  	pop	ax

 31716                                  
 31717                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31718                                  ;*** findUMB - makes ES:0 point to the first MCB in UMB given as AL
 31719                                  ;            -- returns UmbHEAD pointer (0x9FFF) if passed AL==0
 31720                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31721                                  ; ENTRY:    AL should be to a valid UMB number
 31722                                  ; EXIT:     ES:0 points to first MCB in UMB (_not_ the 8+SC MCB that heads it)
 31723                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if couldn't reach UMB (too high)
 31724                                  ; USES:     Flags, ES
 31725                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31726                                  
 31727                                  findUMB:
 31728                                  	push	ax
 31729                                  	push	cx
 31730                                  	push	dx
 31731                                  
 31732                                  	xor	ah,ah		; Zap ah, so al==ax
 31733                                  
 31734                                  	mov	dx,ax		; Store the to-be-found UMB number in DX
 31735                                  
 31736                                  	call	UmbHead		; Returns first UMB segment in AX
 31737                                  	mov	es,ax
 31738                                  	xor	cx,cx		; Pretend we're on UMB 0 for now...
 31739                                  
 31740                                  ; ---------------------------------------------
 31741                                  ; FU10--CX - This UMB number; 0 == conventional
 31742                                  ;       DX - The UMB number they're looking for
 31743                                  ;       ES - The current MCB address
 31744                                  ; ---------------------------------------------
 31745                                  
 31746                                  fu10:	
 31747                                  	cmp	cx,dx		; If CX==DX, we've found the UMB we're
 31748                                  	je	short fuX	; searching for--so exit.
 31749                                  
 31750                                  	call	isSysMCB	; Returns with ZF set if owner is SYSTEM
 31751                                  	jnz	short fu20
 31752                                  
 31753                                  	inc	cx		; If it _was_ SYSTEM, we're in a new UMB.
 31754                                  fu20:	
 31755                                  	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 31756                                  	cmp	al,arena_signature_end ; 'Z'
 31757                                  	je	short fuE	; 'Z' means this was the last MCB... that's it.
 31758                                  
 31759                                  	;NextMCB es, ax		; Go on forward.
 31760                                  	mov     ax,es
 31761                                  	;add	ax,[es:3]
 31762                                  	add     ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31763                                  	inc     ax
 31764                                  	mov     es,ax
 31765                                  
 31766                                  	jmp	short fu10
 31767                                  fuE:	
 31768                                  	stc
 31769                                  fuX:
 31770                                  	pop	dx
 31771                                  	pop	cx
 31772                                  	pop	ax		; The address is already in ES.
 31773                                  	retn
 31774                                  
 31775                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31776                                  ;*** BigFree - makes ES:0 point to the largest free MCB in UMB given as AL
 31777                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31778                                  ; ENTRY:    AL should be to a valid UMB number
 31779                                  ; EXIT:     ES:0 points to largest free MCB in UMB, AX returns its size
 31780                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if couldn't reach UMB (0 or too high)
 31781                                  ; USES:     Flags, ES
 31782                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31783                                  
 31784                                  BigFree:
 31785                                  	push	bx
 31786                                  	push	cx
 31787                                  
 31788                                  	call	findUMB			; Returns with CF if err, else ES==MCB
 31789                                  	jc	short bfX		; (would be "jc bfE"; it just does stc)
 31790                                  
 31791                                  	xor	bx,bx			; Segment address of largest free MCB
 31792                                  	xor	cx,cx			; Size of largest free MCB
 31793                                  
 31794                                  ; ---------------------------------------------
 31795                                  ; BF10--ES - Current MCB address
 31796                                  ;       BX - Address of largest free MCB so far
 31797                                  ;       CX - Size of largest free MCB so far
 31798                                  ; ---------------------------------------------
 31799                                  
 31800                                  bf10:	
 31801                                  	call	isSysMCB		; If we've left the MCB, we're done.
 31802                                  	jz	short bf30
 31803                                  
 31804                                  	;call	isFreeMCB		; Returns with ZF set if owner is 0
 31805                                  	or	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],0
 31806                                  	jnz	short bf20
 31807                                  
 31808                                  	mov	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31809                                  	;cmp	cx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]	; Compare sizes...
 31810                                  	cmp	cx,ax
 31811                                  	jg	short bf20		; Unless we're bigger,
 31812                                  
 31813                                  	mov	bx,es			; Store this new element's address,
 31814                                  	;mov	cx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]	; and its size.
 31815                                  	mov	cx,ax
 31816                                  
 31817                                  bf20:	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 31818                                  	cmp	al,arena_signature_end	; 'Z'
 31819                                  	jz	short bf30		; 'Z' means this was the last MCB.
 31820                                  
 31821                                  	;NextMCB es,ax		; Go on forward.
 31822                                  	mov     ax,es
 31823                                  	;add	ax,[es:3]
 31824                                  	add     ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31825                                  	inc     ax
 31826                                  	mov     es,ax
 31827                                  
 31828                                  	jmp	short bf10
 31829                                  
 31830                                  bf30:	mov	es,bx			; Return the address
 31831                                  	mov	ax,cx			; Return the size
 31832                                  	or	bx,bx
 31833                                  	jnz	short bfX		; (if size==0, there's nothing free)
 31834                                  bfE:	
 31835                                  	stc
 31836                                  bfX:
 31837                                  	pop	cx
 31838                                  	pop	bx
 31839                                  	retn
 31840                                  
 31841                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31842                                  ;*** isSpecified - sets ZF if UMB in AL wasn't specified in DH/LH line.
 31843                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31844                                  ; ENTRY:    AL should be to a valid UMB number
 31845                                  ; EXIT:     ZF set if UMB wasn't specified, ZF clear if it was
 31846                                  ; ERROR:    None
 31847                                  ; USES:     Flags
 31848                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31849                                  
 31850                                  isSpecified:
 31851                                  	push	ax
 31852                                  
 31853                                  	xor	bh,bh
 31854                                  	mov	bl,al
 31855                                  
 31856                                  	;getdata al, DS:UmbUsed[bx]
 31857                                  	;
 31858                                  	;push	ds
 31859                                  	;push	cs
 31860                                  	;pop	ds
 31861                                  	;mov	al,[bx+UmbUsed]
 31862                                  	;pop	ds
 31863                                  	
 31864                                  	mov	al,[cs:bx+UmbUsed]
 31865                                  	or	al,al			; Sets ZF if al==0 (ie, if unspecified)
 31866                                  
 31867                                  	pop	ax
 31868                                  	retn
 31869                                  
 31870                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31871                                  ;*** shrinkMCB - breaks an MCB into two pieces, the lowest one's size==AX
 31872                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31873                                  ; ENTRY:    AX == new size, ES:0 == current MCB
 31874                                  ; EXIT:     None; MCB broken if carry clear
 31875                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if MCB isn't as large as AX+0x20 (not a useful split)
 31876                                  ; USES:     Flags
 31877                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31878                                  ; If the size of the to-be-split MCB isn't at least 0x20 bytes greater than
 31879                                  ; the specified new size, the split is useless; if it's only 0x10 bytes, that
 31880                                  ; 0x10 will be used to make a header that mentions a 0-byte free space, and
 31881                                  ; that just sucks up 0x10 bytes for nothing. So we make 0x20 bytes the
 31882                                  ; minimum for performing a split.
 31883                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31884                                  
 31885                                  MIN_SPLIT_SIZE	equ	20h
 31886                                  
 31887                                  shrinkMCB:
 31888                                  	;pushreg <bx, cx, es>
 31889                                  	push	bx
 31890                                  	push	cx
 31891                                  	push	es
 31892                                  
 31893                                  	mov	bx,ax			; Move things around... and
 31894                                  	mov	ax,es			; save this one for later.
 31895                                  
 31896                                  	mov	cx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31897                                  	sub	cx,MIN_SPLIT_SIZE ; 32
 31898                                  	;cmp	bx,cx			; {New size} vs {Current Size-20h}
 31899                                  	;ja	short smE		; if wanted_size > cur-20h, abort.
 31900                                  	; 18/12/2022
 31901                                  	cmp	cx,bx
 31902                                  	jb	short smE ; (*)
 31903                                  
 31904                                  	mov	dl,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 31905                                  	mov	cx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31906                                  
 31907                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.SIZE],bx
 31908                                  	mov	byte [es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],'M'
 31909                                  
 31910                                  	add	ax,bx
 31911                                  	inc	ax
 31912                                  	mov	es,ax			; Move to new arena area
 31913                                  
 31914                                  	mov	ax,cx
 31915                                  	sub	ax,bx
 31916                                  	; 12/12/2022
 31917                                  	; ax > 0
 31918                                  	dec	ax			; And prepare the new size
 31919                                  
 31920                                  	; 18/12/2022
 31921                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],dl
 31922                                  	;mov	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],0 ; (**)
 31923                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.SIZE],ax
 31924                                  	;mov	ax,'  ' ; 2020h
 31925                                  	;mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+0],ax ; (**)
 31926                                  	;mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+2],ax ; (**)
 31927                                  	;mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+4],ax ; (**)
 31928                                  	;mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+6],ax ; (**)
 31929                                  
 31930                                  	; 18/12/2022
 31931                                  	call	freeMCB	; (**)
 31932                                  
 31933                                  	; 12/12/2022
 31934                                  	; cf=0
 31935                                  	;clc
 31936                                  	; 18/12/2022
 31937                                  	;jmp	short smX
 31938                                  smE:	
 31939                                  	; 18/12/2022
 31940                                  	; cf=1 (*)
 31941                                  	;stc
 31942                                  smX:	
 31943                                  	;popreg	<es, cx, bx>
 31944                                  	pop	es
 31945                                  	pop	cx
 31946                                  	pop	bx
 31947                                  	retn
 31948                                  
 31949                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31950                                  ;*** hideUMB? - hides as appropriate the UMB in CL
 31951                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31952                                  ; ENTRY:    CL should be to a valid UMB number, and AX to its address (findUMB)
 31953                                  ; EXIT:     None; UMB is hidden as necessary
 31954                                  ; ERROR:    None
 31955                                  ; USES:     Flags, AX, CX
 31956                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31957                                  ; PRIMARY LOGIC:
 31958                                  ;
 31959                                  ; If the UMB is specified in the DH/LH statement, then:
 31960                                  ;    If the largest free segment is too small (check specified size), then:
 31961                                  ;       Pretend it wasn't ever specified, and fall out of this IF.
 31962                                  ;    Else, if largest free segment is LARGER than specified size, then:
 31963                                  ;       If /S was given on the command-line, then:
 31964                                  ;          Break that element into two pieces
 31965                                  ;          Set a flag that we're shrinking
 31966                                  ;       Endif
 31967                                  ;    Endif
 31968                                  ; Endif
 31969                                  ; If the UMB is NOT specified (or was removed by the above):
 31970                                  ;    Hide all free elements in the UMB
 31971                                  ;    If the flag that we're shrinking was set, then:
 31972                                  ;       UN-hide the lower portion of the shrunken UMB
 31973                                  ;    ENDIF
 31974                                  ; ENDIF
 31975                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31976                                  
 31977                                  _hideUMB_:
 31978                                  	push	bx
 31979                                  	push	dx
 31980                                  	push	es
 31981                                  
 31982                                  	mov	al,cl
 31983                                  	call	isSpecified	; Returns ZF set if al's umb was NOT specified
 31984                                  	jz	short hu_20
 31985                                  
 31986                                  	mov	al,cl		; Retrieve the size of the largest
 31987                                  	call	BigFree		; free element in AX; put its address in ES
 31988                                  	jc	short hu_20	; Oops. Errors mean skip this part.
 31989                                  
 31990                                  	push	ax		; TOS==size of BigFree in UMB (popped as BX)
 31991                                  	mov	al,cl		; Retrieve the user's specified
 31992                                  	call	GetSize		; minimum size for this umb (into AX)
 31993                                  	pop	bx		; Now BX==BigFree, AX==Specified Size
 31994                                  
 31995                                  	or	ax,ax		; If they didn't specify one,
 31996                                  	jz	short hu_20	; Skip over all this.
 31997                                  
 31998                                  	cmp	ax,bx		; Ah... if (specified > max free)
 31999                                  	jbe	short hu_10
 32000                                  
 32001                                  	mov	al,cl		;   Then mark that UMB as unused. Nya nya.
 32002                                  	call	unMarkUMB
 32003                                  	jmp	short hu_20
 32004                                  hu_10:	
 32005                                  	call	isTiny		; Returns ZF clear if user specified /S
 32006                                  	jz	short hu_20
 32007                                  
 32008                                  	call	shrinkMCB	; They specified /S, so shrink the MCB to AX
 32009                                  	jc	short hu_20	; Ah... if didn't shrink after all, skip this:
 32010                                  
 32011                                  	mov	dx,es
 32012                                  	jmp	short hu_30	; Skip the spec check.. we wanna hide this one.
 32013                                  
 32014                                  hu_20:	mov	ax,cx
 32015                                  	call	isSpecified	; If they specified this UMB, we're done...
 32016                                  	jnz	short hu_X	; so leave.
 32017                                  
 32018                                  	xor	dx,dx
 32019                                  hu_30:	
 32020                                  	mov	al,cl
 32021                                  
 32022                                  	call	hideUMB		; Hides everything in UMB #al
 32023                                  
 32024                                  	or	dx,dx		; Did we shrink a UMB? If not, DX==0,
 32025                                  	jz	short hu_X	; So we should leave.
 32026                                  
 32027                                  	mov	es,dx		; Ah, but if it isn't, DX==the MCB's address;
 32028                                  	call	unHideMCB	; Un-hides the lower portion of that MCB.
 32029                                  hu_X:	
 32030                                  	pop	es
 32031                                  	pop	dx
 32032                                  	pop	bx
 32033                                  	retn
 32034                                  
 32035                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32036                                  ;*** UnFreeze - Marks FROZEN elements as FREE
 32037                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32038                                  ; Entry:  None
 32039                                  ; Exit:   None; all 8+FROZEN elements are marked as FREE, from any UMB.
 32040                                  ; Error:  None
 32041                                  ; Uses:   Flags
 32042                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32043                                  
 32044                                  UnFreeze:
 32045                                  	push	ax
 32046                                  	push	es
 32047                                  
 32048                                  	call	UmbHead		; Returns with carry if err, else ES == MCB
 32049                                  	jc	short ufX
 32050                                  
 32051                                  	mov	es,ax
 32052                                  
 32053                                  ; ------------------------------
 32054                                  ; UF10--ES - Current MCB address
 32055                                  ; ------------------------------
 32056                                  
 32057                                  uf10:	call	isFrozMCB	; Returns with ZF set if MCB is FROZEN
 32058                                  	jnz	short uf20
 32059                                  	call	unHideMCB
 32060                                  uf20:	
 32061                                  	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 32062                                  
 32063                                  	cmp	al,arena_signature_end ; 'Z'
 32064                                  	jz	short ufX	; 'Z' means this was the last MCB... that's it.
 32065                                  
 32066                                  	;NextMCB es, ax		; Go on forward.
 32067                                  	mov     ax,es
 32068                                  	;add	ax,[es:3]
 32069                                  	add     ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 32070                                  	inc     ax
 32071                                  	mov     es,ax
 32072                                  
 32073                                  	jmp	short uf10
 32074                                  ufX:	
 32075                                  	pop	es
 32076                                  	pop	ax
 32077                                  	retn
 32078                                  
 32079                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32080                                  ;*** isFrozMCB - returns with ZF set if current MCB (ES:0) is FROZEN
 32081                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32082                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:0 should point to an MCB
 32083                                  ; EXIT:     ZF set if MCB is frozen, else !ZF
 32084                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32085                                  ; USES:     Flags
 32086                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32087                                  
 32088                                  isFrozMCB:
 32089                                  	;push	ax
 32090                                  
 32091                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.OWNER]	; Check the owner...
 32092                                  	;cmp	ax,SystemPSPOwner	; 8 (for US OR Japan) is valid
 32093                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],SystemPSPOwner
 32094                                  	jne	short ifmX
 32095                                  
 32096                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME+0]
 32097                                  	;cmp	ax,'FR' ; 5246h
 32098                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME+0],'FR'
 32099                                  	jne	short ifmX
 32100                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME+2]
 32101                                  	;cmp	ax,'OZ' ; 5A4Fh
 32102                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME+2],'OZ'
 32103                                  	jne	short ifmX
 32104                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME+4]
 32105                                  	;cmp	ax,'EN' ; 4E45h
 32106                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME+4],'EN'
 32107                                  	jne	short ifmX
 32108                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME+6]
 32109                                  	;cmp	ax,'  ' ; 2020h
 32110                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME+6],'  '
 32111                                  ifmX:	
 32112                                  	;pop	ax
 32113                                  	retn
 32114                                  
 32115                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32116                                  ;*** frezMCB - marks as 8+FROZEN the MCB at ES:0
 32117                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32118                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:0 should point to an MCB
 32119                                  ; EXIT:     None; MCB frozen
 32120                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32121                                  ; USES:     None
 32122                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32123                                  
 32124                                  frezMCB:
 32125                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],SystemPSPOwner ; 8
 32126                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.NAME+0],'FR'
 32127                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.NAME+2],'OZ'
 32128                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.NAME+4],'EN'
 32129                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.NAME+6],'  '
 32130                                  	retn
 32131                                  
 32132                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32133                                  ;*** FreezeUM - Marks FROZEN all UM elements now FREE, save those in load UMB
 32134                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32135                                  ; Entry:  None
 32136                                  ; Exit:   None; all free elements not in load UMB marked as 8+FROZEN
 32137                                  ; Error:  None
 32138                                  ; Uses:   Flags
 32139                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32140                                  
 32141                                  FreezeUM:
 32142                                  	push	ax
 32143                                  	push	cx
 32144                                  	push	dx
 32145                                  	push	es
 32146                                  
 32147                                  	;call	GetLoadUMB
 32148                                  	mov	al,[cs:UmbLoad] ; 19/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 32149                                  
 32150                                  	xor	ah,ah		; Zap ah, so al==ax
 32151                                  	mov	dx,ax		; Store the load UMB in DX, so we can skip it
 32152                                  
 32153                                  	call	UmbHead		; Returns first UMB segment in AX
 32154                                  	mov	es,ax
 32155                                  	xor	cx,cx		; Pretend we're on UMB 0 for now...
 32156                                  
 32157                                  ; -----------------------------------------
 32158                                  ; FUM10--ES - Current MCB address
 32159                                  ;        CX - Current UMB number
 32160                                  ;        DX - UMB number to skip (load UMB)
 32161                                  ; -----------------------------------------
 32162                                  
 32163                                  fum10:	call	isSysMCB	; Returns with ZF set if owner is SYSTEM
 32164                                  	jnz	short fum20
 32165                                  
 32166                                  	inc	cx		; If it _was_ SYSTEM, we're in a new UMB.
 32167                                  fum20:	
 32168                                  	cmp	cx,dx		; If this is the load UMB, we don't want to
 32169                                  	je	short fum30	; freeze anything... so skip that section.
 32170                                  
 32171                                  	;call	isFreeMCB	; Oh. If it's not free, we can't freeze it
 32172                                  	or	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],0
 32173                                  	jnz	short fum30	; either.
 32174                                  
 32175                                  	call	frezMCB
 32176                                  fum30:	
 32177                                  	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 32178                                  	cmp	al,arena_signature_end ; 'Z'
 32179                                  	je	short fumX	; 'Z' means this was the last MCB... that's it.
 32180                                  
 32181                                  	;NextMCB es, ax		; Go on forward.
 32182                                  	mov     ax,es
 32183                                  	;add	ax,[es:3]
 32184                                  	add     ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 32185                                  	inc     ax
 32186                                  	mov     es,ax
 32187                                  	
 32188                                  	jmp	short fum10
 32189                                  
 32190                                  fumX:	pop	es
 32191                                  	pop	dx
 32192                                  	pop	cx
 32193                                  	pop	ax
 32194                                  	retn
 32195                                  
 32196                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32197                                  ;*** UmbTest - returns with carry set if UMBs are not available, else CF==false
 32198                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32199                                  ; ENTRY:    None
 32200                                  ; EXIT:     Carry is clear if UMBs are available, or set if they are not
 32201                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32202                                  ; USES:     CF (AX,BX,DS,ES pushed 'cause they're used by others)
 32203                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32204                                  
 32205                                  UmbTest:
 32206                                  	push	ax
 32207                                  	push	bx
 32208                                  	push	ds
 32209                                  	push	es
 32210                                  
 32211                                  	call	fm_link			; Link in UMBs (if not already linked)
 32212                                  	call	WalkMem			; Check to see if they're really linked
 32213                                  	pushf				; And remember what we found out
 32214                                  	call	fm_unlink		; Unlink UMBs (if WE have linked 'em)
 32215                                  	popf				; And restore what we found out.
 32216                                  
 32217                                  	pop	es
 32218                                  	pop	ds
 32219                                  	pop	bx
 32220                                  	pop	ax
 32221                                  	retn
 32222                                  
 32223                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32224                                  ;*** WalkMem - travels memory chain and returns carry clear iff UMBs are linked
 32225                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32226                                  ; ENTRY:    None
 32227                                  ; EXIT:     Carry SET if MCB chain stops before 9FFF, CLEAR if stops >= 9FFF.
 32228                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32229                                  ; USES:     Flags
 32230                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32231                                  
 32232                                  WalkMem:
 32233                                  	push	ax ; ?
 32234                                  	push	bx ; ?
 32235                                  	push	es ; ? no need to save contents of these registers ?
 32236                                  		   	
 32237                                  	mov	ah,GET_IN_VARS		; Call int 21h, function 52h...
 32238                                  	int	21h
 32239                                  
 32240                                  	mov	ax,[es:bx-2]
 32241                                  	mov	es,ax
 32242                                  
 32243                                  ; ------------------------------
 32244                                  ; UM10: ES = Current MCB pointer
 32245                                  ; ------------------------------
 32246                                  
 32247                                  um10:	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 32248                                  	cmp	al,arena_signature_end ;  'Z'
 32249                                  	je	short um20		; If signature == 'Z', hay no more.
 32250                                  
 32251                                  	;NextMCB es, bx			; Move to the next MCB
 32252                                  
 32253                                  	mov     bx,es
 32254                                  	;add	bx,[es:3]
 32255                                  	add     bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 32256                                  	inc     bx
 32257                                  	mov     es,bx
 32258                                  		
 32259                                  	jmp	short um10		; And restart the loop.
 32260                                  um20:	
 32261                                  	mov	ax,es
 32262                                  
 32263                                  	cmp	ax,9FFFh		; This sets CF iff ax < 9FFF.
 32264                                  
 32265                                  	pop	es ; ?
 32266                                  	pop	bx ; ?
 32267                                  	pop	ax ; ?
 32268                                  	retn
 32269                                  
 32270                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32271                                  ;*** hl_unlink - unlinks UMBs if fm_umb is set to 0; restores strategy too
 32272                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32273                                  ; ENTRY:    fm_umb == 1 : leave linked, else unlink
 32274                                  ; EXIT:     None
 32275                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32276                                  ; USES:     AX, BX
 32277                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32278                                  
 32279                                  hl_unlink:
 32280                                  	xor	bh,bh
 32281                                  
 32282                                  	;getdata bl,fm_umb		; Restore original link-state
 32283                                  	;
 32284                                  	;push	ds
 32285                                  	;push	cs
 32286                                  	;pop	ds
 32287                                  	;mov	bl,[fm_umb]
 32288                                  	;pop	ds
 32289                                  
 32290                                  	mov	bl,[cs:fm_umb]
 32291                                  
 32292                                  	mov	ax,DOS_SET_UMBLINK ; 5803h
 32293                                  	int	21h
 32294                                  	retn
 32295

 32297                                  ; HIGHEXIT.INC (MSDOS 6.0 - 1991)

 32299                                  ; 09/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 32300                                  
 32301                                  ;   Module:   HIGHEXIT.INC - Code executed after LoadHigh or DeviceHigh
 32302                                  ;   Date:     May 14, 1992
 32303                                  
 32304                                  ;   Modification log:
 32305                                  ;
 32306                                  ;     DATE    WHO      DESCRIPTION
 32307                                  ;   --------  -------  --------------------------------------------------------

 32310                                  
 32311                                  UMB_HeadIdx	equ	8Ch	; Offset from ES (after func52h) to get UMBHead
 32312                                  
 32313                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32314                                  ;*** UnHideUMBs - Marks HIDDEN elements as FREE
 32315                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32316                                  ; ENTRY:  None; perhaps, earlier, HideUMBs was called... if not, we have
 32317                                  ;               very little to do, as no elelments will be marked as HIDDEN.
 32318                                  ; EXIT:   Sets InHigh to zero; carry clear if HideUMBs was called earlier.
 32319                                  ; ERROR:  None
 32320                                  ; USES:   fInHigh (from highvar.inc), carry flag
 32321                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32322                                  
 32323                                  UnHideUMBs:
 32324                                  	push	ax		; Save ax for what we're about to do
 32325                                  
 32326                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32327                                  ; BUGBUG t-richj 11-8-92: The following six lines were commented out for a good
 32328                                  ;    length of time. Those six constitute a check of whether or not we should
 32329                                  ;    indeed clean up the upper-memory chain; without such a check, COMMAND.COM
 32330                                  ;    will destroy the current link-state and memory-allocation strategy after
 32331                                  ;    every command execution.
 32332                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32333                                  
 32334                                  	;getdata al,fInHigh	; Get InHigh from data segment
 32335                                  	;
 32336                                  	;push	ds
 32337                                  	;push	cs
 32338                                  	;pop	ds
 32339                                  	;mov	al,[fInHigh]
 32340                                  	;pop	ds	
 32341                                  
 32342                                  	mov	al,[cs:fInHigh]
 32343                                  
 32344                                  	or	al,al
 32345                                  	jnz	short uhu10	; If didn't call loadhigh/devicehigh earlier,
 32346                                  
 32347                                  	pop	ax		; then there's nothing to do here... so
 32348                                  	stc			; restore everything and return. Just like
 32349                                  	retn			; that.
 32350                                  uhu10:	
 32351                                  	call	linkumb		; Make sure UMBs are linked in.
 32352                                  	call	FreeUMBs
 32353                                  
 32354                                  	;putdata fInHigh,0	; We're leaving, so update fInHigh.
 32355                                  	;
 32356                                  	;push	es
 32357                                  	;push	cs
 32358                                  	;pop	es
 32359                                  	;mov	byte [es:fInHigh],0
 32360                                  	;pop	ds	
 32361                                  
 32362                                  	mov	byte [cs:fInHigh],0	
 32363                                  
 32364                                  	call	he_unlink	; Unlink UMBs
 32365                                  
 32366                                  	pop	ax
 32367                                  	; 12/12/2022
 32368                                  	;clc	; 12/12/2022 (this clc may not be necessary!?)
 32369                                  	retn
 32370                                  
 32371                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32372                                  ;*** he_unlink - unlinks UMBs if fm_umb is set to 0
 32373                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32374                                  ; ENTRY:    fm_umb == 1 : leave linked, else unlink
 32375                                  ; EXIT:     None
 32376                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32377                                  ; USES:     AX, BX
 32378                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32379                                  
 32380                                  he_unlink:
 32381                                  	xor	bh, bh
 32382                                  
 32383                                  	;getdata bl, fm_umb	; Restore original link-state
 32384                                  	mov	bl,[cs:fm_umb]	
 32385                                  
 32386                                  	mov	ax,DOS_SET_UMBLINK ; 5803h
 32387                                  	int	21h
 32388                                  	retn
 32389                                  
 32390                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32391                                  ;*** freeUMBs - frees all HIDDEN memory elements in upper-memory.
 32392                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32393                                  ; ENTRY:    None
 32394                                  ; EXIT:     None; HIDDEN memory elements returned to FREE
 32395                                  ; ERROR:    None (ignore CF)
 32396                                  ; USES:     Flags
 32397                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32398                                  
 32399                                  FreeUMBs:
 32400                                  	push	ax
 32401                                  	push	es
 32402                                  
 32403                                  	call	HeadUmb		; Returns with carry if err, else ES == MCB
 32404                                  	jc	short fusX
 32405                                  
 32406                                  	mov	es,ax		; Prepare for the loop; ES = current MCB addr.
 32407                                  fus10:	
 32408                                  	call	isHideMCB	; Returns with ZF set if owner is 0
 32409                                  	jnz	short fus20
 32410                                  	call	freeMCB
 32411                                  fus20:	   
 32412                                  	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 32413                                  	cmp	al,arena_signature_end ; 'Z'
 32414                                  	jz	short fusX	; That means this was the last MCB--that's it.
 32415                                  
 32416                                  	mov	ax,es
 32417                                  	add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 32418                                  	inc	ax
 32419                                  	mov	es,ax		; Go on forward.
 32420                                  
 32421                                  	jmp	short fus10
 32422                                  fusX:	
 32423                                  	pop	es
 32424                                  	pop	ax
 32425                                  	retn
 32426                                  
 32427                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32428                                  ;*** isHideMCB - returns with ZF set if current MCB (ES:0) is HIDDEN
 32429                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32430                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:0 should point to an MCB
 32431                                  ; EXIT:     ZF set if MCB is hidden, else !ZF
 32432                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32433                                  ; USES:     Flags
 32434                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32435                                  
 32436                                  isHideMCB:
 32437                                  	;push	ax
 32438                                  
 32439                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],SystemPSPOwner ; If the owner's SYSTEM
 32440                                  	jne	short ihm_x				; then check for HIDDEN
 32441                                  
 32442                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME]
 32443                                  	;cmp	ax,'HI' ; 4948h
 32444                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME+0],'HI'
 32445                                  	jne	short ihm_x
 32446                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME+2]
 32447                                  	;cmp	ax,'DD' ; 4444h
 32448                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME+2],'DD'
 32449                                  	jne	short ihm_x
 32450                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME+4]
 32451                                  	;cmp	ax,'EN' ; 4E45h
 32452                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME+4],'EN'
 32453                                  	jne	short ihm_x
 32454                                  	;mov	ax,[es:ARENA.NAME+6]
 32455                                  	;cmp	ax,'  ' ; 2020h
 32456                                  	cmp	word [es:ARENA.NAME+6],'  '
 32457                                  ihm_x:	
 32458                                  	;pop	ax
 32459                                  	retn
 32460                                  
 32461                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32462                                  ;*** freeMCB - marks as free the MCB at ES:0
 32463                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32464                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:0 should point to an MCB
 32465                                  ; EXIT:     None; MCB free'd
 32466                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32467                                  ; USES:     AX
 32468                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32469                                  
 32470                                  freeMCB:
 32471                                  	mov	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],0
 32472                                  	mov	ax,'  '
 32473                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+0],ax
 32474                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+2],ax
 32475                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+4],ax
 32476                                  	mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+6],ax
 32477                                  	retn
 32478                                  
 32479                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32480                                  ;*** HeadUmb - returns in AX the address of the first UMB block (0x9FFF)
 32481                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32482                                  ; ENTRY:  Nothing
 32483                                  ; EXIT:   AX contains 0x9FFF for most systems
 32484                                  ; ERROR:  Carry set if pointer is 0xFFFF (if not set up yet--DH runs into this)
 32485                                  ; USES:   Flags, AX
 32486                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32487                                  
 32488                                  HeadUmb:
 32489                                  	; 13/05/2019
 32490                                  
 32491                                  	;push	si ; ?
 32492                                  	;push	ds ; ?
 32493                                  	;push	es
 32494                                  	;push	bx ; *
 32495                                  
 32496                                  	; 09/04/2019
 32497                                  	; !!! No need to save es,bx,ds,si above !!! (es,bx are changed here)
 32498                                  
 32499                                  	mov	ah,GET_IN_VARS		; Call int 21h, function 52h...
 32500                                  	int	21h
 32501                                  			; DOS - 2+ internal - GET LIST OF LISTS
 32502                                  			; Return: ES:BX -> DOS list of lists
 32503                                  	;mov	ax,[es:8Ch]
 32504                                  	mov	ax,[es:UMB_HeadIdx]	; And read what's in ES:008C
 32505                                  	cmp	ax,0FFFFh
 32506                                  	;je	short xhu_e		; If it's 0xFFFF, it's an error...
 32507                                  
 32508                                  	;clc				; Else, it isn't.
 32509                                  	;jmp	short xhu_x
 32510                                  xhu_e:	
 32511                                  	;stc
 32512                                  	cmc	; 09/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0 ; *
 32513                                  xhu_x:	
 32514                                  	;pop	bx ; *
 32515                                  	;pop	es	
 32516                                  	;pop	ds ; ?
 32517                                  	;pop	si ; ?
 32518                                  	retn
 32519                                  
 32520                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32521                                  ;*** linkumb - links UMBs not already linked in; updates fm_umb as needed
 32522                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32523                                  ; ENTRY:    None
 32524                                  ; EXIT:     fm_umb == 0 if not linked in previously, 1 if already linked in
 32525                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32526                                  ; USES:     AX, BX, fm_umb
 32527                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32528                                  
 32529                                  linkumb:
 32530                                  	mov	ax,DOS_GET_UMBLINK ; 5802h
 32531                                  	int	21h			; Current link-state is now in al
 32532                                  
 32533                                  	or	al,al			; BUGBUG: proper check?
 32534                                  	jnz	short lumbX		; Jumps if UMBs already linked in
 32535                                  
 32536                                  	mov	ax,DOS_SET_UMBLINK ; 5803h
 32537                                  	mov	bx,1
 32538                                  	int	21h
 32539                                  lumbX:
 32540                                  	retn
 32541

 32544                                  ; 01/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)

 32547                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 32548                                  ; SYSCONF.ASM (MSDOS 6.0 - 1991)

 32551                                  
 32552                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32553                                  ;
 32554                                  ; procedure : InitDevLoad
 32555                                  ;
 32556                                  ;	Input : DeviceHi = 0 indicates load DD in low memory
 32557                                  ;			 = 1 indicates load in UMB:
 32558                                  ;		           ConvLoad = 0 indicates a new-style load (see below)
 32559                                  ;		                    = 1 indicates a DOS 5-style load
 32560                                  ;		DevSize  = Size of the device driver file in paras
 32561                                  ;
 32562                                  ;	Output : none
 32563                                  ;
 32564                                  ;	Initializes DevLoadAddr, DevLoadEnd & DevEntry.
 32565                                  ;	Also sets up a header for the Device driver entry for mem utility
 32566                                  ;
 32567                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32568                                  ; For a "new-style load", we break off the current DevEntry and link the umbs
 32569                                  ; as we see fit, using HideUMBs (and UnHideUMBs at exit, though _it_ decides
 32570                                  ; whether it's entitled to do anything). HideUMBs uses the chart built by
 32571                                  ; ParseVar to determine which UMBs to leave FREE, and which not.
 32572                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32573                                  
 32574                                  	; 01/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 32575                                  InitDevLoad:
 32576                                  	; 11/12/2022
 32577                                  	; ds = cs
 32578 00002751 803E[651E]00            	cmp	byte [DeviceHi],0
 32579                                  	;cmp	byte [cs:DeviceHi],0	; Are we loading in UMB ?
 32580                                  	;je	short InitForLo		; no, init for lo mem
 32581 00002756 741F                    	je	short initforlo_x ; 09/04/2019
 32582                                  
 32583                                  ; 01/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 32584                                  ;	cmp	byte [cs:ConvLoad],1	; Are we loading as per DOS 5?
 32585                                  ;	je	short InitForConv
 32586                                  ;
 32587                                  ;; There are two stages to preparing upper-memory; first, we mark as 8+HIDDEN
 32588                                  ;; any areas not specified on the /L:... chain. Second, we mark as 8+FROZEN
 32589                                  ;; any areas left in upper-memory, except for elements in the load UMB...
 32590                                  ;; we then malloc space as per Dos-5 style, and mark as free any spaces which
 32591                                  ;; are 8+FROZEN (but leave 8+HIDDEN still hidden). The load is performed,
 32592                                  ;; and UnHideUMBs later on marks all 8+HIDDEN as free.
 32593                                  ;
 32594                                  ;	call	ShrinkUMB		; Stop using the old device arena
 32595                                  ;
 32596                                  ;	call	HideUMBs		; Mark up the UM area as we see fit
 32597                                  ;	call	FreezeUM		; Hide everything BUT the load area
 32598                                  ;	call	GetUMBForDev		; And grab that load area as needed
 32599                                  ;	pushf
 32600                                  ;	call	UnFreeze		; Then unhide everything frozen
 32601                                  ;	popf
 32602                                  ;
 32603                                  ;	jc	short InitForLo		; (if carry, it's loading low)
 32604                                  ;
 32605                                  ;	jmp	short InitForHi
 32606                                  
 32607                                  	; 01/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 32608                                  	; (SYSINIT:2B67h)
 32609                                  InitForConv:
 32610                                  	; 11/12/2022
 32611                                  	; ds = cs
 32612 00002758 E83700                  	call	SpaceInUMB		; Do we have space left in the
 32613                                  					;  current UMB ?
 32614 0000275B 7308                    	jnc	short InitForHi		; yes, we have
 32615 0000275D E83C04                  	call	ShrinkUMB		; shrink the current UMB in use
 32616 00002760 E84500                  	call	GetUMBForDev		; else try to allocate new UMB
 32617 00002763 720D                    	jc	short InitForLo		; we didn't succeed, so load
 32618                                  					;  in low memory
 32619                                  InitForHi:
 32620                                  	; 11/12/2022
 32621                                  	; ds = cs
 32622                                  	;mov	ax,[cs:DevUMBFree]	; get Para addr of free mem
 32623                                  	;mov	dx,[cs:DevUMBAddr]	; UMB start addr
 32624                                  	;add	dx,[cs:DevUMBSize]	; DX = UMB End addr
 32625 00002765 A1[5B1E]                	mov	ax,[DevUMBFree]
 32626 00002768 8B16[571E]              	mov	dx,[DevUMBAddr]
 32627 0000276C 0316[591E]              	add	dx,[DevUMBSize]
 32628 00002770 EB0C                    	jmp	short idl1
 32629                                  
 32630                                  InitForLo:
 32631                                  	; 11/12/2022
 32632                                  	; ds = cs
 32633                                  	;mov	byte [cs:DeviceHi],0	; in case we failed to load
 32634 00002772 C606[651E]00            	mov	byte [DeviceHi],0
 32635                                  initforlo_x:
 32636                                  	; 11/12/2022
 32637                                  	; ds = cs
 32638                                  					;  into UMB indicate that
 32639                                  					;  we are loading low
 32640                                  	;mov	ax,[cs:memhi]		; AX = start of Low memory
 32641                                  	;mov	dx,[cs:ALLOCLIM]	; DX = End of Low memory
 32642 00002777 A1[E003]                	mov	ax,[memhi]
 32643 0000277A 8B16[A302]              	mov	dx,[ALLOCLIM]
 32644                                  idl1:
 32645 0000277E E86600                  	call	DevSetMark		; setup a sub-arena for DD
 32646                                  	; 11/12/2022
 32647                                  	; ds = cs
 32648                                  	;mov	[cs:DevLoadAddr],ax	; init the Device load address
 32649                                  	;mov	[cs:DevLoadEnd],dx	; init the limit of the block
 32650                                  	;mov	word [cs:DevEntry],0	; init Entry point to DD
 32651                                  	;mov	[cs:DevEntry+2],ax
 32652 00002781 A3[4A1E]                	mov	[DevLoadAddr],ax
 32653 00002784 8916[4C1E]              	mov	[DevLoadEnd],dx
 32654 00002788 C706[4E1E]0000          	mov	word [DevEntry],0
 32655 0000278E A3[501E]                	mov	[DevEntry+2],ax
 32656 00002791 C3                      	retn
 32657                                  
 32658                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32659                                  ;
 32660                                  ; procedure : SpaceInUMB?
 32661                                  ;
 32662                                  ;	Input : DevUMBAddr, DevUMBSize, DevUMBFree & DevSize
 32663                                  ;	Output : Carry set if no space in UMB
 32664                                  ;		 Carry clear if Space is available for the device in
 32665                                  ;		   current UMB
 32666                                  ;
 32667                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32668                                  
 32669                                  SpaceInUMB:
 32670                                  	; 11/12/2022
 32671                                  	; ds = cs
 32672                                  	;mov	ax,[cs:DevUMBSize]
 32673                                  	;add	ax,[cs:DevUMBAddr]	; End of UMB
 32674                                  	;sub	ax,[cs:DevUMBFree]	; - Free = Remaining space

 33607                                  ;

 33609                                  ;	iff it's free. Coalesce is usually used to join free blocks, but

 33980                                  ; 14/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 33981                                  
 33982                                  ; Multiple configuration block support  Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 33983                                  ;
 33984                                  ; Summary:
 33985                                  ;
 33986                                  ;   The procedure "organize" crunches the in-memory copy of config.sys
 33987                                  ;   into lines delimited by CR/LF (sometimes no CR, but *always* an LF)
 33988                                  ;   with the leading "keyword=" replaced by single character codes (eg, B
 33989                                  ;   for BUFFERS, D for DEVICE, Z for any unrecognized keyword); see comtab
 33990                                  ;   and/or config.inc for the full list.
 33991                                  ;
 33992                                  ;   [blockname] and INCLUDE are the major syntactical additions for multi-
 33993                                  ;   configuration support. blockname is either MENU, which contains one
 33994                                  ;   or more MENUITEM lines, an optional MENUDEFAULT (which includes optional
 33995                                  ;   time-out), or any user-defined keyword, such as NETWORK, CD-ROM, etc.
 33996                                  ;   INCLUDE allows the current block to name another block for inclusion
 33997                                  ;   during the processing phase of CONFIG.SYS. An INCLUDE is only honored
 33998                                  ;   once, precluding nasty infinite-loop scenarios. If blocks are present
 33999                                  ;   without a MENU block, then only lines inside COMMON blocks are processed.
 34000                                  ;
 34001                                  ; Example:
 34002                                  ;
 34003                                  ;   [menu]
 34004                                  ;   menuitem=misc,Miscellaneous
 34005                                  ;   menuitem=network,Network Configuration
 34006                                  ;   menudefault=network,15
 34007                                  ;
 34008                                  ;   [network]
 34009                                  ;   include misc
 34010                                  ;   device=foo
 34011                                  ;
 34012                                  ;   [misc]
 34013                                  ;   device=bar
 34014                                  ;   include alternate
 34015                                  ;
 34016                                  ;   [alternate]
 34017                                  ;   device=tar
 34018                                  ;
 34019                                  ;
 34020                                  ;   When the menu is displayed
 34021                                  ;
 34022                                  ;    1. Miscellaneous
 34023                                  ;    2. Network Configuration
 34024                                  ;
 34025                                  ;   #2 is highlighted as the default option, and will be automatically
 34026                                  ;   selected after 15 seconds. It will invoke the following lines in the
 34027                                  ;   following order:
 34028                                  ;
 34029                                  ;       DEVICE=BAR
 34030                                  ;       DEVICE=TAR
 34031                                  ;       DEVICE=FOO
 34032                                  ;
 34033                                  
 34034                                  ;MULTI_CONFIG equ 1
 34035                                  
 34036                                  ; the following depend on the positions of the various letters in switchlist
 34037                                  
 34038                                  switchnum	equ 11111000b ; 0F8h	; which switches require number
 34039                                  
 34040                                  flagec35	equ 00000100b ; 4	; electrically compatible 3.5 inch disk drive
 34041                                  flagdrive	equ 00001000b ; 8 
 34042                                  flagcyln	equ 00010000b ; 16
 34043                                  flagseclim	equ 00100000b ; 32
 34044                                  flagheads	equ 01000000b ; 64
 34045                                  flagff		equ 10000000b ; 128
 34046                                  
 34047                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34048                                  ; 19/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 34170                                  ;
 34171                                  ; procedure : parseline
 34172                                  ;
 34173                                  ; entry point is parseline. al contains the first character in command line.
 34174                                  ;
 34175                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34176                                  
 34177                                  	; 01/11/2022 - Retrodos v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 34178                                  	; (SYSINIT:30ACh)
 34179                                  
 34180                                  parseline:
 34181                                  	push	ds
 34182                                  
 34183                                  	push	cs
 34184                                  	pop	ds
 34185                                  
 34186                                  nextswtch:
 34187                                  	cmp	al,cr			; carriage return?
 34188                                  	je	short done_line
 34189                                  	cmp	al,lf			; linefeed?
 34190                                  	je	short put_back		; put it back and done
 34191                                  
 34192                                  ; anything less or equal to a space is ignored.
 34193                                  
 34194                                  	cmp	al,' '                  ; space?
 34195                                  	jbe	short getnext		; skip over space
 34196                                  	cmp	al,'/'
 34197                                  	je	short getparm
 34198                                  	stc				; mark error invalid-character-in-input
 34199                                  	jmp	short exitpl
 34200                                  
 34201                                  getparm:
 34202                                  	call	check_switch
 34203                                  	mov	[switches],bx		; save switches read so far
 34204                                  	jc	short swterr
 34205                                  getnext:
 34206                                  	call	getchr
 34207                                  	jc	short done_line
 34208                                  	jmp	short nextswtch
 34209                                  swterr:
 34210                                  	jmp	short exitpl		; exit if error
 34211                                  
 34212                                  done_line:
 34213                                  	; 12/12/2022
 34214                                  	test	byte [switches],flagdrive ; 8
 34215                                  	;test	word [switches],flagdrive ; 8 ; see if drive specified
 34216                                  	jnz	short okay
 34217                                  	stc				; mark error no-drive-specified
 34218                                  	jmp	short exitpl

 34515                                  ; procedure : setdeviceparameters
 34516                                  ;
 34517                                  ; setdeviceparameters sets up the recommended bpb in each bds in the
 34518                                  ; system based on the form factor. it is assumed that the bpbs for the
 34519                                  ; various form factors are present in the bpbtable. for hard files,
 34520                                  ; the recommended bpb is the same as the bpb on the drive.
 34521                                  ; no attempt is made to preserve registers since we are going to jump to
 34522                                  ; sysinit straight after this routine.
 34523                                  ;
 34524                                  ;	if we return carry, the DRIVPARM will be aborted, but presently
 34525                                  ;	  we always return no carry
 34526                                  ;
 34527                                  ;	note:  there is a routine by the same name in msdioctl.asm
 34528                                  ;
 34529                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34530
