 36231                                  ;
 36232                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36233                                  
 36234                                  srch_block:	          ; returns BX -> named block in CONFIG.SYS
 36235                                          push    ax              ;
 36236                                          push    cx              ;
 36237                                          mov     cx,[cs:count]   ;
 36238                                          push    si              ;
 36239                                          sub     si,si           ;
 36240                                          push    ds              ;
 36241                                          push    es              ;
 36242                                          pop     ds              ;
 36243                                          call    find_block      ;
 36244                                          mov     di,si           ;
 36245                                          mov     bx,cx           ;
 36246                                          pop     ds              ;
 36247                                          pop     si              ;
 36248                                          pop     cx              ;
 36249                                          pop     ax              ;
 36250                                  find_exit: ; 16/04/2019
 36251                                          retn			;
 36252                                  
 36253                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36254                                  ;
 36255                                  ;   find_block:  searches rest of config.sys for block name @DS:DI
 36256                                  ;
 36257                                  ;   INPUT
 36258                                  ;    DS:DI -> block name to find
 36259                                  ;    ES:SI -> remainder of config.sys image
 36260                                  ;       CX == remaining size of config.sys image
 36261                                  ;
 36262                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36263                                  ;       ZF flag set, if found (also, CF set if EOF)
 36264                                  ;    ES:SI -> where the search stopped (at end of block name or EOF)
 36265                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 36266                                  ;
 36267                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36268                                  ;       AX
 36269                                  ;
 36270                                  ;   NOTES
 36271                                  ;       This differs from "srch_block" in that it searches only the
 36272                                  ;       remaining portion of the config.sys image and leaves SI and CX
 36273                                  ;       pointing to where the search left off, and that it takes a pointer
 36274                                  ;       to search string in our own segment (DS:DI instead of ES:DI).
 36275                                  ;
 36276                                  ;   HISTORY
 36277                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36278                                  ;
 36279                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36280                                  
 36281                                  find_block:
 36282                                          call    get_char        ; get line code
 36283                                          jc	short find_exit	; end of file
 36284                                          and     al,~CONFIG_OPTION_QUERY
 36285                                          cmp     al,CONFIG_BEGIN ; beginning of a block?
 36286                                          je	short check_line ; no
 36287                                          cmp     al,CONFIG_INCLUDE
 36288                                          jne	short next_line	;
 36289                                          or	byte [cs:config_multi],1
 36290                                          jmp     short next_line ;
 36291                                  check_line:
 36292                                          or      byte [cs:config_multi],1
 36293                                          call    comp_names      ; compare block names
 36294                                          jbe	short find_exit	; end of file, or names matched
 36295                                  next_line:
 36296                                          call    skip_opt_line   ; no, so skip to next line
 36297                                          jmp	short find_block  ;
 36298                                  ;find_exit:
 36299                                  ;	retn
 36300                                  
 36301                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36302                                  ;
 36303                                  ;   comp_names:  compares keyword @DS:DI to position in config.sys @ES:SI
 36304                                  ;
 36305                                  ;   INPUT
 36306                                  ;    DS:DI -> keyword to compare
 36307                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 36308                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 36309                                  ;
 36310                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36311                                  ;       ZF flag set, if match (also, CF set if EOF)
 36312                                  ;    ES:SI -> where the comparison stopped (at end of block name or EOF)
 36313                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 36314                                  ;
 36315                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36316                                  ;       AX
 36317                                  ;
 36318                                  ;   NOTES
 36319                                  ;       None
 36320                                  ;
 36321                                  ;   HISTORY
 36322                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36323                                  ;
 36324                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36325                                  
 36326                                  comp_names:
 36327                                          push    di              ;
 36328                                  comp_loop:                      ;
 36329                                          call    get_char        ;
 36330                                          jc	short comp_exit	;
 36331                                          call    any_delim       ; is next character a delimiter?
 36332                                          mov     ah,[di]         ; (get next character we're supposed to match)
 36333                                          je	short comp_almost ; yes, it *could* be a match
 36334                                          inc     di              ;
 36335                                          and     ax,~2020h ; 0DFDFh 
 36336                                  				; BUGBUG -- assumes both names are alphanumeric -JTP
 36337                                          cmp     al,ah           ; match?
 36338                                          je	short comp_loop ; yes, keep looking at the characters
 36339                                          clc                     ; prevent erroneous eof indication: clear carry
 36340                                  comp_exit:                      ;
 36341                                          pop     di              ;
 36342                                          retn			;
 36343                                  comp_almost:                    ;
 36344                                          xchg    al,ah           ; we don't know for sure if it's a match
 36345                                          call    any_delim       ; until we verify that the second string has
 36346                                          xchg    al,ah           ; been exhausted also...
 36347                                          jmp     comp_exit       ; if we are, this call to any_delim will tell...
 36348                                  
 36349                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36350                                  
 36351                                  comp_names_safe:
 36352                                          push    ax
 36353                                          push    cx
 36354                                          push	si
 36355                                          push    ds
 36356                                          push    cs
 36357                                          pop     ds
 36358                                          call    comp_names
 36359                                          pop     ds
 36360                                  	pop	si
 36361                                          pop     cx
 36362                                          pop     ax
 36363                                          retn
 36364                                  
 36365                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36366                                  ;
 36367                                  ;   print_item:  display menu item #BL
 36368                                  ;
 36369                                  ;   INPUT
 36370                                  ;       BL == menu item # to display
 36371                                  ;
 36372                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36373                                  ;       Menu item displayed, with appropriate highlighting if BL == bDefBlock
 36374                                  ;
 36375                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36376                                  ;       None
 36377                                  ;
 36378                                  ;   NOTES
 36379                                  ;       This function saves/restores the current cursor position, so you
 36380                                  ;       needn't worry about it.
 36381                                  ;
 36382                                  ;   HISTORY
 36383                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36384                                  ;
 36385                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36386                                  
 36387                                  print_item:		; prints menu item #BL (1 to N)
 36388                                          push    ax              ;
 36389                                          push    bx              ;
 36390                                          push    cx              ;
 36391                                          push    dx              ;
 36392                                          push    si              ;
 36393                                          mov     ah,03h          ; get cursor position
 36394                                          mov     bh,[bMenuPage]  ; always page zero
 36395                                          int     10h             ; DH/DL = row/column
 36396                                          push    dx              ; save it
 36397                                          mov     ah,02h          ; set cursor position
 36398                                          mov     dh,bl           ;
 36399                                          add     dh,3            ;
 36400                                          mov     dl,5            ;
 36401                                          int     10h             ; set cursor position for correct row/col
 36402                                          mov     al,bl           ;
 36403                                          add     al,'0'          ; convert menu item # to ASCII digit
 36404                                          mov     ah,[bMenuColor] ; normal attribute
 36405                                          cmp     bl,[bDefBlock]  ; are we printing the current block?
 36406                                          jne	short print_other ; no
 36407                                          or      ah,70h          ; yes, set bgnd color to white
 36408                                          mov     ch,ah           ;
 36409                                          mov     cl,4            ;
 36410                                          rol     ch,cl           ;
 36411                                          cmp     ch,ah           ; are fgnd/bgnd the same?
 36412                                          jne	short print_other ; no
 36413                                          xor     ah,08h          ; yes, so modify the fgnd intensity
 36414                                  print_other:                    ;
 36415                                          mov     bh,0            ;
 36416                                          add     bx,bx           ;
 36417                                          mov     di,[aoffBlockDesc+bx]
 36418                                          mov     bl,ah           ; put the attribute in the correct register now
 36419                                          mov     bh,[bMenuPage]  ; get correct video page #
 36420                                          mov     ah,09h          ; write char/attr
 36421                                          mov     cx,1            ;
 36422                                          int     10h             ;
 36423                                          inc     dl              ; increment column
 36424                                          mov     ah,02h          ;
 36425                                          int     10h             ;
 36426                                          ;mov	ax,0900h+'.'    ;
 36427                                          mov	ax,092Eh
 36428                                  	int     10h             ; display '.'
 36429                                          inc     dl              ; increment column
 36430                                          mov     ah,02h          ;
 36431                                          int     10h             ;
 36432                                          ;mov	ax,0900h+' '    ;
 36433                                          mov	ax,0920h
 36434                                  	int     10h             ; display ' '
 36435                                          inc     dl              ; increment column
 36436                                          mov     ah,02h          ;
 36437                                          int     10h             ;
 36438                                          push    es              ;
 36439                                  print_loop:                     ;
 36440                                          mov     al,[es:di]	; get a character of the description
 36441                                          inc     di              ;
 36442                                          cmp     al,TAB ; 9	; substitute spaces for tabs
 36443                                          jne	short print_nontab ;
 36444                                          mov     al,' '          ;
 36445                                  print_nontab:                   ;
 36446                                          cmp     al,' '          ;
 36447                                          jb	short print_done ; stop at the 1st character < space
 36448                                          cmp     al,'$'          ;
 36449                                          je	short print_done ; also stop on $
 36450                                          mov     ah,09h          ; display function #
 36451                                          int     10h             ;
 36452                                          inc     dl              ; increment column
 36453                                          cmp     dl,78           ; far enough?
 36454                                          jae	short print_done ; yes
 36455                                          mov     ah,02h          ;
 36456                                          int     10h             ;
 36457                                          jmp     print_loop      ;
 36458                                  print_done:                     ;
 36459                                          pop     es              ;
 36460                                          pop     dx              ;
 36461                                          mov     ah,02h          ;
 36462                                          int     10h             ; restore previous row/col
 36463                                          pop     si              ;
 36464                                          pop     dx              ;
 36465                                          pop     cx              ;
 36466                                          pop     bx              ;
 36467                                          pop     ax              ;
 36468                                          retn			;
 36469                                  
 36470                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36471                                  ;
 36472                                  ;   select_item:  wait for user to select menu item, with time-out
 36473                                  ;
 36474                                  ;   INPUT
 36475                                  ;       None
 36476                                  ;
 36477                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36478                                  ;       BX == menu item # (1-N), or -1 for clean boot
 36479                                  ;       Selected menu item highlighted
 36480                                  ;       Cursor positioned beneath menu, ready for tty-style output now
 36481                                  ;
 36482                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36483                                  ;       None
 36484                                  ;
 36485                                  ;   NOTES
 36486                                  ;       None
 36487                                  ;
 36488                                  ;   HISTORY
 36489                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36490                                  ;
 36491                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36492                                  
 36493                                  select_item:		; returns digit value in BX (trashes AX/CX/DX)
 36494                                          mov     bl,[bDefBlock]  ; BL will be the default block #
 36495                                          mov     al,bl           ;
 36496                                          call    disp_num        ;
 36497                                          call    show_status     ; display current interactive status
 36498                                          cmp     byte [secTimeOut],-1
 36499                                          je	short input_key	; no time-out, just go to input
 36500                                          mov     ah,GET_TIME ; 2Ch
 36501                                          int     21h             ;
 36502                                          mov     bh,dh           ; BH = initial # of seconds
 36503                                  check_time:
 36504                                          mov     al,[secTimeOut] ;
 36505                                          sub     al,[secElapsed] ;
 36506                                          jae	short show_time	;
 36507                                          or      byte [bQueryOpt],2  ; disable all further prompting
 36508                                          mov     byte [secElapsed],0
 36509                                          jmp	select_done	; time's up!
 36510                                  show_time:
 36511                                          push    bx              ;
 36512                                          mov     bl,al           ; save # in BL
 36513                                          mov     bh,[bMenuPage]  ;
 36514                                          mov     ah,03h          ; get cursor position
 36515                                          int     10h             ;
 36516                                          push    dx              ;
 36517                                  	add	dl,8		; move cursor to the right
 36518                                          mov     ah,02h          ; set cursor position
 36519                                          int     10h             ;
 36520                                          mov     dx,_$TimeOut
 36521                                          call    print           ; print the "Time remaining: " prompt
 36522                                          mov     al,bl           ; recover # from BL
 36523                                          cbw                     ; this works because AL is always <= 90
 36524                                          mov     cl,10           ;
 36525                                          div     cl              ; AL = tens digit, AH = ones digit
 36526                                          mov     cl,ah           ;
 36527                                          add     al,'0'          ;
 36528                                          mov     ah,0Eh          ;
 36529                                          int     10h             ; write TTY tens digit
 36530                                          mov     al,cl           ;
 36531                                          add     al,'0'          ;
 36532                                          mov     ah,0Eh          ;
 36533                                          int     10h             ; write TTY ones digit
 36534                                          pop     dx
 36535                                          mov     ah,02h          ; set cursor position back to where it was
 36536                                          int     10h             ;
 36537                                          pop     bx              ;
 36538                                  input_key:
 36539                                          mov     ah,RAW_CON_IO ; 6
 36540                                          mov     dl,0FFh         ; input request
 36541                                          int     21h             ;
 36542                                          jnz	short got_key	;
 36543                                          cmp     byte [secTimeOut],-1; is there a time-out?
 36544                                          je	short input_key	; no, just go back to input
 36545                                          mov     ah,GET_TIME     ;
 36546                                          int     21h             ; DH = seconds
 36547                                          mov     ah,dh           ;
 36548                                          sub     dh,bh           ; should generally be zero or one
 36549                                          mov     bh,ah           ;
 36550                                          jnc	short got_time	;
 36551                                          mov     dh,1            ; it wrapped back to zero, so assume one
 36552                                  got_time:
 36553                                          or      dh,dh           ; any change?
 36554                                          jz	short input_key	; no
 36555                                          add     [secElapsed],dh ;
 36556                                          jmp	short check_time ;
 36557                                  got_key:
 36558                                          push    ax              ;
 36559                                          mov     ax,-1           ; zap both secTimeOut and secElapsed
 36560                                          xchg    [secTimeOut],ax
 36561                                          cmp     al,-1           ; was time-out already disabled?
 36562                                          je	short timeout_disabled ; yes
 36563                                          push    bx              ; let's disable # seconds display
 36564                                          mov     ax,0A20h        ; write multiple spaces
 36565                                          mov     bx,[bMenuColor]
 36566                                          mov     cx,80           ; 80 of them, to be safe
 36567                                          int     10h             ; to completely obliterate # seconds display
 36568                                          pop     bx   		;
 36569                                  
 36570                                  timeout_disabled:
 36571                                          pop     ax              ;
 36572                                          or      al,al           ; extended key pressed?
 36573                                          jnz	short normal_key ; no
 36574                                          int     21h             ; get the next part of the key then
 36575                                          jz	short input_key	; hmmm, what happened to the second part?
 36576                                  
 36577                                          cmp     al,48h          ; up arrow?
 36578                                          jne	short not_up	; no
 36579                                          cmp     bl,1            ; are we as up as up can get?
 36580                                          jbe	short input_key	; yes, ignore it
 36581                                          dec     byte [bDefBlock] ;
 36582                                          call    print_item      ; re-print the current item
 36583                                          dec     bl              ; and then print the new current item
 36584                                          jmp     short print1
 36585                                  not_up:
 36586                                          cmp     al,50h          ; down arrow?
 36587                                          jne	short not_down	; no
 36588                                          cmp     bl,[bMaxBlock]  ; are we as down as down can get?
 36589                                          jae	short to_input_key ; yes, ignore it
 36590                                          inc     byte [bDefBlock] ;
 36591                                          call    print_item      ; re-print the current item
 36592                                          inc     bx              ; and then print the new current item
 36593                                  print1: 
 36594                                  	mov     al,bl           ;
 36595                                  print2: 
 36596                                  	call    print_item      ;
 36597                                          call    disp_num        ;
 36598                                  to_input_key:
 36599                                          jmp     input_key       ;
 36600                                  not_down:
 36601                                          test    byte [bDisableUI],1
 36602                                          jnz	short to_input_key ; don't allow F8 or F5
 36603                                          cmp     al,42h          ; F8 function key?
 36604                                          jne	short not_f8	; no
 36605                                          xor     byte [bQueryOpt],1
 36606                                          call    show_status     ;
 36607                                          jmp     input_key	;
 36608                                  not_f8:
 36609                                          cmp     al,3Fh          ; F5 function key?
 36610                                          jne	short to_input_key ; no
 36611                                          mov     bx,-1           ; special return code (-1) indicating clean boot
 36612                                          mov     al,' '          ; don't want to display anything really;
 36613                                          jmp     short disp_input; just want to display the cr/lf sequence...
 36614                                  
 36615                                  normal_key:
 36616                                          cmp     al,0Dh          ; Enter?
 36617                                          je	short select_done ; yes
 36618                                          cmp     al,08h          ; backspace?
 36619                                          jne	short not_backspace ; no
 36620                                          mov     bx,-2 ; 0FFFEh	; yes, special return code
 36621                                          retn			;
 36622                                  not_backspace:
 36623                                          sub     al,'0'          ; is greater than '0'?
 36624                                          jbe	short to_input_key ; no
 36625                                          cmp     al,[bMaxBlock]  ; is less than or equal to the maximum digit?
 36626                                          ja	short to_input_key ; no
 36627                                          mov	[bDefBlock],al  ;
 36628                                          call    print_item      ; redisplay the current selection
 36629                                          mov     bl,al           ; set new selection
 36630                                          jmp	short print2
 36631                                  
 36632                                  select_done:
 36633                                          mov     bh,0            ; return a full 16-bit value (for indexing)
 36634                                          mov     al,bl           ;
 36635                                          add     al,'0'          ; convert it into a digit, then display it
 36636                                  
 36637                                  	; fall into disp_input
 36638                                  
 36639                                  ; 16/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 36640                                  
 36641                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36642                                  ;
 36643                                  ;   disp_input:  display a single character + cr/lf
 36644                                  ;
 36645                                  ;   INPUT
 36646                                  ;       AL == character to display
 36647                                  ;
 36648                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36649                                  ;       None
 36650                                  ;
 36651                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36652                                  ;       None
 36653                                  ;
 36654                                  ;   NOTES
 36655                                  ;       This function is used not only for the menu input selection but
 36656                                  ;       also for the interactive line prompting (the y/n/a thing).
 36657                                  ;
 36658                                  ;   HISTORY
 36659                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36660                                  ;
 36661                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36662                                  
 36663                                  disp_input:
 36664                                          push    ax
 36665                                          cmp     al,' '
 36666                                          jae	short disp_ok
 36667                                          mov     al,' '
 36668                                  disp_ok:
 36669                                          mov     dl,al
 36670                                          mov     ah,STD_CON_OUTPUT ; 2
 36671                                          int     21h
 36672                                          mov     dx,crlfm
 36673                                          call    print
 36674                                          pop     ax
 36675                                          retn
 36676                                  
 36677                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36678                                  
 36679                                  disp_num:
 36680                                          push    bx
 36681                                          add     al,'0'
 36682                                          mov     ah,0Ah
 36683                                          mov     bx,[bMenuColor]
 36684                                          mov     cx,1
 36685                                          int     10h
 36686                                          pop     bx
 36687                                          retn
 36688                                  
 36689                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36690                                  ;
 36691                                  ;   show_status:  display current interactive mode setting (on/off/none)
 36692                                  ;
 36693                                  ;   INPUT
 36694                                  ;       None
 36695                                  ;
 36696                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36697                                  ;       None
 36698                                  ;
 36699                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36700                                  ;       None
 36701                                  ;
 36702                                  ;   NOTES
 36703                                  ;       None
 36704                                  ;
 36705                                  ;   HISTORY
 36706                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36707                                  ;
 36708                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36709                                  
 36710                                  show_status:
 36711                                          push    bx              ; BL = video page #
 36712                                          mov     bx,[bMenuColor]
 36713                                          mov     ah,03h          ; get cursor position
 36714                                          int     10h             ;
 36715                                          push    dx              ; save it
 36716                                          mov     ah,02h          ; set cursor position
 36717                                          mov     dx,[bLastCol]   ; set correct row/col
 36718                                          test    byte [bDisableUI],1
 36719                                          jz	short show_onoff ; just show on/off
 36720                                          mov     dl,0            ;
 36721                                          int     10h             ;
 36722                                          mov     ax,0A20h        ; write multiple spaces
 36723                                          mov     cx,80           ; 80 of them, to be exact
 36724                                          int     10h             ; to obliterate the status line
 36725                                          jmp     short show_done ;
 36726                                  show_onoff: 
 36727                                          int     10h
 36728                                  		; - VIDEO - WRITE CHARACTERS ONLY AT CURSOR POSITION
 36729                                  		; AL = character, BH = display page - alpha mode
 36730                                  		; BL = color of character (graphics mode, PCjr only)
 36731                                  		; CX = number of times to write character
 36732                                  
 36733                                          mov     al,[_$NO]	; assume OFF
 36734                                          cmp     byte [bQueryOpt],1 ; is interactive mode on?
 36735                                          jne	short show_noton ; no
 36736                                          mov     al,[_$YES]	; yes
 36737                                  show_noton:                     ;
 36738                                          mov     ah,0Eh          ; write TTY
 36739                                          int     10h             ;
 36740                                  show_done:                      ;
 36741                                          pop     dx              ;
 36742                                          mov     ah,02h          ;
 36743                                          int     10h             ; restore original cursor position
 36744                                          pop     bx              ;
 36745                                          retn			;
 36746                                  
 36747                                  ; 16/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 36748                                  
 36749                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36750                                  ;
 36751                                  ;   skip_token: advances ES:SI/CX past the current token
 36752                                  ;
 36753                                  ;   INPUT
 36754                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 36755                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 36756                                  ;
 36757                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36758                                  ;       CF set if EOL/EOF hit
 36759                                  ;       AL == 1st char of delimiter
 36760                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past the delimiter
 36761                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 36762                                  ;
 36763                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36764                                  ;       AX
 36765                                  ;
 36766                                  ;   NOTES
 36767                                  ;       None
 36768                                  ;
 36769                                  ;   HISTORY
 36770                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36771                                  ;
 36772                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36773                                  
 36774                                  skip_token:
 36775                                          call    get_char
 36776                                          jc	short skip_token_done
 36777                                          call    any_delim
 36778                                          jne	short skip_token
 36779                                  skip_check_eol:
 36780                                          cmp     al,cr ; 0Dh
 36781                                          je	short skip_token_eol
 36782                                          cmp     al,lf ; 0Ah
 36783                                          je	short skip_token_eol
 36784                                          clc
 36785                                          ;jmp	short skip_token_done
 36786                                  	retn
 36787                                  skip_token_eol:
 36788                                          stc
 36789                                  skip_token_done:
 36790                                          retn
 36791                                  
 36792                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36793                                  ;
 36794                                  ;   skip_delim: advances ES:SI/CX past the current delimiter
 36795                                  ;
 36796                                  ;   INPUT
 36797                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 36798                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 36799                                  ;
 36800                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36801                                  ;       CF set if EOF hit
 36802                                  ;       AL == 1st char of token
 36803                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past the token
 36804                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 36805                                  ;    ES:BX -> new token (since ES:SI is already pointing 1 byte past token)
 36806                                  ;
 36807                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36808                                  ;       AX
 36809                                  ;
 36810                                  ;   NOTES
 36811                                  ;       None
 36812                                  ;
 36813                                  ;   HISTORY
 36814                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36815                                  ;
 36816                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36817                                  
 36818                                  skip_delim:       ; returns carry set if eol/eof
 36819                                          call    get_char        ;
 36820                                          lea     bx,[si-1]       ; also returns BX -> next token
 36821                                          jc	short skip_token_done ;
 36822                                          call    delim           ;
 36823                                          je	short skip_delim ;
 36824                                          jmp	short skip_check_eol  ; 13/05/2019
 36825                                  
 36826                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36827                                  ;
 36828                                  ;   skip_opt_line: same as skip_line provided AL != LF
 36829                                  ;
 36830                                  ;   INPUT
 36831                                  ;       AL == last character read
 36832                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 36833                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 36834                                  ;
 36835                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36836                                  ;       CF set if EOF hit
 36837                                  ;       AL == 1st char of new line
 36838                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past 1st char of new line
 36839                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 36840                                  ;
 36841                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36842                                  ;       AX
 36843                                  ;
 36844                                  ;   NOTES
 36845                                  ;       In other words, the purpose here is to skip to the next line,
 36846                                  ;       unless ES:SI is already sitting at the front of the next line (which
 36847                                  ;       it would be if the last character fetched -- AL -- was a linefeed)
 36848                                  ;
 36849                                  ;   HISTORY
 36850                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36851                                  ;
 36852                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36853                                  
 36854                                  skip_opt_line:
 36855                                          cmp     al,lf ; 0Ah
 36856                                          je	short skip_line_done
 36857                                       
 36858                                  	; fall into skip_line
 36859                                  
 36860                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36861                                  ;
 36862                                  ;   skip_line: skip to the next line
 36863                                  ;
 36864                                  ;   INPUT
 36865                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 36866                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 36867                                  ;
 36868                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36869                                  ;       CF set if EOF hit
 36870                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past 1st char of new line
 36871                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 36872                                  ;
 36873                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36874                                  ;       AX
 36875                                  ;
 36876                                  ;   NOTES
 36877                                  ;       None
 36878                                  ;
 36879                                  ;   HISTORY
 36880                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36881                                  ;
 36882                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36883                                  
 36884                                  skip_line:
 36885                                          call    get_char
 36886                                          jc	short skip_line_done
 36887                                          cmp     al,lf ; 0Ah
 36888                                          jne	short skip_line
 36889                                  skip_line_done:
 36890                                  num_done:	; 18/12/2022
 36891                                          retn
 36892                                  
 36893                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36894                                  ;
 36895                                  ;   get_number: return binary equivalent of numeric string
 36896                                  ;
 36897                                  ;   INPUT
 36898                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 36899                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 36900                                  ;
 36901                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36902                                  ;       AL == non-digit encountered
 36903                                  ;       BX == binary #
 36904                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past 1st non-digit
 36905                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 36906                                  ;
 36907                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36908                                  ;       AX
 36909                                  ;
 36910                                  ;   NOTES
 36911                                  ;       None
 36912                                  ;
 36913                                  ;   HISTORY
 36914                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36915                                  ;
 36916                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36917                                  
 36918                                  ; 13/05/2019
 36919                                  
 36920                                  get_number:
 36921                                          sub     bx,bx           ; BX = result
 36922                                  num_loop:
 36923                                          call    get_char        ;
 36924                                          jc	short num_done	;
 36925                                          cmp     al,'0'          ; convert to value
 36926                                          jb	short num_done	; no more number
 36927                                          cmp     al,'9'          ;
 36928                                          ja	short num_done	;
 36929                                          push    ax              ;
 36930                                          mov     ax,10           ;
 36931                                          push    dx              ;
 36932                                          mul     bx              ;
 36933                                          pop     dx              ;
 36934                                          mov     bx,ax           ;
 36935                                          pop     ax              ;
 36936                                          sub     al,'0'          ;
 36937                                          cbw                     ;
 36938                                          add     bx,ax           ;
 36939                                          jmp	short num_loop	;
 36940                                  
 36941                                  	; 18/12/2022
 36942                                  ;num_done:
 36943                                          ;retn
 36944                                  
 36945                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36946                                  ;
 36947                                  ;   get_char:  return next character, advance ES:SI, and decrement CX
 36948                                  ;
 36949                                  ;   INPUT
 36950                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 36951                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 36952                                  ;
 36953                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36954                                  ;       AL == next character
 36955                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past next character
 36956                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 36957                                  ;
 36958                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36959                                  ;       AX
 36960                                  ;
 36961                                  ;   NOTES
 36962                                  ;       None
 36963                                  ;
 36964                                  ;   HISTORY
 36965                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 36966                                  ;
 36967                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36968                                  
 36969                                  get_char:
 36970                                          sub     cx,1            ; use SUB to set carry,zero
 36971                                          jb	short get_fail	; out of data
 36972                                          ;lods	byte ptr es:[si] ;
 36973                                  	es	
 36974                                  	lodsb
 36975                                          mov     ah,al           ;
 36976                                          retn			;
 36977                                  get_fail:                       ; restore CX to zero
 36978                                          mov     cx,0            ; leave carry set, zero not set
 36979                                  nearby_ret:
 36980                                          retn
 36981                                  
 36982                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36983                                  ;
 36984                                  ;   query_user: ask user whether to execute current config.sys command
 36985                                  ;
 36986                                  ;   INPUT
 36987                                  ;       AL == current command code
 36988                                  ;    ES:SI -> current command line in config.sys
 36989                                  ;    config_cmd == current command code, but with QUERY bit intact
 36990                                  ;                  (00h used to generate "Process AUTOEXEC.BAT" prompt)
 36991                                  ;
 36992                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36993                                  ;       CF set if command should be ignored (it is also REM'ed out)
 36994                                  ;
 36995                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36996                                  ;       BX, CX, DX, DI
 36997                                  ;
 36998                                  ;   NOTES
 36999                                  ;       None
 37000                                  ;
 37001                                  ;   HISTORY
 37002                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37003                                  ;
 37004                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37005                                  
 37006                                  	; 12/12/2022
 37007                                  query_user:
 37008                                          test    byte [bQueryOpt],4	; answer no to everything?
 37009                                          ;jz	short qu_1		;
 37010                                          ; 12/12/2022
 37011                                  	;jmp	short skip_all		;
 37012                                  	jnz	short skip_all
 37013                                  qu_1:
 37014                                  	test    byte [bQueryOpt],2	; answer yes to everything?
 37015                                          jnz	short nearby_ret	; yes (and return carry clear!)
 37016                                          push    ax                      ;
 37017                                          mov     al,[config_cmd]         ;
 37018                                          test    byte [bQueryOpt],1	; query every command?
 37019                                          jnz	short query_all		; yes
 37020                                          test    al,CONFIG_OPTION_QUERY  ;
 37021                                          ;jnz	short query_all		;
 37022                                          ; 12/12/2022
 37023                                  	;jmp	short do_cmd		;
 37024                                  	jz	short do_cmd ; cf=0
 37025                                  query_all:
 37026                                  
 37027                                  ;   Search for the command code (AL) in "comtab", and then print
 37028                                  ;   out the corresponding keyword, followed by the rest of the actual
 37029                                  ;   line pointed to by ES:SI
 37030                                  
 37031                                          push    si                      ; save pointer to rest of CONFIG.SYS line
 37032                                          mov     dx,_$AutoPrmpt    	;
 37033                                          and     al,~CONFIG_OPTION_QUERY ; 7Fh
 37034                                          jz	short generic_prompt	; config_cmd must have been 0
 37035                                  
 37036                                          mov     dh,al                   ; save config_cmd in DH
 37037                                          sub     bx,bx                   ;
 37038                                          mov     di,comtab		;
 37039                                  find_match:                             ;
 37040                                          mov     bl,[di]                 ; get size of current keyword
 37041                                          or      bl,bl                   ;
 37042                                          jz	short line_print	; end of table
 37043                                          inc     di                      ;
 37044                                          cmp     al,[di+bx]              ; match?
 37045                                          je	short cmd_match		; yes
 37046                                          lea     di,[di+bx+1]            ; otherwise, skip this command code
 37047                                  	; 13/05/2019	
 37048                                          jmp	short find_match	; loop
 37049                                  cmd_match:                              ;
 37050                                          mov     cl,[di-1]               ;
 37051                                          mov     ch,0                    ;
 37052                                          mov     ah,STD_CON_OUTPUT ; 2
 37053                                  cmd_print:                              ;
 37054                                          mov     al,[di]                 ;
 37055                                          inc     di                      ;
 37056                                          mov     dl,al                   ;
 37057                                          int     21h                     ;
 37058                                          loop    cmd_print               ;
 37059                                          mov     dl,'='                  ;
 37060                                          cmp     dh,CONFIG_SET  ; 'V'    ; for SET commands, don't display a '='
 37061                                          jne	short cmd_notset	;
 37062                                          mov     dl,' '                  ;
 37063                                  cmd_notset:
 37064                                          int     21h                     ; '=' looks funny on SET commands
 37065                                  line_print:                             ;
 37066                                  	;lods	byte ptr es:[si]        ;
 37067                                          es
 37068                                  	lodsb
 37069                                  	or      al,al                   ;
 37070                                          jnz	short non_null		;
 37071                                          mov     al,' '                  ;
 37072                                  non_null:                               ;
 37073                                          cmp     al,' '                  ; control code?
 37074                                          jb	short prompt_user	; yes, assume end of line
 37075                                          jne	short non_space		;
 37076                                          cmp     byte [es:si],' '	;
 37077                                          jb	short prompt_user	;
 37078                                  non_space:                              ;
 37079                                          mov     dl,al                   ;
 37080                                          mov     ah,STD_CON_OUTPUT ; 2	;
 37081                                          int     21h                     ;
 37082                                          jmp	short line_print	;
 37083                                  prompt_user:                            ;
 37084                                          mov     dx,_$InterPrmpt		;
 37085                                  
 37086                                  generic_prompt:
 37087                                          call    print                   ;
 37088                                  input_loop:                             ;
 37089                                          mov     ah,0                    ; read a key
 37090                                          int     16h                     ;
 37091                                          or      al,al                   ; is it a function key?
 37092                                          jnz	short not_func		; no
 37093                                          cmp     ah,3Fh                  ; F5 function key?
 37094                                          jne	short input_loop	; no
 37095                                          mov     al,[_$NO]                  ;
 37096                                          or      byte [bQueryOpt],4	; no more queries
 37097                                          jmp     short legal_char        ;
 37098                                  not_func:
 37099                                          and     al,~20h ; 0DFh		; converting to upper case
 37100                                          cmp     al,[_$NO]		; verify character is legal
 37101                                          je	short legal_char	;
 37102                                          cmp     al,[_$YES]		;
 37103                                          je	short legal_char	;
 37104                                          cmp     byte [config_cmd],0	;
 37105                                          je	short input_loop	; don't allow Esc on this query
 37106                                          cmp     al,1Bh                  ; Esc?
 37107                                          jne	short input_loop	;
 37108                                          or      byte [bQueryOpt],2	; no more interactive boot prompts
 37109                                          mov     al,[_$YES]
 37110                                  legal_char:                             ;
 37111                                          call    disp_input              ;
 37112                                          pop     si                      ; restore pointer to rest of CONFIG.SYS line
 37113                                  
 37114                                          cmp     al,[_$NO]		; process line?
 37115                                          je	short skip_cmd		; no
 37116                                  	; 12/12/2022
 37117                                  	clc
 37118                                  do_cmd:
 37119                                  	pop     ax			;
 37120                                  	; 12/12/2022
 37121                                  	; cf=0
 37122                                  	;clc				; just do the command
 37123                                  	retn
 37124                                  
 37125                                  skip_cmd:
 37126                                  	pop     ax			;
 37127                                  skip_all:
 37128                                  	mov     ah,CONFIG_REM ; '0'	; fake out the rest of sysinit's processing
 37129                                  	stc
 37130                                  	retn
 37131                                  
 37132                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37133                                  ;
 37134                                  ;   print_error: displays multi-config error conditions
 37135                                  ;
 37136                                  ;   INPUT
 37137                                  ;    Carry set to pause, clear to not
 37138                                  ;    ES:SI -> current command line in config.sys
 37139                                  ;
 37140                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37141                                  ;       None
 37142                                  ;
 37143                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 37144                                  ;       None
 37145                                  ;
 37146                                  ;   NOTES
 37147                                  ;       None
 37148                                  ;
 37149                                  ;   HISTORY
 37150                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37151                                  ;
 37152                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37153                                  
 37154                                  print_error:
 37155                                          push    ax
 37156                                          push    bx
 37157                                          push    cx
 37158                                          push    dx
 37159                                          push    ds
 37160                                          push    cs
 37161                                          pop     ds
 37162                                          pushf
 37163                                          call    get_linenum
 37164                                          mov     [linecount],bx
 37165                                          call    error_line
 37166                                          popf
 37167                                          jnc	short pe_ret
 37168                                          mov     dx,_$PauseMsg
 37169                                          call    print
 37170                                          mov     ax,0C07h		; flush input buffer, then wait for key
 37171                                          int     21h			; wait for a key
 37172                                          or      al,al			; extended key?
 37173                                          jnz	short pe_1		; no
 37174                                          mov     ah,07h			; yes
 37175                                          int     21h			; eat it too
 37176                                  pe_1:     
 37177                                  	mov     dx,crlfm
 37178                                          call    print
 37179                                  pe_ret: 
 37180                                  	pop     ds
 37181                                          pop     dx
 37182                                          pop     cx
 37183                                          pop     bx
 37184                                          pop     ax
 37185                                  	retn
 37186                                  
 37187                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37188                                  
 37189                                  ;   This function is very simple:  it merely prepends a "/D" to the
 37190                                  ;   command-line for the shell;  this (undocumented) switch disables
 37191                                  ;   AUTOEXEC.BAT processing and the date/time prompt that is usually
 37192                                  ;   displayed when there's no AUTOEXEC.BAT.
 37193                                  
 37194                                  disable_autoexec:
 37195                                  	; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS -  SYSINIT:4BE2h
 37196                                  	; 17/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 37197                                  
 37198                                  	test	byte [bQueryOpt],4
 37199                                  	jz	short disable_exit
 37200                                  	test	byte [dae_flag],1
 37201                                  	jnz	short disable_exit
 37202                                  	or	byte [dae_flag],1
 37203                                          ;or	byte [bQueryOpt],2 ; MSDOS 6.0 
 37204                                  	or      word [bQueryOpt],102h	; [bDefBlock] = 1
 37205                                  	mov     dx,'D ' ; 2044h
 37206                                  dae_1:
 37207                                          ;mov	al,[def_swchr]
 37208                                  	mov     al,[command_line-1]     ; get default switchchar
 37209                                          or      al,al                   ; anything there?
 37210                                          jz	short disable_exit	; no, disable_autoexec already called
 37211                                          mov     bl,[command_line]       ;
 37212                                          mov     bh,0                    ; BX == command-line length
 37213                                          mov     cx,bx                   ;
 37214                                          add     bl,3                    ;
 37215                                          cmp     bl,126                  ;
 37216                                          ja	short disable_exit	;
 37217                                          mov     [command_line],bl       ; update length
 37218                                          add     bx,command_line+1	; make sure we move the NULL too
 37219                                          inc     cx                      ; (just for consistency sake)
 37220                                  disable_loop:                           ;
 37221                                          mov     ah,[bx-3]               ;
 37222                                          mov     [bx],ah                 ;
 37223                                          dec     bx                      ;
 37224                                          loop    disable_loop            ;
 37225                                          mov     [bx-2],al               ;
 37226                                  	;mov	word [bx-1],'D ' ; 2044h ; /D is stuffed into place now
 37227                                  	mov	[bx-1],dx  ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS - SYSINIT:4C29h		
 37228                                          ;mov	byte [command_line-1],0 ;
 37229                                  disable_exit:                           ;
 37230                                          retn
 37231                                  
 37232                                  CheckQueryOpt:	; MSDOS 6.21 IO.YSYS - SYSINIT:4C2Dh
 37233                                  	cmp     byte [bQueryOpt],1
 37234                                  	jnz     short disable_exit
 37235                                  	test	byte [dae_flag],2
 37236                                  	jnz     short disable_exit
 37237                                  	or      byte [dae_flag],2
 37238                                  	mov     dx,'Y ' ; 2059h ; 11/09/2023
 37239                                  	jmp     short dae_1
 37240                                  
 37241                                  ;endif  ;MULTI_CONFIG
 37242                                  
 37243                                  %endif	; 02/11/2022

 37255                                  ;

 37258                                  ;any_delim:

 37260                                  ;       je	short delim_ret
 37261                                  ;       cmp     al,lf
 37262                                  ;       je	short delim_ret

 37264                                  ;       je	short delim_ret

 37270                                  	; 02/11/2022 - Retrodos v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 37271                                  	; (SYSINIT:3450h)

 37277 00002FA5 7413                    	je	short delim_ret
 37278

 37280 00002FA7 3C20                    	cmp	al,' '          ; the filename.
 37281 00002FA9 740F                    	je	short delim_ret
 37282 00002FAB 3C09                            cmp     al,tab ; 9
 37283 00002FAD 740B                    	je	short delim_ret
 37284 00002FAF 3C3D                    	cmp	al,'='
 37285 00002FB1 7407                    	je	short delim_ret
 37286 00002FB3 3C2C                    	cmp	al,','
 37287 00002FB5 7403                    	je	short delim_ret
 37288 00002FB7 3C3B                    	cmp	al,';'
 37289                                  
 37290                                  	; 02/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 37291                                  ;ifdef	MULTI_CONFIG
 37292                                  ;   Make sure there's no chance of a false EOF indication
 37293 00002FB9 F8                      	clc	; 09/09/2023 ('SkipDelim' must not be return with cf=1)
 37294                                  ;endif
 37295                                  	; 02/11/2022
 37296                                  delim_ret:
 37297                                  nl_ret:	; 10/09/2023
 37298 00002FBA C3                      	retn

 37538                                  ;
 37539                                  ; procedure : getnum
 37540                                  ;
 37541                                  ; getnum parses a decimal number.
 37542                                  ; returns it in ax, sets zero flag if ax = 0 (may be considered an
 37543                                  ; error), if number is bad carry is set, zero is set, ax=0.
 37544                                  ;
 37545                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37546                                  
 37547                                  getnum:
 37548 00003069 53                      	push	bx
 37549 0000306A 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx			; running count is zero
 37550                                  b2:
 37551 0000306C E8F2FF                  	call	todigit 		; do we have a digit ?
 37552 0000306F 7247                    	jc	short badnum		; no, bomb
 37553                                  
 37554 00003071 93                      	xchg	ax,bx			; put total in ax
 37555 00003072 53                      	push	bx			; save digit (0 to 9)
 37556                                  	;mov	bx,10			; base of arithmetic
 37557                                  	; 12/12/2022
 37558 00003073 B30A                    	mov	bl,10
 37559 00003075 F7E3                    	mul	bx			; shift by one decimal digit
 37560 00003077 5B                      	pop	bx			; get back digit (0 to 9)
 37561 00003078 00D8                    	add	al,bl			; get total
 37562 0000307A 80D400                  	adc	ah,0			; make that 16 bits
 37563 0000307D 7239                    	jc	short badnum		; too big a number
 37564                                  
 37565 0000307F 93                      	xchg	ax,bx			; stash total
 37566                                  
 37567 00003080 E841FF                  	call	getchr			;get next digit
 37568 00003083 722D                    	jc	short b1		; no more characters
 37569 00003085 3C20                    	cmp	al,' ' 			; space?
 37570 00003087 741F                    	je	short b15		; then end of digits
 37571 00003089 3C2C                    	cmp	al,',' 			; ',' is a seperator!!!
 37572 0000308B 741B                    	je	short b15		; then end of digits.
 37573 0000308D 3C09                    	cmp	al, tab ; 9		; tab
 37574 0000308F 7417                    	je	short b15
 37575 00003091 2E3A06[2A03]            	cmp	al,[cs:sepchr]		; allow 0 or special separators
 37576 00003096 7410                    	je	short b15
 37577 00003098 3C2F                    	cmp	al,'/'			; see if another switch follows
 37578                                  	;nop				; cas - remnant of old bad code
 37579                                  	;nop
 37580                                  	; 12/12/2022
 37581                                  	; 02/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 37582                                  	;nop
 37583                                  	;nop
 37584 0000309A 740C                    	je	short b15
 37585 0000309C 3C0A                    	cmp	al,lf			; line-feed?
 37586 0000309E 7408                    	je	short b15
 37587 000030A0 3C0D                    	cmp	al,cr			; carriage return?
 37588 000030A2 7404                    	je	short b15
 37589 000030A4 08C0                    	or	al,al			; end of line separator?
 37590 000030A6 75C4                    	jnz	short b2		; no, try as a valid char...
 37591                                  b15:
 37592 000030A8 2EFF06[D203]            	inc	word [cs:count]		; one more character to s...
 37593 000030AD 2EFF0E[D603]            	dec	word [cs:chrptr]	; back up over separator
 37594                                  b1:
 37595 000030B2 89D8                    	mov	ax,bx			; get proper count
 37596 000030B4 09C0                    	or	ax,ax			; clears carry, sets zero accordingly
 37597 000030B6 5B                      	pop	bx
 37598 000030B7 C3                      	retn
 37599                                  badnum:
 37600                                  	; 02/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 37601                                  	;mov	byte [cs:sepchr],0
 37602 000030B8 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax			; set zero flag, and ax = 0
 37603                                  	; 12 /12/2022
 37604 000030BA 2EA2[2A03]              	mov	[cs:sepchr],al ; 0
 37605 000030BE 5B                      	pop	bx
 37606 000030BF F9                      	stc				; and carry set
 37607 000030C0 C3                      	retn
