 37941                                  ;move file pointer to cx:dx
 37942                                  ;read ax bytes into the control buffer. (should be less than 2 kb)
 37943                                  ;si will be set to 0 hence ds:si points to the control buffer.
 37944                                  ;
 37945                                  ;entry:  cx,dx offset from the start of the file where the read/write pointer
 37946                                  ;	 be moved.
 37947                                  ;	 ax - # of bytes to read
 37948                                  ;	 bx - file handle
 37949                                  ;	 ds - buffer seg.
 37950                                  ;return: the control data information is read into ds:0 - ds:0200.
 37951                                  ;	 cx,dx value destroyed.
 37952                                  ;	 carry set if error in reading file.
 37953                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37954                                  
 37955 00003211 50                      	push	ax			;# of bytes to read
 37956 00003212 B80042                  	mov	ax,4200h
 37957 00003215 F9                      	stc
 37958 00003216 CD21                    	int	21h			;move pointer
 37959 00003218 59                      	pop	cx			;# of bytes to read
 37960 00003219 7209                    	jc	short ricb_exit
 37961                                  
 37962 0000321B 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx			;ds:dx -> control buffer
 37963 0000321D 31F6                    	xor	si,si
 37964 0000321F B43F                    	mov	ah,3Fh			;read into the buffer
 37965 00003221 F9                      	stc
 37966 00003222 CD21                    	int	21h			;should be less than 1024 bytes.
 37967                                  ricb_exit:
 37968 00003224 C3                      	retn
 37969                                  
 37970                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37971                                  
 37972                                  ;! set_country_path procedure is not called from anywhere !

 37974                                  %if 0
 37975                                  
 37976                                  set_country_path:
 37977                                  
 37978                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37979                                  ;in:  ds - sysinitseg, es - confbot, si -> start of the asciiz path string
 37980                                  ;     dosinfo_ext, cntry_drv, cntry_root, cntry_path
 37981                                  ;     assumes current directory is the root directory.
 37982                                  ;out: ds:di -> full path (cntry_drv).
 37983                                  ;     set the cntry_drv string from the country=,,path command.
 37984                                  ;     ds, es, si value saved.
 37985                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37986                                  
 37987                                  	; 04/01/2023 - Retrodos v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 37988                                  	; (SYSINIT:4EF4h)
 37989                                  
 37990                                  	; 10/09/2023 - Retrodos v4.1 IO.SYS (Optimization)
 37991                                  	; (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS - SYSINIT:36DDh)
 37992                                  
 37993                                  	push	si
 37994                                  
 37995                                  	push	ds			;switch ds, es
 37996                                  	push	es
 37997                                  	pop	ds
 37998                                  	pop	es			;now ds -> confbot, es -> sysinitseg
 37999                                  
 38000                                  	call	chk_drive_letter	;current ds:[si] is a drive letter?
 38001                                  	jc	short scp_default_drv 	;no, use current default drive.
 38002                                  
 38003                                  	mov	al,[si]
 38004                                  	inc	si
 38005                                  	inc	si			;si -> next char after ":"
 38006                                  	jmp	short scp_setdrv
 38007                                  
 38008                                  scp_default_drv:
 38009                                  	mov	ah,19h
 38010                                  	int	21h
 38011                                  	add	al,"A"			;convert it to a character.
 38012                                  
 38013                                  scp_setdrv:
 38014                                  	mov	[cs:cntry_drv],al	;set the drive letter.
 38015                                  	mov	di,cntry_path
 38016                                  	mov	al,[si]
 38017                                  	cmp	al, "\"
 38018                                  	je	short scp_root_dir
 38019                                  
 38020                                  	cmp	al,"/"			;let's accept "/" as an directory delim
 38021                                  	;je	short scp_root_dir
 38022                                  	;jmp	short scp_path
 38023                                  	; 04/01/2023
 38024                                  	jne	short scp_path
 38025                                  
 38026                                  scp_root_dir:
 38027                                  	dec	di			;di -> cntry_root
 38028                                  scp_path:
 38029                                  	call	move_asciiz		;copy it
 38030                                  
 38031                                  	mov	di,cntry_drv
 38032                                  scpath_exit:
 38033                                  
 38034                                  	push	ds			;switch ds, es
 38035                                  	push	es
 38036                                  	pop	ds
 38037                                  	pop	es			;ds, es value restored
 38038                                  
 38039                                  	pop	si
 38040                                  	retn
 38041                                  
 38042                                  %endif
 38043                                  
 38044                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38045                                  
 38046                                  chk_drive_letter:
 38047                                  
 38048                                  ;check if ds:[si] is a drive letter followed by ":".
 38049                                  ;assume that every alpha character is already converted to upper case.
 38050                                  ;carry set if not.
 38051                                  
 38052                                  	; 10/09/2023 - Retrodos v4.1 IO.SYS (Optimization)
 38053                                  
 38054 00003225 50                      	push	ax
 38055 00003226 803C41                  	cmp	byte [si],"A"
 38056                                  	;jb	short cdletter_no
 38057 00003229 720C                    	jb	short cdletter_exit
 38058 0000322B 803C5A                  	cmp	byte [si],"Z"
 38059 0000322E 7706                    	ja	short cdletter_no
 38060 00003230 807C013A                	cmp	byte [si+1],":"
 38061                                  	;jne	short cdletter_no
 38062                                  	;jmp	short cdletter_exit
 38063                                  	; 10/09/2023
 38064 00003234 7401                    	je	short cdletter_exit
 38065

 38067 00003236 F9                      	stc
 38068                                  cdletter_exit:
